@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Settings:
    start: date = date(2018, 1, 1)
    end: date | None = None
    futures_id: str = "TX"
    split_date: date = date(2023, 1, 1)
    history_window: int = 252
    minimum_history: int = 60
    minimum_group_size: int = 20
    minimum_year_size: int = 80
    alpha: float = 0.05

    def validate(self) -> None:
        if self.end and self.end < self.start:
            raise ValueError("end 不可早於 start")
        if self.split_date <= self.start:
            raise ValueError("split_date 必須晚於 start")
        if self.history_window < 60:
            raise ValueError("history_window 至少為 60")
        if not 20 <= self.minimum_history <= self.history_window:
            raise ValueError("minimum_history 必須介於20與history_window之間")
        if self.minimum_group_size < 10 or self.minimum_year_size < 40:
            raise ValueError("樣本門檻過低")


def load_source(settings: Settings) -> pd.DataFrame:
    from common import db

    settings.validate()
    query_start = settings.start - timedelta(days=max(400, settings.history_window * 2))
    columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*SOURCE_COLUMNS, *EXTRA_SOURCE_COLUMNS)))
    selected = ", ".join(f'"{column}"' for column in columns)
    sql = f'''SELECT futures_id, {selected}
              FROM {SOURCE_VIEW}
              WHERE futures_id = ? AND "日期" >= ?'''
    params: list[Any] = [settings.futures_id, query_start]
    if settings.end:
        sql += ' AND "日期" <= ?'
        params.append(settings.end)
    sql += ' ORDER BY "日期"'
    return db.sql_to_df(sql, params=tuple(params), parse_dates=["日期"])


def load_targets(settings: Settings) -> pd.DataFrame:
    from common import db

    sql = f'''
        SELECT trading_date, range_ratio, amplitude_label, path_pattern_label,
               excursion_bias_label, session_trend_label
        FROM {TARGET_VIEW}
        WHERE futures_id = ?
          AND valid_for_research
          AND trading_date BETWEEN ? AND ?
        ORDER BY trading_date
    '''
    return db.sql_to_df(
        sql,
        params=(settings.futures_id, settings.start, settings.end or date.today()),
        parse_dates=["trading_date"],
    )


def _pct(numerator: pd.Series, denominator: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return _safe_ratio(numerator, denominator) * 100.0


def _rolling_previous_mean(values: pd.Series, window: int) -> pd.Series:
    return pd.to_numeric(values, errors="coerce").shift(1).rolling(window, min_periods=window).mean()


def _direction_code(values: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    text = values.astype("string").str.strip()
    result = pd.Series(np.nan, index=values.index, dtype=float)
    result[text.str.contains("多|漲", na=False)] = 1.0
    result[text.str.contains("空|跌", na=False)] = -1.0
    return result


def build_extended_features(source: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
    ordered = source.sort_values("日期").reset_index(drop=True).copy()
    features, metadata = build_signal_features(ordered)
    day_open = _numeric(ordered, "日盤開")
    day_high = _numeric(ordered, "日盤高")
    day_low = _numeric(ordered, "日盤低")
    day_close = _numeric(ordered, "日盤收")
    night_open = _numeric(ordered, "夜盤開")
    night_high = _numeric(ordered, "夜盤高")
    night_low = _numeric(ordered, "夜盤低")
    night_close = _numeric(ordered, "夜盤收")
    day_range = day_high - day_low
    night_range = night_high - night_low
    day_volume = _numeric(ordered, "日成交量")
    night_volume = _numeric(ordered, "夜成交量")
    day_return = _pct(day_close - day_open, day_open)
    night_return = _pct(night_close - night_open, night_open)

    additions: dict[str, tuple[pd.Series, str, str, bool]] = {
        "日盤開收": (day_return, "日夜盤", "(日收-日開)/日開*100", True),
        "日盤振幅": (_pct(day_range, day_open), "日夜盤", "(日高-日低)/日開*100", False),
        "日盤收盤位置": (_safe_ratio(day_close - day_low, day_range) * 100, "日夜盤", "(日收-日低)/(日高-日低)*100", True),
        "夜盤相對日收": (_pct(night_close - day_close, day_close), "日夜盤", "(夜收-日收)/日收*100", True),
        "夜盤開收": (night_return, "日夜盤", "(夜收-夜開)/夜開*100", True),
        "夜盤振幅": (_pct(night_range, night_open), "日夜盤", "(夜高-夜低)/夜開*100", False),
        "夜盤收盤位置": (_safe_ratio(night_close - night_low, night_range) * 100, "日夜盤", "(夜收-夜低)/(夜高-夜低)*100", True),
        "夜日振幅比": (_safe_ratio(night_range, day_range), "振幅狀態", "夜盤振幅/日盤振幅", False),
        "日盤振幅_前30日比": (_safe_ratio(day_range, _rolling_previous_mean(day_range, 30)), "振幅狀態", "日盤振幅/此前30日平均", False),
        "夜盤振幅_前30日比": (_safe_ratio(night_range, _rolling_previous_mean(night_range, 30)), "振幅狀態", "夜盤振幅/此前30日平均", False),
        "近5日日盤振幅_前30日比": (_safe_ratio(day_range.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean(), _rolling_previous_mean(day_range, 30)), "振幅狀態", "近5日日盤平均振幅/此前30日平均", False),
        "日成交量_前20日比": (_safe_ratio(day_volume, _rolling_previous_mean(day_volume, 20)), "量能", "日成交量/此前20日平均", False),
        "夜成交量_前20日比": (_safe_ratio(night_volume, _rolling_previous_mean(night_volume, 20)), "量能", "夜成交量/此前20日平均", False),
        "日夜方向一致": ((np.sign(day_return) == np.sign(night_return)).where(day_return.notna() & night_return.notna()).astype(float), "日夜盤", "日盤與夜盤開收同方向=1", False),
        "日盤走勢碼": (_direction_code(ordered["日盤走勢"]), "型態", "漲勢盤=1、跌勢盤=-1", True),
        "夜盤走勢碼": (_direction_code(ordered["夜盤走勢"]), "型態", "漲勢盤=1、跌勢盤=-1", True),
        "核心昨價量方向碼": (_direction_code(ordered["策略_核心_昨價量"]), "既有訊號", "多=1、空=-1", True),
        "核心五日價量方向碼": (_direction_code(ordered["策略_核心_五日價量"]), "既有訊號", "多=1、空=-1", True),
    }
    for name, (values, category, formula, natural_direction) in additions.items():
        features[name] = pd.to_numeric(values, errors="coerce")
        metadata[name] = {
            "類別": category,
            "公式": formula,
            "天然方向": natural_direction,
        }
    return features, metadata


def add_target_flags(targets: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    result = targets.copy()
    amplitude = result["amplitude_label"].isin(["劇烈振幅", "極端振幅"])
    strong_long = result["path_pattern_label"].eq("強單邊多")
    strong_short = result["path_pattern_label"].eq("強單邊空")
    result["劇烈以上"] = amplitude.astype(int)
    result["劇烈強單邊"] = (amplitude & (strong_long | strong_short)).astype(int)
    result["劇烈強單邊多"] = (amplitude & strong_long).astype(int)
    result["劇烈強單邊空"] = (amplitude & strong_short).astype(int)
    result["劇烈非單邊"] = (amplitude & ~(strong_long | strong_short)).astype(int)
    return result


def prepare_detail(
    source: pd.DataFrame,
    targets: pd.DataFrame,
    settings: Settings,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
    ordered = source.sort_values("日期").reset_index(drop=True).copy()
    features, metadata = build_extended_features(ordered)
    target_flags = add_target_flags(targets)
    target_flags["trading_date"] = pd.to_datetime(target_flags["trading_date"])
    target_lookup = target_flags.set_index("trading_date")
    signal_date = pd.to_datetime(ordered["日期"])
    result_date = signal_date.shift(-1)
    common = pd.DataFrame({"訊號日": signal_date, "結果日": result_date})
    common = common.join(target_lookup, on="結果日")
    parts: list[pd.DataFrame] = []
    for name, meta in metadata.items():
        raw = pd.to_numeric(features[name], errors="coerce")
        percentile = _rolling_percentile(raw, settings.history_window, settings.minimum_history)
        part = common.copy()
        part["指標類別"] = meta["類別"]
        part["指標代碼"] = name
        part["公式"] = meta["公式"]
        part["原始值"] = raw
        part["歷史分位_pct"] = percentile
        part["強度層"] = _strength_bucket(percentile)
        parts.append(part)
    detail = pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True)
    valid = detail["結果日"].notna() & detail["range_ratio"].notna()
    detail = detail[valid].copy()
    return detail.reset_index(drop=True), metadata


def build_target_distribution(targets: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    work = add_target_flags(targets)
    work["年"] = pd.to_datetime(work["trading_date"]).dt.year
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    periods: list[tuple[str, pd.DataFrame]] = [("全期", work)]
    periods.extend((str(year), group) for year, group in work.groupby("年", sort=True))
    for period, group in periods:
        total = len(group)
        for target in TARGETS:
            count = int(group[target].sum())
            rows.append({
                "期間": period, "分組": "研究目標", "標籤": target,
                "樣本數": count, "母體數": total,
                "占比_pct": count / total * 100 if total else math.nan,
            })
        for group_name, column in (("振幅標籤", "amplitude_label"), ("路徑型態", "path_pattern_label")):
            for label, count in group[column].value_counts(dropna=False).items():
                rows.append({
                    "期間": period, "分組": group_name, "標籤": label,
                    "樣本數": int(count), "母體數": total,
                    "占比_pct": count / total * 100 if total else math.nan,
                })
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def build_bucket_summary(detail: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for (category, signal), signal_data in detail.groupby(["指標類別", "指標代碼"], sort=False):
        for target in TARGETS:
            usable = signal_data.dropna(subset=["強度層", target])
            baseline = usable[target].mean()
            for bucket in BUCKET_LABELS:
                group = usable[usable["強度層"] == bucket]
                count = len(group)
                events = int(group[target].sum()) if count else 0
                rate = events / count if count else math.nan
                rows.append({
                    "指標類別": category, "指標代碼": signal, "研究目標": target,
                    "強度層": bucket, "樣本數": count, "事件數": events,
                    "事件率_pct": rate * 100 if count else math.nan,
                    "母體事件率_pct": baseline * 100 if np.isfinite(baseline) else math.nan,
                    "Lift": rate / baseline if count and baseline > 0 else math.nan,
                    "相對母體增減_百分點": (rate - baseline) * 100 if count else math.nan,
                    "平均振幅倍數": group["range_ratio"].mean() if count else math.nan,
                })
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def _period_stats(data: pd.DataFrame, target: str, minimum_group_size: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    usable = data[["歷史分位_pct", "強度層", target]].dropna()
    result: dict[str, Any] = {
        "樣本數": len(usable), "事件數": int(usable[target].sum()),
        "母體事件率_pct": usable[target].mean() * 100 if len(usable) else math.nan,
    }
    if len(usable) < minimum_group_size * 2 or usable[target].nunique() < 2:
        return result
    rho, rho_p = spearmanr(usable["歷史分位_pct"], usable[target])
    result.update({"趨勢效果": rho, "趨勢p值": rho_p})
    low = usable[usable["強度層"] == BUCKET_LABELS[0]][target]
    high = usable[usable["強度層"] == BUCKET_LABELS[-1]][target]
    if min(len(low), len(high)) >= minimum_group_size:
        table = [[int(high.sum()), int(len(high) - high.sum())], [int(low.sum()), int(len(low) - low.sum())]]
        odds_ratio, fisher_p = fisher_exact(table, alternative="two-sided")
        q1_rate = low.mean()
        q5_rate = high.mean()
        result.update({
            "Q1樣本數": len(low), "Q5樣本數": len(high),
            "Q1事件率_pct": q1_rate * 100, "Q5事件率_pct": q5_rate * 100,
            "Q5減Q1_百分點": (q5_rate - q1_rate) * 100,
            "Q5對Q1勝算比": odds_ratio, "Q1Q5_p值": fisher_p,
        })
    table5 = pd.crosstab(usable["強度層"], usable[target]).reindex(BUCKET_LABELS, fill_value=0)
    if table5.shape[1] == 2 and (table5.sum(axis=1) >= minimum_group_size).all():
        chi2, p_value, _, _ = chi2_contingency(table5)
        cramers_v = math.sqrt(chi2 / len(usable))
        result.update({"五層差異p值": p_value, "五層效果量": cramers_v})
    return result


def build_ranking(detail: pd.DataFrame, settings: Settings) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    dates = pd.to_datetime(detail["結果日"]).dt.date
    discovery_mask = dates < settings.split_date
    for (category, signal), signal_data in detail.groupby(["指標類別", "指標代碼"], sort=False):
        signal_dates = pd.to_datetime(signal_data["結果日"]).dt.date
        parts = {
            "全期": signal_data,
            "探索期": signal_data[signal_dates < settings.split_date],
            "驗證期": signal_data[signal_dates >= settings.split_date],
        }
        for target in TARGETS:
            row: dict[str, Any] = {"指標類別": category, "指標代碼": signal, "研究目標": target}
            for period, group in parts.items():
                stats = _period_stats(group, target, settings.minimum_group_size)
                row.update({f"{period}_{key}": value for key, value in stats.items()})
            rows.append(row)
    ranking = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if ranking.empty:
        return ranking
    for p_column, q_column in (
        ("全期_趨勢p值", "全期_趨勢q值"),
        ("全期_Q1Q5_p值", "全期_Q1Q5_q值"),
        ("全期_五層差異p值", "全期_五層差異q值"),
        ("探索期_趨勢p值", "探索期_趨勢q值"),
        ("探索期_Q1Q5_p值", "探索期_Q1Q5_q值"),
    ):
        ranking[q_column] = _bh_adjust(ranking[p_column]) if p_column in ranking else math.nan
    ranking["前後期趨勢同方向"] = (
        np.sign(ranking["探索期_趨勢效果"]) == np.sign(ranking["驗證期_趨勢效果"])
    )
    ranking["前後期極端差同方向"] = (
        np.sign(ranking["探索期_Q5減Q1_百分點"]) == np.sign(ranking["驗證期_Q5減Q1_百分點"])
    )
    ranking["全期任一FDR顯著"] = (
        ranking[["全期_趨勢q值", "全期_Q1Q5_q值", "全期_五層差異q值"]]
        .lt(settings.alpha).any(axis=1)
    )
    return ranking


def build_yearly(detail: pd.DataFrame, settings: Settings) -> pd.DataFrame:
    work = detail.copy()
    work["年"] = pd.to_datetime(work["結果日"]).dt.year
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for (category, signal, year), group in work.groupby(["指標類別", "指標代碼", "年"], sort=True):
        for target in TARGETS:
            stats = _period_stats(group, target, max(5, settings.minimum_group_size // 4))
            if stats.get("樣本數", 0) >= settings.minimum_year_size:
                rows.append({
                    "指標類別": category, "指標代碼": signal, "年": int(year),
                    "研究目標": target, **stats,
                })
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def add_yearly_consistency(ranking: pd.DataFrame, yearly: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if ranking.empty:
        return ranking
    result = ranking.copy()
    info: list[tuple[int, int, float]] = []
    for row in result.itertuples(index=False):
        expected = np.sign(getattr(row, "全期_趨勢效果", math.nan))
        group = yearly[(yearly["指標代碼"] == row.指標代碼) & (yearly["研究目標"] == row.研究目標)]
        signs = np.sign(pd.to_numeric(group.get("趨勢效果"), errors="coerce").dropna())
        signs = signs[signs != 0]
        matches = int((signs == expected).sum()) if np.isfinite(expected) and expected != 0 else 0
        info.append((len(signs), matches, matches / len(signs) if len(signs) else math.nan))
    result[["可比較年度數", "同方向年度數", "年度趨勢一致率"]] = pd.DataFrame(info, index=result.index)
    trend_pass = (
        result["前後期趨勢同方向"]
        & result["驗證期_趨勢p值"].lt(0.10)
    )
    extreme_pass = (
        result["前後期極端差同方向"]
        & result["驗證期_Q1Q5_p值"].lt(0.10)
    )
    result["第一階段候選"] = (
        result["全期任一FDR顯著"]
        & (trend_pass | extreme_pass)
        & result["年度趨勢一致率"].ge(0.60)
    )
    return result.sort_values(
        ["第一階段候選", "全期任一FDR顯著", "全期_五層差異q值", "全期_趨勢q值"],
        ascending=[False, False, True, True], na_position="last",
    ).reset_index(drop=True)


def export_results(
    detail: pd.DataFrame,
    distribution: pd.DataFrame,
    buckets: pd.DataFrame,
    ranking: pd.DataFrame,
    yearly: pd.DataFrame,
    metadata: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    settings: Settings,
    output_dir: Path,
) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    suffix = f"{settings.start:%Y%m%d}_{settings.end:%Y%m%d}" if settings.end else f"{settings.start:%Y%m%d}_latest"
    paths = (
        output_dir / f"amplitude_feature_distribution_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"amplitude_feature_buckets_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"amplitude_feature_ranking_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"amplitude_feature_yearly_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"amplitude_feature_detail_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"amplitude_feature_manifest_{suffix}.json",
    )
    for frame, path in zip((distribution, buckets, ranking, yearly, detail), paths[:5]):
        frame.to_csv(path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    paths[5].write_text(json.dumps({
        "analysis_name": ANALYSIS_NAME,
        "metric_version": METRIC_VERSION,
        "run_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
        "settings": {**asdict(settings), "start": settings.start.isoformat(),
                     "end": settings.end.isoformat() if settings.end else None,
                     "split_date": settings.split_date.isoformat()},
        "source_view": SOURCE_VIEW,
        "target_view": TARGET_VIEW,
        "targets": TARGETS,
        "features": metadata,
        "rules": {
            "feature_bucket": "各指標只與此前最多252筆歷史比較後切五分位，不使用未來資料",
            "discovery": f"結果日早於{settings.split_date.isoformat()}",
            "validation": f"結果日起於{settings.split_date.isoformat()}",
            "multiple_testing": "同一輸出的全部特徵與目標使用BH-FDR校正",
            "candidate": "全期任一檢定FDR<0.05、探索驗證同方向、驗證p<0.10、年度方向一致率>=60%",
        },
        "warnings": [
            "第一階段只掃描單因子，不代表因果或可直接交易",
            "理想單邊多空事件數較少，必須特別重視年度穩定性",
            "第二階段才測最多兩項特徵的組合，避免樣本快速縮小",
        ],
    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str), encoding="utf-8")
    return paths


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="全部交易日劇烈振幅與理想路徑的第一階段單因子分析")
    parser.add_argument("--start", type=date.fromisoformat, default=date(2018, 1, 1))
    parser.add_argument("--end", type=date.fromisoformat)
    parser.add_argument("--split-date", type=date.fromisoformat, default=date(2023, 1, 1))
    parser.add_argument("--futures-id", default="TX")
    parser.add_argument("--history-window", type=int, default=252)
    parser.add_argument("--minimum-history", type=int, default=60)
    parser.add_argument("--minimum-group-size", type=int, default=20)
    parser.add_argument("--minimum-year-size", type=int, default=80)
    parser.add_argument("--alpha", type=float, default=0.05)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-dir", type=Path,
        default=Path("../output/analysis/futures_daily_amplitude_feature_scan"),
    )
    return parser.parse_args()


def main() -> None:
    args = parse_args()
    settings = Settings(
        start=args.start, end=args.end, futures_id=args.futures_id,
        split_date=args.split_date, history_window=args.history_window,
        minimum_history=args.minimum_history, minimum_group_size=args.minimum_group_size,
        minimum_year_size=args.minimum_year_size, alpha=args.alpha,
    )
    settings.validate()
    source = load_source(settings)
    targets = load_targets(settings)
    detail, metadata = prepare_detail(source, targets, settings)
    distribution = build_target_distribution(targets)
    buckets = build_bucket_summary(detail)
    ranking = build_ranking(detail, settings)
    yearly = build_yearly(detail, settings)
    ranking = add_yearly_consistency(ranking, yearly)
    paths = export_results(detail, distribution, buckets, ranking, yearly, metadata, settings, args.output_dir)
    print(f"有效目標交易日：{len(targets):,} 日")
    print(f"單因子：{len(metadata)} 項")
    print(f"特徵明細：{len(detail):,} 筆")
    print(f"全期任一FDR顯著：{int(ranking['全期任一FDR顯著'].sum()) if len(ranking) else 0} 組")
    print(f"第一階段候選：{int(ranking['第一階段候選'].sum()) if len(ranking) else 0} 組")
    print("\n輸出：")
    for path in paths:
        print(path.resolve())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import uuid
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from datetime import date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact

from analysis.futures_daily_amplitude_feature_scan import (
    EXTRA_SOURCE_COLUMNS,
    SOURCE_VIEW,
    Settings as FeatureSettings,
    load_targets,
    prepare_detail,
)
from backtest.futures_raw_signal_strength_scan import (
    SOURCE_COLUMNS,
    _rolling_percentile,
    _safe_ratio,
    _strength_bucket,
)
from backtest.futures_strategy_next_day_field_scan import _bh_adjust


ANALYSIS_NAME = "futures_daily_amplitude_foreign_flow_scan"
METRIC_VERSION = "1.0.0"
TARGET = "劇烈以上"
STOCK_SOURCE_TABLE = "core.stock_report_daily"
STOCK_SYMBOL = "TAIEX"
FOREIGN_COLUMN = "買超_外資_億"
TURNOVER_COLUMN = "總成交金額_億"
RECENT_RANGE_FEATURE = "近5日日盤振幅_前30日比"
NIGHT_RANGE_FEATURE = "夜盤振幅_前30日比"
BASE_RULE_NAME = "近期振幅＋夜盤振幅皆為Q5"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Settings:
    start: date = date(2018, 1, 1)
    end: date | None = None
    futures_id: str = "TX"
    split_date: date = date(2023, 1, 1)
    history_window: int = 252
    minimum_history: int = 60
    foreign_days: int = 3
    lower_percentile: float = 20.0
    upper_percentile: float = 80.0
    minimum_rule_sample: int = 20
    minimum_year_rule_sample: int = 5
    alpha: float = 0.05

    def validate(self) -> None:
        if self.end and self.end < self.start:
            raise ValueError("end 不可早於 start")
        if self.split_date <= self.start:
            raise ValueError("split_date 必須晚於 start")
        if self.history_window < 60:
            raise ValueError("history_window 至少為60")
        if not 20 <= self.minimum_history <= self.history_window:
            raise ValueError("minimum_history 必須介於20與history_window之間")
        if self.foreign_days < 2:
            raise ValueError("foreign_days 至少為2")
        if not 0 < self.lower_percentile < self.upper_percentile < 100:
            raise ValueError("外資分位門檻必須依序介於0與100之間")
        if self.minimum_rule_sample < 10:
            raise ValueError("minimum_rule_sample 至少為10")
        if self.minimum_year_rule_sample < 3:
            raise ValueError("minimum_year_rule_sample 至少為3")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Rule:
    rule_id: str
    name: str
    foreign_side: str
    require_base_rule: bool


def build_rules(settings: Settings) -> list[Rule]:
    days = settings.foreign_days
    return [
        Rule("F01", f"外資{days}日累計大賣Q1", "sell", False),
        Rule("F02", f"外資{days}日累計大買Q5", "buy", False),
        Rule("F03", f"主規則＋外資{days}日累計大賣Q1", "sell", True),
        Rule("F04", f"主規則＋外資{days}日累計大買Q5", "buy", True),
    ]


def _build_source_query(settings: Settings) -> tuple[str, tuple[Any, ...]]:
    query_start = settings.start - timedelta(days=max(400, settings.history_window * 2))
    futures_columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys((
        *SOURCE_COLUMNS,
        *EXTRA_SOURCE_COLUMNS,
    )))
    selected = ", ".join(f'f."{column}"' for column in futures_columns)
    sql = f'''SELECT f.futures_id, {selected},
                     stock."{FOREIGN_COLUMN}" AS "{FOREIGN_COLUMN}",
                     stock."{TURNOVER_COLUMN}" AS "{TURNOVER_COLUMN}"
              FROM {SOURCE_VIEW} AS f
              LEFT JOIN {STOCK_SOURCE_TABLE} AS stock
                ON stock."日期" = f."日期"
               AND stock."股票代號" = '{STOCK_SYMBOL}'
              WHERE f.futures_id = ? AND f."日期" >= ?'''
    params: list[Any] = [settings.futures_id, query_start]
    if settings.end:
        sql += ' AND f."日期" <= ?'
        params.append(settings.end)
    sql += ' ORDER BY f."日期"'
    return sql, tuple(params)


def load_source_with_foreign(settings: Settings) -> pd.DataFrame:
    from common import db

    settings.validate()
    sql, params = _build_source_query(settings)
    try:
        return db.sql_to_df(sql, params=params, parse_dates=["日期"])
    except Exception as exc:
        message = str(exc)
        if FOREIGN_COLUMN in message or TURNOVER_COLUMN in message or "does not exist" in message:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"{STOCK_SOURCE_TABLE} 的 {STOCK_SYMBOL} 資料必須包含"
                f"「{FOREIGN_COLUMN}」與「{TURNOVER_COLUMN}」欄位"
            ) from exc
        raise


def build_foreign_feature(source: pd.DataFrame, settings: Settings) -> pd.DataFrame:
    ordered = source.sort_values("日期").reset_index(drop=True).copy()
    foreign = pd.to_numeric(ordered[FOREIGN_COLUMN], errors="coerce")
    turnover = pd.to_numeric(ordered[TURNOVER_COLUMN], errors="coerce")
    foreign_sum = foreign.rolling(settings.foreign_days, min_periods=settings.foreign_days).sum()
    turnover_sum = turnover.rolling(settings.foreign_days, min_periods=settings.foreign_days).sum()
    ratio = _safe_ratio(foreign_sum, turnover_sum) * 100.0
    percentile = _rolling_percentile(ratio, settings.history_window, settings.minimum_history)

    buy_days = foreign.gt(0).rolling(settings.foreign_days, min_periods=settings.foreign_days).sum()
    sell_days = foreign.lt(0).rolling(settings.foreign_days, min_periods=settings.foreign_days).sum()
    return pd.DataFrame({
        "訊號日": pd.to_datetime(ordered["日期"]),
        "外資單日買賣超_億": foreign,
        f"外資{settings.foreign_days}日累計買賣超_億": foreign_sum,
        f"市場{settings.foreign_days}日累計成交金額_億": turnover_sum,
        f"外資{settings.foreign_days}日累計買賣超率_pct": ratio,
        "外資歷史分位_pct": percentile,
        "外資強度層": _strength_bucket(percentile),
        f"近{settings.foreign_days}日買超天數": buy_days,
        f"近{settings.foreign_days}日賣超天數": sell_days,
        f"連續{settings.foreign_days}日買超": buy_days.eq(settings.foreign_days),
        f"連續{settings.foreign_days}日賣超": sell_days.eq(settings.foreign_days),
    })


def prepare_model_frame(
    feature_detail: pd.DataFrame,
    foreign_feature: pd.DataFrame,
    settings: Settings,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    base_columns = ["訊號日", "結果日", "range_ratio", TARGET]
    selected = feature_detail[
        feature_detail["指標代碼"].isin([RECENT_RANGE_FEATURE, NIGHT_RANGE_FEATURE])
    ].copy()
    base = (
        selected[selected["指標代碼"] == RECENT_RANGE_FEATURE][base_columns]
        .drop_duplicates(subset=["結果日"])
        .copy()
    )
    for feature in (RECENT_RANGE_FEATURE, NIGHT_RANGE_FEATURE):
        part = (
            selected[selected["指標代碼"] == feature]
            [["結果日", "原始值", "歷史分位_pct", "強度層"]]
            .drop_duplicates(subset=["結果日"])
            .rename(columns={
                "原始值": f"{feature}_原始值",
                "歷史分位_pct": f"{feature}_歷史分位_pct",
                "強度層": f"{feature}_強度層",
            })
        )
        base = base.merge(part, on="結果日", how="left", validate="one_to_one")
    base["訊號日"] = pd.to_datetime(base["訊號日"])
    base["結果日"] = pd.to_datetime(base["結果日"])
    base = base.merge(foreign_feature, on="訊號日", how="left", validate="many_to_one")
    base[TARGET] = pd.to_numeric(base[TARGET], errors="coerce")
    base["主規則符合"] = (
        base[f"{RECENT_RANGE_FEATURE}_歷史分位_pct"].ge(80.0)
        & base[f"{NIGHT_RANGE_FEATURE}_歷史分位_pct"].ge(80.0)
    )
    start_ts = pd.Timestamp(settings.start)
    end_ts = pd.Timestamp(settings.end or date.today())
    base = base[base["結果日"].between(start_ts, end_ts)].copy()
    return base.sort_values("結果日").reset_index(drop=True)


def _wilson_interval(events: int, count: int, z: float = 1.959963984540054) -> tuple[float, float]:
    if count <= 0:
        return math.nan, math.nan
    rate = events / count
    denominator = 1.0 + z * z / count
    centre = (rate + z * z / (2.0 * count)) / denominator
    margin = z * math.sqrt(rate * (1.0 - rate) / count + z * z / (4.0 * count * count)) / denominator
    return max(0.0, centre - margin), min(1.0, centre + margin)


def _rule_masks(data: pd.DataFrame, rule: Rule, settings: Settings) -> tuple[pd.Series, pd.Series, pd.Series]:
    eligible = data["外資歷史分位_pct"].notna() & data[TARGET].notna()
    foreign_match = (
        data["外資歷史分位_pct"].le(settings.lower_percentile)
        if rule.foreign_side == "sell"
        else data["外資歷史分位_pct"].ge(settings.upper_percentile)
    )
    reference = eligible & (data["主規則符合"] if rule.require_base_rule else True)
    matched = reference & foreign_match
    return eligible, reference, matched


def _rate(events: int, count: int) -> float:
    return events / count if count else math.nan


def _period_stats(data: pd.DataFrame, rule: Rule, settings: Settings) -> dict[str, Any]:
    eligible, reference, matched = _rule_masks(data, rule, settings)
    universe = data[eligible]
    reference_group = data[reference]
    hit = data[matched]
    reference_miss = data[reference & ~matched]

    universe_count = len(universe)
    universe_events = int(universe[TARGET].sum()) if universe_count else 0
    reference_count = len(reference_group)
    reference_events = int(reference_group[TARGET].sum()) if reference_count else 0
    match_count = len(hit)
    match_events = int(hit[TARGET].sum()) if match_count else 0
    universe_rate = _rate(universe_events, universe_count)
    reference_rate = _rate(reference_events, reference_count)
    match_rate = _rate(match_events, match_count)
    low_ci, high_ci = _wilson_interval(match_events, match_count)

    odds_ratio = math.nan
    p_value = math.nan
    if match_count and len(reference_miss) and reference_group[TARGET].nunique() == 2:
        miss_events = int(reference_miss[TARGET].sum())
        table = [
            [match_events, match_count - match_events],
            [miss_events, len(reference_miss) - miss_events],
        ]
        odds_ratio, p_value = fisher_exact(table, alternative="two-sided")

    return {
        "母體數": universe_count,
        "母體事件數": universe_events,
        "母體事件率_pct": universe_rate * 100 if np.isfinite(universe_rate) else math.nan,
        "參考組": BASE_RULE_NAME if rule.require_base_rule else "全部可判定日",
        "參考組數": reference_count,
        "參考組事件數": reference_events,
        "參考組事件率_pct": reference_rate * 100 if np.isfinite(reference_rate) else math.nan,
        "符合數": match_count,
        "事件數": match_events,
        "事件率_pct": match_rate * 100 if np.isfinite(match_rate) else math.nan,
        "事件率95CI下限_pct": low_ci * 100 if np.isfinite(low_ci) else math.nan,
        "事件率95CI上限_pct": high_ci * 100 if np.isfinite(high_ci) else math.nan,
        "相對母體Lift": match_rate / universe_rate if np.isfinite(match_rate) and universe_rate > 0 else math.nan,
        "相對參考組Lift": match_rate / reference_rate if np.isfinite(match_rate) and reference_rate > 0 else math.nan,
        "相對參考組增減_百分點": (
            (match_rate - reference_rate) * 100
            if np.isfinite(match_rate) and np.isfinite(reference_rate) else math.nan
        ),
        "占母體_pct": match_count / universe_count * 100 if universe_count else math.nan,
        "占參考組_pct": match_count / reference_count * 100 if reference_count else math.nan,
        "符合對參考組其餘勝算比": odds_ratio,
        "增量Fisher_p值": p_value,
        "符合日平均振幅倍數": hit["range_ratio"].mean() if match_count else math.nan,
    }


def build_yearly(frame: pd.DataFrame, rules: list[Rule], settings: Settings) -> pd.DataFrame:
    work = frame.copy()
    work["年"] = work["結果日"].dt.year
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for rule in rules:
        for year, group in work.groupby("年", sort=True):
            stats = _period_stats(group, rule, settings)
            rows.append({
                "規則代碼": rule.rule_id,
                "規則名稱": rule.name,
                "外資方向": "大賣" if rule.foreign_side == "sell" else "大買",
                "加入主規則": rule.require_base_rule,
                "年": int(year),
                **stats,
                "年度樣本足夠": stats["符合數"] >= settings.minimum_year_rule_sample,
            })
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def build_summary(
    frame: pd.DataFrame,
    rules: list[Rule],
    yearly: pd.DataFrame,
    settings: Settings,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    result_dates = frame["結果日"].dt.date
    periods = {
        "全期": frame,
        "探索期": frame[result_dates < settings.split_date],
        "驗證期": frame[result_dates >= settings.split_date],
    }
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for rule in rules:
        row: dict[str, Any] = {
            "規則代碼": rule.rule_id,
            "規則名稱": rule.name,
            "外資方向": "大賣" if rule.foreign_side == "sell" else "大買",
            "加入主規則": rule.require_base_rule,
        }
        for period, group in periods.items():
            stats = _period_stats(group, rule, settings)
            row.update({f"{period}_{key}": value for key, value in stats.items()})
        rows.append(row)
    summary = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    summary["全期_增量Fisher_q值"] = _bh_adjust(summary["全期_增量Fisher_p值"])

    annual_info: list[tuple[int, int, float]] = []
    for rule in rules:
        group = yearly[(yearly["規則代碼"] == rule.rule_id) & yearly["年度樣本足夠"]]
        comparable = group.dropna(subset=["相對參考組Lift"])
        positive = int(comparable["相對參考組Lift"].gt(1.0).sum())
        annual_info.append((
            len(comparable),
            positive,
            positive / len(comparable) if len(comparable) else math.nan,
        ))
    summary[["可比較年度數", "優於參考組年度數", "年度正向率"]] = pd.DataFrame(annual_info, index=summary.index)
    summary["探索驗證皆優於參考組"] = (
        summary["探索期_相對參考組Lift"].gt(1.0)
        & summary["驗證期_相對參考組Lift"].gt(1.0)
    )
    summary["外資增量候選"] = (
        summary["全期_增量Fisher_q值"].lt(settings.alpha)
        & summary["探索驗證皆優於參考組"]
        & summary["驗證期_增量Fisher_p值"].lt(0.10)
        & summary["驗證期_符合數"].ge(settings.minimum_rule_sample)
        & summary["年度正向率"].ge(0.60)
    )
    return summary.sort_values(
        ["外資增量候選", "驗證期_相對參考組Lift", "驗證期_符合數"],
        ascending=[False, False, False],
        na_position="last",
    ).reset_index(drop=True)


def build_rule_detail(frame: pd.DataFrame, rules: list[Rule], settings: Settings) -> pd.DataFrame:
    foreign_columns = [
        "外資單日買賣超_億",
        f"外資{settings.foreign_days}日累計買賣超_億",
        f"市場{settings.foreign_days}日累計成交金額_億",
        f"外資{settings.foreign_days}日累計買賣超率_pct",
        "外資歷史分位_pct",
        "外資強度層",
        f"近{settings.foreign_days}日買超天數",
        f"近{settings.foreign_days}日賣超天數",
        f"連續{settings.foreign_days}日買超",
        f"連續{settings.foreign_days}日賣超",
    ]
    base_columns = ["訊號日", "結果日", "range_ratio", TARGET, "主規則符合", *foreign_columns]
    parts: list[pd.DataFrame] = []
    for rule in rules:
        eligible, reference, matched = _rule_masks(frame, rule, settings)
        part = frame[base_columns].copy()
        part["規則代碼"] = rule.rule_id
        part["規則名稱"] = rule.name
        part["可判定"] = eligible
        part["屬於參考組"] = reference
        part["符合條件"] = matched
        parts.append(part)
    return pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True)


def export_results(
    frame: pd.DataFrame,
    summary: pd.DataFrame,
    yearly: pd.DataFrame,
    rule_detail: pd.DataFrame,
    rules: list[Rule],
    settings: Settings,
    output_dir: Path,
) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    suffix = f"{settings.start:%Y%m%d}_{settings.end:%Y%m%d}" if settings.end else f"{settings.start:%Y%m%d}_latest"
    paths = (
        output_dir / f"violent_amplitude_foreign_flow_summary_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"violent_amplitude_foreign_flow_yearly_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"violent_amplitude_foreign_flow_detail_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"violent_amplitude_foreign_flow_manifest_{suffix}.json",
    )
    summary.to_csv(paths[0], index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    yearly.to_csv(paths[1], index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    rule_detail.to_csv(paths[2], index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    paths[3].write_text(json.dumps({
        "analysis_name": ANALYSIS_NAME,
        "metric_version": METRIC_VERSION,
        "run_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
        "settings": {
            **asdict(settings),
            "start": settings.start.isoformat(),
            "end": settings.end.isoformat() if settings.end else None,
            "split_date": settings.split_date.isoformat(),
        },
        "source_view": SOURCE_VIEW,
        "foreign_source_table": STOCK_SOURCE_TABLE,
        "foreign_source_symbol": STOCK_SYMBOL,
        "source_columns": {
            "foreign_net_buy_sell": FOREIGN_COLUMN,
            "market_turnover": TURNOVER_COLUMN,
        },
        "foreign_feature_formula": (
            f"近{settings.foreign_days}日外資買賣超合計／"
            f"近{settings.foreign_days}日市場成交金額合計×100"
        ),
        "base_rule": BASE_RULE_NAME,
        "rules": [asdict(rule) for rule in rules],
        "candidate_rule": (
            "全期增量Fisher檢定BH-FDR q<0.05、探索與驗證相對參考組Lift皆>1、"
            "驗證期增量Fisher p<0.10、驗證期符合數達門檻、年度正向率>=60%"
        ),
        "warnings": [
            "本程式只研究隔日日盤是否劇烈以上，不區分多空與交易損益",
            "F03/F04的參考組是近期振幅與夜盤振幅皆Q5，增量檢定不是與全部交易日比較",
            "外資買賣可能同時受到行情影響，本結果代表關聯而非因果",
            "明細保留連續買賣天數，主規則仍以3日累計買賣超率的歷史分位判定",
        ],
    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str), encoding="utf-8")
    return paths


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="外資3日累計買賣超與隔日日盤劇烈振幅統計")
    parser.add_argument("--start", type=date.fromisoformat, default=date(2018, 1, 1))
    parser.add_argument("--end", type=date.fromisoformat)
    parser.add_argument("--split-date", type=date.fromisoformat, default=date(2023, 1, 1))
    parser.add_argument("--futures-id", default="TX")
    parser.add_argument("--history-window", type=int, default=252)
    parser.add_argument("--minimum-history", type=int, default=60)
    parser.add_argument("--foreign-days", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--lower-percentile", type=float, default=20.0)
    parser.add_argument("--upper-percentile", type=float, default=80.0)
    parser.add_argument("--minimum-rule-sample", type=int, default=20)
    parser.add_argument("--minimum-year-rule-sample", type=int, default=5)
    parser.add_argument("--alpha", type=float, default=0.05)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-dir",
        type=Path,
        default=Path("../output/analysis/futures_daily_amplitude_foreign_flow_scan"),
    )
    return parser.parse_args()


def main() -> None:
    args = parse_args()
    settings = Settings(
        start=args.start,
        end=args.end,
        futures_id=args.futures_id,
        split_date=args.split_date,
        history_window=args.history_window,
        minimum_history=args.minimum_history,
        foreign_days=args.foreign_days,
        lower_percentile=args.lower_percentile,
        upper_percentile=args.upper_percentile,
        minimum_rule_sample=args.minimum_rule_sample,
        minimum_year_rule_sample=args.minimum_year_rule_sample,
        alpha=args.alpha,
    )
    settings.validate()
    feature_settings = FeatureSettings(
        start=settings.start,
        end=settings.end,
        futures_id=settings.futures_id,
        split_date=settings.split_date,
        history_window=settings.history_window,
        minimum_history=settings.minimum_history,
    )
    source = load_source_with_foreign(settings)
    targets = load_targets(feature_settings)
    feature_detail, _ = prepare_detail(source, targets, feature_settings)
    foreign_feature = build_foreign_feature(source, settings)
    frame = prepare_model_frame(feature_detail, foreign_feature, settings)
    rules = build_rules(settings)
    yearly = build_yearly(frame, rules, settings)
    summary = build_summary(frame, rules, yearly, settings)
    rule_detail = build_rule_detail(frame, rules, settings)
    paths = export_results(frame, summary, yearly, rule_detail, rules, settings, args.output_dir)

    baseline = frame[TARGET].mean() * 100
    base_days = frame[frame["主規則符合"] & frame[TARGET].notna()]
    base_rate = base_days[TARGET].mean() * 100 if len(base_days) else math.nan
    print(f"有效研究日：{len(frame):,} 日")
    print(f"劇烈以上母體率：{baseline:.2f}%")
    print(f"主規則：{len(base_days):,} 日，劇烈率 {base_rate:.2f}%")
    print(f"外資規則：{len(rules)} 組")
    print(f"外資增量候選：{int(summary['外資增量候選'].sum())} 組")
    display = [
        "規則代碼", "規則名稱", "驗證期_參考組數", "驗證期_參考組事件率_pct",
        "驗證期_符合數", "驗證期_事件率_pct", "驗證期_相對參考組Lift",
        "驗證期_增量Fisher_p值", "外資增量候選",
    ]
    print("\n驗證期結果：")
    print(summary[display].to_string(index=False))
    print("\n輸出：")
    for path in paths:
        print(path.resolve())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, time, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


RULE_VERSION = "1.0.0"
SOURCE_RELATION = "raw_finmind.fm_taiwan_futures_kbar_1m"
TARGET_TABLE = "research.futures_daily_amplitude_pattern"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Settings:
    start: date = date(2018, 1, 1)
    end: date | None = None
    futures_id: str = "TX"
    session_start: time = time(8, 45)
    session_end: time = time(13, 45)
    first_window_minutes: int = 30
    minimum_bars: int = 290
    range_days: int = 30
    low_range_threshold: float = 0.75
    expanded_range_threshold: float = 1.25
    violent_range_threshold: float = 1.50
    extreme_range_threshold: float = 2.00
    biased_share_threshold: float = 0.65
    strong_share_threshold: float = 0.80

    def validate(self) -> None:
        if self.end is not None and self.end < self.start:
            raise ValueError("end 不可早於 start")
        if not 2 <= self.range_days <= 252:
            raise ValueError("range_days 必須介於 2 到 252")
        if not (
            0 < self.low_range_threshold < self.expanded_range_threshold
            < self.violent_range_threshold < self.extreme_range_threshold
        ):
            raise ValueError("振幅門檻必須依序遞增")
        if not 0.5 < self.biased_share_threshold < self.strong_share_threshold < 1:
            raise ValueError("方向占比門檻必須符合 0.5 < biased < strong < 1")
        if self.first_window_minutes <= 0:
            raise ValueError("first_window_minutes 必須大於 0")


def load_bars(settings: Settings) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """讀取全部交易日的日盤一分K，並固定每個交易日使用最前月完整契約。"""
    from common import db

    settings.validate()
    history_start = settings.start - timedelta(days=max(90, settings.range_days * 4))
    end = settings.end or date.today()
    sql = """
        WITH contract_stats AS (
            SELECT
                trading_date,
                contract_date,
                COUNT(*) AS bar_count,
                MIN(bar_datetime) AS first_at,
                MAX(bar_datetime) AS last_at,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trading_date
                    ORDER BY
                        CASE
                            WHEN MIN(bar_datetime)::time <= (?::time + INTERVAL '1 minute')
                             AND MAX(bar_datetime)::time >= (?::time - INTERVAL '1 minute')
                            THEN 0 ELSE 1
                        END,
                        contract_date
                ) AS contract_rank
            FROM raw_finmind.fm_taiwan_futures_kbar_1m
            WHERE futures_id = ?
              AND trading_session = 'position'
              AND contract_date ~ '^[0-9]{6}$'
              AND trading_date BETWEEN ? AND ?
              AND bar_datetime::time BETWEEN ? AND ?
            GROUP BY trading_date, contract_date
        ), chosen AS (
            SELECT trading_date, contract_date
            FROM contract_stats
            WHERE contract_rank = 1
        )
        SELECT
            k.trading_date,
            k.contract_date,
            k.bar_datetime,
            k.open,
            k.high,
            k.low,
            k.close,
            k.volume
        FROM raw_finmind.fm_taiwan_futures_kbar_1m k
        JOIN chosen c
          ON c.trading_date = k.trading_date
         AND c.contract_date = k.contract_date
        WHERE k.futures_id = ?
          AND k.trading_session = 'position'
          AND k.bar_datetime::time BETWEEN ? AND ?
        ORDER BY k.trading_date, k.bar_datetime
    """
    return db.sql_to_df(
        sql,
        params=(
            settings.session_start, settings.session_end, settings.futures_id,
            history_start, end, settings.session_start, settings.session_end,
            settings.futures_id, settings.session_start, settings.session_end,
        ),
        parse_dates=["trading_date", "bar_datetime"],
    )


def _amplitude_label(ratio: float | None, settings: Settings) -> str | None:
    if ratio is None or pd.isna(ratio):
        return None
    if ratio < settings.low_range_threshold:
        return "低振幅"
    if ratio < settings.expanded_range_threshold:
        return "一般振幅"
    if ratio < settings.violent_range_threshold:
        return "明顯放大"
    if ratio < settings.extreme_range_threshold:
        return "劇烈振幅"
    return "極端振幅"


def _excursion_bias(up_share: float | None, settings: Settings) -> str:
    if up_share is None or pd.isna(up_share):
        return "無法判定"
    if up_share >= settings.strong_share_threshold:
        return "強上行集中"
    if up_share >= settings.biased_share_threshold:
        return "上行集中"
    if up_share <= 1.0 - settings.strong_share_threshold:
        return "強下行集中"
    if up_share <= 1.0 - settings.biased_share_threshold:
        return "下行集中"
    return "上下均衡"


def _path_pattern(
    up_share: float | None,
    close_location: float | None,
    extreme_order: str,
    settings: Settings,
) -> str:
    if up_share is None or close_location is None or pd.isna(up_share) or pd.isna(close_location):
        return "無法判定"
    down_share = 1.0 - up_share
    if up_share >= settings.strong_share_threshold and close_location >= 0.75:
        return "強單邊多"
    if down_share >= settings.strong_share_threshold and close_location <= 0.25:
        return "強單邊空"
    if up_share >= settings.biased_share_threshold:
        if close_location <= 0.45:
            return "先拉後殺"
        return "偏多震盪"
    if down_share >= settings.biased_share_threshold:
        if close_location >= 0.55:
            return "先殺後拉"
        return "偏空震盪"
    if extreme_order == "LOW_FIRST" and close_location >= 0.65:
        return "先殺後拉"
    if extreme_order == "HIGH_FIRST" and close_location <= 0.35:
        return "先拉後殺"
    return "上下雙向震盪"


def _daily_row(group: pd.DataFrame, settings: Settings) -> dict[str, Any]:
    bars = group.sort_values("bar_datetime").reset_index(drop=True)
    first = bars.iloc[0]
    last = bars.iloc[-1]
    day_high = float(bars["high"].max())
    day_low = float(bars["low"].min())
    day_open = float(first["open"])
    day_close = float(last["close"])
    range_points = day_high - day_low
    high_bars = bars[bars["high"].eq(day_high)]
    low_bars = bars[bars["low"].eq(day_low)]
    first_high_at = pd.Timestamp(high_bars.iloc[0]["bar_datetime"])
    last_high_at = pd.Timestamp(high_bars.iloc[-1]["bar_datetime"])
    first_low_at = pd.Timestamp(low_bars.iloc[0]["bar_datetime"])
    last_low_at = pd.Timestamp(low_bars.iloc[-1]["bar_datetime"])
    if last_low_at < last_high_at:
        extreme_order = "LOW_FIRST"
        session_trend = "漲勢盤"
    elif last_high_at < last_low_at:
        extreme_order = "HIGH_FIRST"
        session_trend = "跌勢盤"
    else:
        extreme_order = "SAME_BAR"
        session_trend = "同K極值"

    up_excursion = day_high - day_open
    down_excursion = day_open - day_low
    up_share = up_excursion / range_points if range_points > 0 else np.nan
    down_share = down_excursion / range_points if range_points > 0 else np.nan
    close_location = (day_close - day_low) / range_points if range_points > 0 else np.nan
    window_end = (
        pd.Timestamp.combine(pd.Timestamp(first["trading_date"]).date(), settings.session_start)
        + pd.Timedelta(minutes=settings.first_window_minutes)
    )
    opening = bars[bars["bar_datetime"] < window_end]
    if opening.empty:
        first_30m_high = first_30m_low = first_30m_close = first_30m_range = np.nan
    else:
        first_30m_high = float(opening["high"].max())
        first_30m_low = float(opening["low"].min())
        first_30m_close = float(opening.iloc[-1]["close"])
        first_30m_range = first_30m_high - first_30m_low
    first_30m_share = first_30m_range / range_points if range_points > 0 else np.nan

    first_at = pd.Timestamp(first["bar_datetime"])
    last_at = pd.Timestamp(last["bar_datetime"])
    expected_start = pd.Timestamp.combine(first_at.date(), settings.session_start)
    expected_end = pd.Timestamp.combine(first_at.date(), settings.session_end)
    complete = bool(
        len(bars) >= settings.minimum_bars
        and first_at <= expected_start + pd.Timedelta(minutes=1)
        and last_at >= expected_end - pd.Timedelta(minutes=1)
    )
    return {
        "futures_id": settings.futures_id,
        "trading_date": pd.Timestamp(first["trading_date"]).date(),
        "contract_date": str(first["contract_date"]),
        "rule_version": RULE_VERSION,
        "source_first_at": first_at,
        "source_last_at": last_at,
        "bar_count": int(len(bars)),
        "session_complete": complete,
        "day_open": day_open,
        "day_high": day_high,
        "day_low": day_low,
        "day_close": day_close,
        "day_volume": int(pd.to_numeric(bars["volume"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).sum()),
        "range_points": range_points,
        "up_excursion_points": up_excursion,
        "down_excursion_points": down_excursion,
        "up_share": up_share,
        "down_share": down_share,
        "open_close_points": day_close - day_open,
        "close_location": close_location,
        "first_high_at": first_high_at,
        "last_high_at": last_high_at,
        "first_low_at": first_low_at,
        "last_low_at": last_low_at,
        "extreme_order": extreme_order,
        "session_trend_label": session_trend,
        "first_30m_high": first_30m_high,
        "first_30m_low": first_30m_low,
        "first_30m_close": first_30m_close,
        "first_30m_range_points": first_30m_range,
        "first_30m_range_share": first_30m_share,
    }


def build_daily_patterns(bars: pd.DataFrame, settings: Settings) -> pd.DataFrame:
    settings.validate()
    if bars.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    required = {
        "trading_date", "contract_date", "bar_datetime", "open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"
    }
    missing = sorted(required.difference(bars.columns))
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"一分K缺少欄位：{', '.join(missing)}")
    source = bars.copy()
    source["trading_date"] = pd.to_datetime(source["trading_date"])
    source["bar_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(source["bar_datetime"])
    rows = [_daily_row(group, settings) for _, group in source.groupby("trading_date", sort=True)]
    daily = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("trading_date").reset_index(drop=True)
    complete_range = daily["range_points"].where(daily["session_complete"])
    daily["average_range_previous"] = (
        complete_range.shift(1).rolling(settings.range_days, min_periods=settings.range_days).mean()
    )
    daily["range_ratio"] = daily["range_points"] / daily["average_range_previous"]
    daily["valid_for_research"] = (
        daily["session_complete"]
        & daily["average_range_previous"].notna()
        & daily["range_points"].gt(0)
    )
    daily["amplitude_label"] = daily["range_ratio"].map(lambda value: _amplitude_label(value, settings))
    daily["excursion_bias_label"] = daily["up_share"].map(lambda value: _excursion_bias(value, settings))
    daily["path_pattern_label"] = daily.apply(
        lambda row: _path_pattern(row["up_share"], row["close_location"], row["extreme_order"], settings),
        axis=1,
    )
    daily.loc[~daily["session_complete"], ["amplitude_label", "excursion_bias_label", "path_pattern_label"]] = [
        None, "資料不完整", "資料不完整"
    ]
    daily["auto_label"] = daily.apply(
        lambda row: (
            f"{row['amplitude_label']}｜{row['path_pattern_label']}"
            if row["amplitude_label"] is not None else None
        ),
        axis=1,
    )
    daily["range_days"] = settings.range_days
    daily["low_range_threshold"] = settings.low_range_threshold
    daily["expanded_range_threshold"] = settings.expanded_range_threshold
    daily["violent_range_threshold"] = settings.violent_range_threshold
    daily["extreme_range_threshold"] = settings.extreme_range_threshold
    daily["biased_share_threshold"] = settings.biased_share_threshold
    daily["strong_share_threshold"] = settings.strong_share_threshold
    start = settings.start
    end = settings.end or date.max
    return daily[daily["trading_date"].between(start, end)].reset_index(drop=True)


DB_COLUMNS = [
    "futures_id", "trading_date", "contract_date", "rule_version",
    "source_first_at", "source_last_at", "bar_count", "session_complete", "valid_for_research",
    "day_open", "day_high", "day_low", "day_close", "day_volume", "range_points",
    "average_range_previous", "range_ratio", "up_excursion_points", "down_excursion_points",
    "up_share", "down_share", "open_close_points", "close_location",
    "first_high_at", "last_high_at", "first_low_at", "last_low_at",
    "extreme_order", "session_trend_label",
    "first_30m_high", "first_30m_low", "first_30m_close",
    "first_30m_range_points", "first_30m_range_share",
    "amplitude_label", "excursion_bias_label", "path_pattern_label", "auto_label",
    "range_days", "low_range_threshold", "expanded_range_threshold",
    "violent_range_threshold", "extreme_range_threshold",
    "biased_share_threshold", "strong_share_threshold",
]


def _db_value(value: Any) -> Any:
    if value is None or value is pd.NA or value is pd.NaT:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, np.generic):
        value = value.item()
    if isinstance(value, pd.Timestamp):
        return value.to_pydatetime()
    try:
        return None if bool(pd.isna(value)) else value
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return value


def save_to_database(daily: pd.DataFrame) -> int:
    """Upsert 自動計算欄位；刻意不更新 manual_* 與 manually_reviewed_at。"""
    from common.db import get_connection

    if daily.empty:
        return 0
    missing = [column for column in DB_COLUMNS if column not in daily.columns]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"入庫資料缺少欄位：{', '.join(missing)}")
    update_columns = [column for column in DB_COLUMNS if column not in ("futures_id", "trading_date")]
    sql = f"""
        INSERT INTO {TARGET_TABLE} ({', '.join(DB_COLUMNS)})
        VALUES ({', '.join(['%s'] * len(DB_COLUMNS))})
        ON CONFLICT (futures_id, trading_date) DO UPDATE SET
            {', '.join(f'{column} = EXCLUDED.{column}' for column in update_columns)},
            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    """
    rows = [
        tuple(_db_value(value) for value in row)
        for row in daily[DB_COLUMNS].itertuples(index=False, name=None)
    ]
    with get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute("SELECT to_regclass(%s)", (TARGET_TABLE,))
            if cursor.fetchone()[0] is None:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "尚未建立逐日振幅型態表；請先執行 "
                    "db_migrate/20261105_add_futures_daily_amplitude_pattern.sql"
                )
            cursor.executemany(sql, rows)
        conn.commit()
    return len(rows)


def export_csv(daily: pd.DataFrame, output_dir: Path, settings: Settings) -> Path:
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    end_text = settings.end.strftime("%Y%m%d") if settings.end else "latest"
    path = output_dir / f"daily_amplitude_pattern_{settings.start:%Y%m%d}_{end_text}.csv"
    daily.to_csv(path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    return path


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="建立全部交易日的日盤振幅與盤中路徑標籤")
    parser.add_argument("--start", type=date.fromisoformat, default=date(2018, 1, 1))
    parser.add_argument("--end", type=date.fromisoformat)
    parser.add_argument("--futures-id", default="TX")
    parser.add_argument("--range-days", type=int, default=30)
    parser.add_argument("--minimum-bars", type=int, default=290)
    parser.add_argument("--low-range-threshold", type=float, default=0.75)
    parser.add_argument("--expanded-range-threshold", type=float, default=1.25)
    parser.add_argument("--violent-range-threshold", type=float, default=1.50)
    parser.add_argument("--extreme-range-threshold", type=float, default=2.00)
    parser.add_argument("--biased-share-threshold", type=float, default=0.65)
    parser.add_argument("--strong-share-threshold", type=float, default=0.80)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-dir", type=Path,
        default=Path("../output/analysis/futures_daily_amplitude_pattern"),
    )
    parser.add_argument("--save-db", action="store_true")
    return parser.parse_args()


def main() -> None:
    args = parse_args()
    settings = Settings(
        start=args.start,
        end=args.end,
        futures_id=args.futures_id,
        range_days=args.range_days,
        minimum_bars=args.minimum_bars,
        low_range_threshold=args.low_range_threshold,
        expanded_range_threshold=args.expanded_range_threshold,
        violent_range_threshold=args.violent_range_threshold,
        extreme_range_threshold=args.extreme_range_threshold,
        biased_share_threshold=args.biased_share_threshold,
        strong_share_threshold=args.strong_share_threshold,
    )
    bars = load_bars(settings)
    daily = build_daily_patterns(bars, settings)
    path = export_csv(daily, args.output_dir, settings)
    saved = save_to_database(daily) if args.save_db else 0
    print(f"全部交易日：{len(daily):,} 日")
    print(f"有效研究樣本：{int(daily['valid_for_research'].sum()) if not daily.empty else 0:,} 日")
    print(f"資料庫保存：{saved:,} 日" if args.save_db else "資料庫保存：未啟用（加 --save-db）")
    print(f"CSV：{path.resolve()}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import itertools
import json
import math
import uuid
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact

from analysis.futures_daily_amplitude_feature_scan import (
    Settings as FeatureSettings,
    load_source,
    load_targets,
    prepare_detail,
)
from backtest.futures_strategy_next_day_field_scan import _bh_adjust


ANALYSIS_NAME = "futures_daily_amplitude_violent_combo_scan"
METRIC_VERSION = "1.0.0"
TARGET = "劇烈以上"
CORE_FEATURES = {
    "近5日日盤振幅_前30日比": "近期振幅",
    "夜盤振幅_前30日比": "夜盤振幅",
    "夜成交量_前20日比": "夜盤成交量",
}
THRESHOLDS = {
    "Q4以上": 60.0,
    "Q5": 80.0,
}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Settings:
    start: date = date(2018, 1, 1)
    end: date | None = None
    futures_id: str = "TX"
    split_date: date = date(2023, 1, 1)
    history_window: int = 252
    minimum_history: int = 60
    minimum_rule_sample: int = 20
    minimum_year_rule_sample: int = 8
    alpha: float = 0.05

    def validate(self) -> None:
        if self.end and self.end < self.start:
            raise ValueError("end 不可早於 start")
        if self.split_date <= self.start:
            raise ValueError("split_date 必須晚於 start")
        if self.history_window < 60:
            raise ValueError("history_window 至少為60")
        if not 20 <= self.minimum_history <= self.history_window:
            raise ValueError("minimum_history 必須介於20與history_window之間")
        if self.minimum_rule_sample < 10:
            raise ValueError("minimum_rule_sample 至少為10")
        if self.minimum_year_rule_sample < 3:
            raise ValueError("minimum_year_rule_sample 至少為3")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Rule:
    rule_id: str
    threshold_label: str
    threshold_pct: float
    features: tuple[str, ...]

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        names = [CORE_FEATURES[feature] for feature in self.features]
        return "＋".join(names) + f"皆為{self.threshold_label}"


def build_rules() -> list[Rule]:
    rules: list[Rule] = []
    feature_names = tuple(CORE_FEATURES)
    counter = 1
    for threshold_label, threshold_pct in THRESHOLDS.items():
        for size in range(1, len(feature_names) + 1):
            for features in itertools.combinations(feature_names, size):
                rules.append(Rule(
                    rule_id=f"R{counter:02d}",
                    threshold_label=threshold_label,
                    threshold_pct=threshold_pct,
                    features=features,
                ))
                counter += 1
    return rules


def prepare_model_frame(detail: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    base_columns = ["訊號日", "結果日", "range_ratio", TARGET]
    selected = detail[detail["指標代碼"].isin(CORE_FEATURES)].copy()
    if selected.empty:
        raise ValueError("找不到三項核心振幅特徵")

    first_feature = next(iter(CORE_FEATURES))
    base = (
        selected[selected["指標代碼"] == first_feature][base_columns]
        .drop_duplicates(subset=["結果日"])
        .copy()
    )
    for feature in CORE_FEATURES:
        part = (
            selected[selected["指標代碼"] == feature]
            [["結果日", "原始值", "歷史分位_pct", "強度層"]]
            .drop_duplicates(subset=["結果日"])
            .rename(columns={
                "原始值": f"{feature}_原始值",
                "歷史分位_pct": f"{feature}_歷史分位_pct",
                "強度層": f"{feature}_強度層",
            })
        )
        base = base.merge(part, on="結果日", how="left", validate="one_to_one")
    base["訊號日"] = pd.to_datetime(base["訊號日"])
    base["結果日"] = pd.to_datetime(base["結果日"])
    base[TARGET] = pd.to_numeric(base[TARGET], errors="coerce")
    return base.sort_values("結果日").reset_index(drop=True)


def _wilson_interval(events: int, count: int, z: float = 1.959963984540054) -> tuple[float, float]:
    if count <= 0:
        return math.nan, math.nan
    rate = events / count
    denominator = 1.0 + z * z / count
    centre = (rate + z * z / (2.0 * count)) / denominator
    margin = z * math.sqrt(rate * (1.0 - rate) / count + z * z / (4.0 * count * count)) / denominator
    return max(0.0, centre - margin), min(1.0, centre + margin)


def _rule_masks(data: pd.DataFrame, rule: Rule) -> tuple[pd.Series, pd.Series]:
    percentile_columns = [f"{feature}_歷史分位_pct" for feature in rule.features]
    eligible = data[percentile_columns].notna().all(axis=1) & data[TARGET].notna()
    matched = eligible & data[percentile_columns].ge(rule.threshold_pct).all(axis=1)
    return eligible, matched


def _period_stats(data: pd.DataFrame, rule: Rule) -> dict[str, Any]:
    eligible, matched = _rule_masks(data, rule)
    universe = data[eligible]
    hit = data[matched]
    miss = data[eligible & ~matched]
    total_count = len(universe)
    total_events = int(universe[TARGET].sum()) if total_count else 0
    match_count = len(hit)
    match_events = int(hit[TARGET].sum()) if match_count else 0
    baseline = total_events / total_count if total_count else math.nan
    rate = match_events / match_count if match_count else math.nan
    miss_rate = miss[TARGET].mean() if len(miss) else math.nan
    low_ci, high_ci = _wilson_interval(match_events, match_count)
    p_value = math.nan
    odds_ratio = math.nan
    if match_count and len(miss) and universe[TARGET].nunique() == 2:
        table = [
            [match_events, match_count - match_events],
            [int(miss[TARGET].sum()), int(len(miss) - miss[TARGET].sum())],
        ]
        odds_ratio, p_value = fisher_exact(table, alternative="two-sided")
    return {
        "母體數": total_count,
        "母體事件數": total_events,
        "母體事件率_pct": baseline * 100 if np.isfinite(baseline) else math.nan,
        "符合數": match_count,
        "事件數": match_events,
        "事件率_pct": rate * 100 if np.isfinite(rate) else math.nan,
        "事件率95CI下限_pct": low_ci * 100 if np.isfinite(low_ci) else math.nan,
        "事件率95CI上限_pct": high_ci * 100 if np.isfinite(high_ci) else math.nan,
        "未符合事件率_pct": miss_rate * 100 if np.isfinite(miss_rate) else math.nan,
        "Lift": rate / baseline if np.isfinite(rate) and baseline > 0 else math.nan,
        "相對母體增減_百分點": (rate - baseline) * 100 if np.isfinite(rate) and np.isfinite(baseline) else math.nan,
        "覆蓋率_pct": match_count / total_count * 100 if total_count else math.nan,
        "符合對未符合勝算比": odds_ratio,
        "Fisher_p值": p_value,
        "符合日平均振幅倍數": hit["range_ratio"].mean() if match_count else math.nan,
    }


def build_yearly(frame: pd.DataFrame, rules: list[Rule], settings: Settings) -> pd.DataFrame:
    work = frame.copy()
    work["年"] = work["結果日"].dt.year
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for rule in rules:
        for year, group in work.groupby("年", sort=True):
            stats = _period_stats(group, rule)
            rows.append({
                "規則代碼": rule.rule_id,
                "規則名稱": rule.name,
                "門檻": rule.threshold_label,
                "條件數": len(rule.features),
                "年": int(year),
                **stats,
                "年度樣本足夠": stats["符合數"] >= settings.minimum_year_rule_sample,
            })
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def build_summary(
    frame: pd.DataFrame,
    rules: list[Rule],
    yearly: pd.DataFrame,
    settings: Settings,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    result_dates = frame["結果日"].dt.date
    periods = {
        "全期": frame,
        "探索期": frame[result_dates < settings.split_date],
        "驗證期": frame[result_dates >= settings.split_date],
    }
    for rule in rules:
        row: dict[str, Any] = {
            "規則代碼": rule.rule_id,
            "規則名稱": rule.name,
            "門檻": rule.threshold_label,
            "歷史分位門檻_pct": rule.threshold_pct,
            "條件數": len(rule.features),
            "使用指標": "｜".join(rule.features),
        }
        for period, group in periods.items():
            stats = _period_stats(group, rule)
            row.update({f"{period}_{key}": value for key, value in stats.items()})
        rows.append(row)
    summary = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    summary["全期_Fisher_q值"] = _bh_adjust(summary["全期_Fisher_p值"])

    annual_info: list[tuple[int, int, float]] = []
    for rule in rules:
        group = yearly[(yearly["規則代碼"] == rule.rule_id) & yearly["年度樣本足夠"]]
        comparable = group.dropna(subset=["Lift"])
        positive = int(comparable["Lift"].gt(1.0).sum())
        annual_info.append((
            len(comparable),
            positive,
            positive / len(comparable) if len(comparable) else math.nan,
        ))
    summary[["可比較年度數", "Lift大於1年度數", "年度正向率"]] = pd.DataFrame(annual_info, index=summary.index)
    summary["探索驗證皆高於母體"] = (
        summary["探索期_Lift"].gt(1.0) & summary["驗證期_Lift"].gt(1.0)
    )
    summary["簡化候選"] = (
        summary["全期_Fisher_q值"].lt(settings.alpha)
        & summary["探索驗證皆高於母體"]
        & summary["驗證期_Fisher_p值"].lt(0.10)
        & summary["驗證期_符合數"].ge(settings.minimum_rule_sample)
        & summary["年度正向率"].ge(0.60)
    )
    return summary.sort_values(
        ["簡化候選", "驗證期_事件率_pct", "驗證期_符合數"],
        ascending=[False, False, False],
        na_position="last",
    ).reset_index(drop=True)


def build_rule_detail(frame: pd.DataFrame, rules: list[Rule]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    parts: list[pd.DataFrame] = []
    base_columns = ["訊號日", "結果日", "range_ratio", TARGET]
    for rule in rules:
        eligible, matched = _rule_masks(frame, rule)
        part = frame[base_columns].copy()
        part["規則代碼"] = rule.rule_id
        part["規則名稱"] = rule.name
        part["門檻"] = rule.threshold_label
        part["條件數"] = len(rule.features)
        part["使用指標"] = "｜".join(rule.features)
        part["可判定"] = eligible
        part["符合條件"] = matched
        parts.append(part)
    return pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True)


def export_results(
    frame: pd.DataFrame,
    summary: pd.DataFrame,
    yearly: pd.DataFrame,
    rule_detail: pd.DataFrame,
    rules: list[Rule],
    settings: Settings,
    output_dir: Path,
) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    suffix = f"{settings.start:%Y%m%d}_{settings.end:%Y%m%d}" if settings.end else f"{settings.start:%Y%m%d}_latest"
    paths = (
        output_dir / f"violent_amplitude_combo_summary_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"violent_amplitude_combo_yearly_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"violent_amplitude_combo_detail_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"violent_amplitude_combo_manifest_{suffix}.json",
    )
    summary.to_csv(paths[0], index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    yearly.to_csv(paths[1], index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    rule_detail.to_csv(paths[2], index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    paths[3].write_text(json.dumps({
        "analysis_name": ANALYSIS_NAME,
        "metric_version": METRIC_VERSION,
        "run_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
        "settings": {
            **asdict(settings),
            "start": settings.start.isoformat(),
            "end": settings.end.isoformat() if settings.end else None,
            "split_date": settings.split_date.isoformat(),
        },
        "target": {TARGET: "振幅標籤為劇烈振幅或極端振幅"},
        "features": CORE_FEATURES,
        "thresholds": THRESHOLDS,
        "rules": [{
            "rule_id": rule.rule_id,
            "name": rule.name,
            "threshold": rule.threshold_label,
            "threshold_pct": rule.threshold_pct,
            "features": list(rule.features),
        } for rule in rules],
        "candidate_rule": (
            "全期Fisher檢定BH-FDR q<0.05、探索與驗證Lift皆>1、"
            "驗證期Fisher p<0.10、驗證期符合數達門檻、年度正向率>=60%"
        ),
        "warnings": [
            "本程式只研究隔日日盤是否劇烈以上，不區分多空或單邊型態",
            "這是條件機率分析，不是含進出場、成本與損益的交易回測",
            "三項特徵可能高度相關，組合Lift必須搭配樣本數與驗證期一起看",
        ],
    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str), encoding="utf-8")
    return paths


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="隔日日盤劇烈振幅：三項核心前置特徵組合統計")
    parser.add_argument("--start", type=date.fromisoformat, default=date(2018, 1, 1))
    parser.add_argument("--end", type=date.fromisoformat)
    parser.add_argument("--split-date", type=date.fromisoformat, default=date(2023, 1, 1))
    parser.add_argument("--futures-id", default="TX")
    parser.add_argument("--history-window", type=int, default=252)
    parser.add_argument("--minimum-history", type=int, default=60)
    parser.add_argument("--minimum-rule-sample", type=int, default=20)
    parser.add_argument("--minimum-year-rule-sample", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--alpha", type=float, default=0.05)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-dir",
        type=Path,
        default=Path("../output/analysis/futures_daily_amplitude_violent_combo_scan"),
    )
    return parser.parse_args()


def main() -> None:
    args = parse_args()
    settings = Settings(
        start=args.start,
        end=args.end,
        futures_id=args.futures_id,
        split_date=args.split_date,
        history_window=args.history_window,
        minimum_history=args.minimum_history,
        minimum_rule_sample=args.minimum_rule_sample,
        minimum_year_rule_sample=args.minimum_year_rule_sample,
        alpha=args.alpha,
    )
    settings.validate()
    feature_settings = FeatureSettings(
        start=settings.start,
        end=settings.end,
        futures_id=settings.futures_id,
        split_date=settings.split_date,
        history_window=settings.history_window,
        minimum_history=settings.minimum_history,
    )
    source = load_source(feature_settings)
    targets = load_targets(feature_settings)
    feature_detail, _ = prepare_detail(source, targets, feature_settings)
    frame = prepare_model_frame(feature_detail)
    rules = build_rules()
    yearly = build_yearly(frame, rules, settings)
    summary = build_summary(frame, rules, yearly, settings)
    rule_detail = build_rule_detail(frame, rules)
    paths = export_results(frame, summary, yearly, rule_detail, rules, settings, args.output_dir)

    baseline = frame[TARGET].mean() * 100
    print(f"有效研究日：{len(frame):,} 日")
    print(f"劇烈以上：{int(frame[TARGET].sum()):,} 日（{baseline:.2f}%）")
    print(f"組合規則：{len(rules)} 組")
    print(f"簡化候選：{int(summary['簡化候選'].sum())} 組")
    display_columns = ["規則代碼", "規則名稱", "驗證期_符合數", "驗證期_事件率_pct", "驗證期_Lift", "簡化候選"]
    print("\n驗證期事件率最高：")
    print(summary[display_columns].head(10).to_string(index=False))
    print("\n輸出：")
    for path in paths:
        print(path.resolve())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
