"""Local historical simulation. All fills use the exact TX tick selected by replay.
No broker connection. Other products are hypothetical TX-price scenarios.
"""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from uuid import UUID
from dashboard import replay_service as replay

D = Decimal
PRODUCTS = {'TX': 200, 'MTX': 50, 'TMF': 10}
TAX = D('0.00002')
DEFAULT_FEES = {'TX': D(50), 'MTX': D(30), 'TMF': D(15)}


def dec(value):
    return D(str(value))


def money(value):
    return dec(value).quantize(D('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)


def costs(entry, exit, direction, qty, fees, tax_rate=TAX):
    """Round estimated tax per contract/side to NTD; fees are per contract/side."""
    entry, exit = dec(entry), dec(exit)
    points = (exit-entry)*(1 if direction == 'LONG' else -1)
    result = {}
    for product, multiplier in PRODUCTS.items():
        fee = money(dec(fees[product])*2*qty)
        tax = sum((p*multiplier*dec(tax_rate)).quantize(D('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP) for p in (entry,exit))*qty
        gross = money(points*multiplier*qty)
        result[product] = dict(points=points, gross=gross, fee=fee, tax=tax, net=gross-fee-tax)
    return result


def slipped(price, direction, slippage, closing=False):
    sign = (1 if direction=='LONG' else -1)*(-1 if closing else 1)
    return dec(price)+sign*slippage


def triggered(kind, direction, target, price, trigger_direction=None):
    if kind == "MARKET": return True
    price, target = dec(price), dec(target)
    if kind == 'LIMIT': return price<=target if direction=='LONG' else price>=target
    if kind == 'STOP': return price>=target if (trigger_direction or ('ABOVE' if direction=='LONG' else 'BELOW'))=='ABOVE' else price<=target
    return True


def normalize_tif(kind, tif=None):
    tif = tif or ('ROD' if kind == 'LIMIT' else 'IOC')
    if tif not in ('ROD','IOC','FOK') or (kind != 'LIMIT' and tif == 'ROD'):
        raise ValueError('市價及觸價市價僅支援 IOC 或 FOK')
    return tif


def initial_order_decision(kind, direction, target, price, tif, trigger_direction=None):
    # No order book: an eligible tick fills all requested lots in this model.
    # STOP is a conditional order; TIF applies only after activation.
    if kind == 'MARKET' or triggered(kind, direction, target, price, trigger_direction):
        return 'FILL'
    if kind == 'STOP' or tif == 'ROD':
        return 'WAIT'
    return 'CANCEL'


def cancel_pending(cur, order_id, clock, wall, reason):
    cur.execute("UPDATE paper_trade.orders SET status='CANCELLED',cancelled_at=%s,cancelled_client_at=%s,cancel_reason=%s WHERE id=%s AND status='PENDING'",(clock,wall,reason,order_id))


def expire_run_orders(cur, run, clock, wall):
    if clock >= run['end_at']:
        cur.execute("UPDATE paper_trade.orders SET status='CANCELLED',cancelled_at=%s,cancelled_client_at=%s,cancel_reason=%s WHERE run_id=%s AND status='PENDING'",(run['end_at'],wall,'回放時段結束',run['id']))


def exit_trigger(order, price):
    p=dec(price); long=order['direction']=='LONG'
    stop, take=order['stop_loss'],order['take_profit']
    if stop is not None and (p<=stop if long else p>=stop): return 'STOP_LOSS'
    if take is not None and (p>=take if long else p<=take): return 'TAKE_PROFIT'
    return None


def bracket_valid(direction, reference, stop, take):
    ref=dec(reference); long=direction=='LONG'
    if stop is not None and not (dec(stop)<ref if long else dec(stop)>ref): raise ValueError('停損須在預計進場價的虧損方向')
    if take is not None and not (dec(take)>ref if long else dec(take)<ref): raise ValueError('停利須在預計進場價的獲利方向')


def connection():
    from common import db
    return db.get_connection()


def cursor(conn):
    from psycopg.rows import dict_row
    return conn.cursor(row_factory=dict_row)


def one(cur, sql, args=()):
    cur.execute(sql,args); return cur.fetchone()


def many(cur, sql, args=()):
    cur.execute(sql,args); return cur.fetchall()


def require(row, label):
    if not row: raise ValueError(label+'不存在')
    return row


def client_time(value):
    try: t=datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace('Z','+00:00'))
    except (ValueError,AttributeError): raise ValueError('無效的電腦時間')
    if t.tzinfo is None: raise ValueError('電腦時間必須包含時區')
    return t


def account_values(data):
    name=data['name'].strip()
    if not 1<=len(name)<=80: raise ValueError('帳號名稱須為 1–80 字')
    return (name,data['initial_equity'],data['fee_tx'],data['fee_mtx'],data['fee_tmf'],data['slippage'])


def accounts():
    with connection() as conn, cursor(conn) as cur:
        return many(cur,'SELECT * FROM paper_trade.accounts ORDER BY id')


def save_account(data, account_id=None):
    args=account_values(data)
    with connection() as conn, cursor(conn) as cur:
        if account_id is None:
            row=one(cur,'''INSERT INTO paper_trade.accounts(name,initial_equity,fee_tx,fee_mtx,fee_tmf,slippage)
                VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) ON CONFLICT(name) DO NOTHING RETURNING *''',args)
        else:
            row=one(cur,'''UPDATE paper_trade.accounts SET name=%s,initial_equity=%s,fee_tx=%s,fee_mtx=%s,fee_tmf=%s,slippage=%s
                WHERE id=%s RETURNING *''',(*args,account_id))
        if not row: raise ValueError('帳號已存在或不存在')
        conn.commit(); return row


def run_list(account_id, market=None, contract=None, start=None, end=None):
    with connection() as conn, cursor(conn) as cur:
        if market is None: return many(cur,'SELECT * FROM paper_trade.runs WHERE account_id=%s ORDER BY id DESC',(account_id,))
        a,b=replay.parse_time(start),replay.parse_time(end)
        return many(cur,'''SELECT * FROM paper_trade.runs WHERE account_id=%s AND market=%s AND contract=%s AND start_at=%s AND end_at=%s ORDER BY id DESC''',(account_id,market,contract,a,b))


def create_run(data):
    market,contract=data['market'],data['contract']; a,b=replay.parse_time(data['start']),replay.parse_time(data['end'])
    if market not in ('tx_day','tx_night'): raise ValueError('只支援 TX 逐筆回放')
    replay.validate(market,'TAIEX',contract,5); replay.validate_range(market,a,b)
    with connection() as conn, cursor(conn) as cur:
        require(one(cur,'SELECT id FROM paper_trade.accounts WHERE id=%s',(data['account_id'],)),'帳號')
        run=one(cur,'''INSERT INTO paper_trade.runs(account_id,market,contract,start_at,end_at) VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) RETURNING *''',(data['account_id'],market,contract,a,b))
        conn.commit(); return run


def tick_key(t): return (t['trade_datetime'],t['source_row_no'],t['id'])

def run_key(r): return None if r['cursor_id'] is None else (r['cursor_time'],r['cursor_row'],r['cursor_id'])


def get_tick(cur, run, tick_id):
    # Exact row, not the last tick of a second. IDs are strings in JSON to avoid JS precision loss.
    try: tid=int(tick_id)
    except (ValueError,TypeError): raise ValueError('沒有可成交的逐筆行情')
    t=one(cur,'''SELECT id,trade_datetime,source_row_no,price FROM raw_finmind.fm_taiwan_futures_tick
        WHERE id=%s AND futures_id='TX' AND contract_date=%s AND trade_datetime >= %s AND trade_datetime <= %s''',
        (tid,run['contract'],run['start_at'],run['end_at']))
    if not t: raise ValueError('此回放區間的成交資料不存在（原始資料可能已重新匯入，請建立新場次）')
    if not dec(t['price']).is_finite() or dec(t['price'])<=0: raise ValueError('原始成交價無效')
    return t


def lock_run(cur, run_id): return require(one(cur,'SELECT * FROM paper_trade.runs WHERE id=%s FOR UPDATE',(run_id,)),'回放交易場次')


def opposite_positions(cur, order):
    return many(cur, TRADE_SELECT+" WHERE o.run_id=%s AND o.product=%s AND o.direction<>%s AND t.exit_time IS NULL ORDER BY t.entry_time,t.id", (order['run_id'],order['product'],order['direction']))


def allocation_plan(positions, quantity, effect):
    """FIFO allocation, with no new exposure for CLOSE."""
    if effect == 'OPEN': return [], quantity
    available=sum(p['quantity'] for p in positions)
    if effect == 'CLOSE' and available < quantity: raise ValueError('可平倉口數不足；平倉不會反向開新倉')
    remaining=quantity; parts=[]
    for p in positions:
        if not remaining: break
        q=min(remaining,p['quantity']); parts.append((p,q)); remaining-=q
    return parts, remaining


def fill(cur, order, tick, wall, limit=False):
    effect=order.get('position_effect','OPEN')
    positions=opposite_positions(cur,order) if effect!='OPEN' else []
    try: parts, remaining=allocation_plan(positions,order['quantity'],effect)
    except ValueError:
        # A resting close may become invalid after another exit. Cancel instead of opening exposure.
        cur.execute("UPDATE paper_trade.orders SET status='CANCELLED',cancelled_at=%s,cancelled_client_at=%s,cancel_reason=%s WHERE id=%s",(tick['trade_datetime'],wall,'可平倉口數不足',order['id']))
        return
    price=dec(tick['price']) if limit else slipped(tick['price'],order['direction'],order['slippage'])
    if price<=0: raise ValueError('模擬成交價格無效')
    for position,qty in parts:
        close_trade(cur,position,tick,wall,'MANUAL',quantity=qty,price=price,exit_order_id=order['id'])
    if remaining:
        cur.execute('''INSERT INTO paper_trade.trades(order_id,entry_time,entry_tick_id,entry_price,entry_raw_price,entry_client_at,position_quantity)
            VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)''',(order['id'],tick['trade_datetime'],tick['id'],price,dec(tick['price']),wall,remaining))
    cur.execute("UPDATE paper_trade.orders SET status='FILLED' WHERE id=%s",(order['id'],))
    if remaining and (order.get('stop_loss') is not None or order.get('take_profit') is not None):
        position=one(cur,TRADE_SELECT+' WHERE t.order_id=%s AND t.exit_time IS NULL',(order['id'],))
        if position:
            why=exit_trigger(position,tick['price'])
            if why: close_trade(cur,position,tick,wall,why)


def close_trade(cur, trade, tick, wall, reason, quantity=None, price=None, exit_order_id=None):
    price=slipped(tick['price'],trade['direction'],trade['slippage'],True) if price is None else dec(price)
    if price<=0: raise ValueError('模擬平倉價格無效')
    qty=trade['quantity'] if quantity is None else quantity
    if qty<1 or qty>trade['quantity']: raise ValueError('平倉口數無效')
    trade_id=trade['trade_id']
    if qty<trade['quantity']:
        # Preserve the original open row; create a separate immutable closed slice.
        row=one(cur, '''INSERT INTO paper_trade.trades(order_id,entry_time,entry_tick_id,entry_price,entry_raw_price,entry_client_at,entry_server_at,position_quantity)
            SELECT order_id,entry_time,entry_tick_id,entry_price,entry_raw_price,entry_client_at,entry_server_at,%s FROM paper_trade.trades WHERE id=%s AND exit_time IS NULL RETURNING id''',(qty,trade_id))
        cur.execute('UPDATE paper_trade.trades SET position_quantity=%s WHERE id=%s AND exit_time IS NULL',(trade['quantity']-qty,trade_id))
        trade_id=require(row,'部分平倉交易')['id']
    cur.execute('''UPDATE paper_trade.trades SET exit_time=%s,exit_tick_id=%s,exit_price=%s,exit_raw_price=%s,
        exit_client_at=%s,exit_server_at=now(),exit_reason=%s,exit_order_id=%s WHERE id=%s AND exit_time IS NULL''',
        (tick['trade_datetime'],tick['id'],price,dec(tick['price']),wall,reason,exit_order_id,trade_id))


TRADE_SELECT='''SELECT t.*,t.id AS trade_id,o.run_id,o.product,o.direction,COALESCE(t.position_quantity,o.quantity) AS quantity,o.stop_loss,o.take_profit,
 o.fee_tx,o.fee_mtx,o.fee_tmf,o.slippage,o.tax_rate,o.order_type,o.target,o.submitted_at,o.submitted_clock_at,o.submitted_client_at,o.submitted_server_at,
 r.account_id,r.market,r.contract,r.start_at,r.end_at FROM paper_trade.trades t JOIN paper_trade.orders o ON o.id=t.order_id JOIN paper_trade.runs r ON r.id=o.run_id'''


def advance(cur, run, tick, wall):
    old=run_key(run); new=tick_key(tick)
    if old is not None and new<old: raise ValueError('目前已倒回已交易時間之前。請回到原進度，或建立新場次重新練習。')
    if old==new: return
    if old is not None:
        # A source-date reimport can replace tick IDs; do not silently resume a changed tape.
        prior=get_tick(cur,run,old[2])
        if tick_key(prior)!=old: raise ValueError('原始行情已變更，請建立新場次。')
    pending=many(cur,"SELECT * FROM paper_trade.orders WHERE run_id=%s AND status='PENDING' ORDER BY id",(run['id'],))
    positions=many(cur,TRADE_SELECT+' WHERE o.run_id=%s AND t.exit_time IS NULL ORDER BY t.id',(run['id'],))
    protective=[p for p in positions if p['stop_loss'] is not None or p['take_profit'] is not None]
    if old is not None and (pending or protective):
        # Process every intermediate trade, even if the chart skipped frames at 300x.
        # Server-side cursor is monotonic and serialized by row lock.
        rows=many(cur,'''SELECT id,trade_datetime,source_row_no,price FROM raw_finmind.fm_taiwan_futures_tick
           WHERE futures_id='TX' AND contract_date=%s AND (trade_datetime,source_row_no,id)>(%s,%s,%s)
           AND (trade_datetime,source_row_no,id)<=(%s,%s,%s) ORDER BY trade_datetime,source_row_no,id''',
           (run['contract'],*old,*new))
        for t in rows:
            if not pending and not protective: break
            for p in protective[:]:
                why=exit_trigger(p,t['price'])
                if why:
                    close_trade(cur,p,t,wall,why); protective.remove(p)
            for o in pending[:]:
                if triggered(o['order_type'],o['direction'],o['target'],t['price'],o.get('trigger_direction')):
                    fill(cur,o,t,wall,o['order_type']=='LIMIT'); pending.remove(o)
                    # Rebuild protection after closing/splitting/opening positions.
                    if o.get('position_effect','OPEN')!='OPEN':
                        protective=many(cur,TRADE_SELECT+' WHERE o.run_id=%s AND t.exit_time IS NULL AND (o.stop_loss IS NOT NULL OR o.take_profit IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY t.id',(run['id'],))
                    elif o['stop_loss'] is not None or o['take_profit'] is not None:
                        p=one(cur,TRADE_SELECT+' WHERE t.order_id=%s AND t.exit_time IS NULL',(o['id'],)); 
                        if p is not None: protective.append(p)
    cur.execute('UPDATE paper_trade.runs SET cursor_time=%s,cursor_row=%s,cursor_id=%s WHERE id=%s',(*new,run['id']))
    run.update(cursor_time=new[0],cursor_row=new[1],cursor_id=new[2])


def fee_map(row): return {p:row['fee_'+p.lower()] for p in PRODUCTS}


def enrich(row, mark=None):
    row=dict(row); price=row['exit_price'] if row['exit_time'] is not None else (slipped(mark,row['direction'],row['slippage'],True) if mark is not None else None)
    if price is not None:
        row['comparison']=costs(row['entry_price'],price,row['direction'],row['quantity'],fee_map(row),row['tax_rate'])
        row['actual']=row['comparison'][row['product']]
    else: row['comparison']=None; row['actual']=None
    row['tick_points']=None if price is None else (dec(price)-row['entry_price'])*(1 if row['direction']=='LONG' else -1)
    return row


def snapshot(cur, run, mark=None):
    trades=many(cur,TRADE_SELECT+' WHERE o.run_id=%s ORDER BY t.id DESC',(run['id'],))
    orders=many(cur,'SELECT * FROM paper_trade.orders WHERE run_id=%s ORDER BY id DESC',(run['id'],))
    # Never expose a later trade's details in an earlier cursor. Caller disallows rewound snapshots.
    return {'run':{**run,'cursor_id':str(run['cursor_id']) if run['cursor_id'] is not None else None},'mark':mark,'trades':[enrich(t,mark) for t in trades], 'orders':orders}


def execute_action(run_id, data):
    wall=client_time(data['client_at']); action=data['action']
    with connection() as conn, cursor(conn) as cur:
        run=lock_run(cur,run_id); tick=get_tick(cur,run,data['tick_id'])
        try: clock=datetime.fromtimestamp(data['clock_ms']/1000,replay.TZ).replace(tzinfo=None)
        except (ValueError,OverflowError,OSError,TypeError): raise ValueError('回放時鐘無效')
        if not run['start_at']<=clock<=run['end_at'] or clock+timedelta(microseconds=1)<tick['trade_datetime']: raise ValueError('回放時鐘與成交時間不一致')
        clock=max(clock,tick['trade_datetime'])
        # A repeat of the same request must not create another order.
        if action=='order':
            request_id=UUID(data['request_id'])
            existing=one(cur,'SELECT id,run_id FROM paper_trade.orders WHERE request_id=%s',(request_id,))
            if existing and existing['run_id']!=run_id: raise ValueError('委託識別碼已被使用')
        advance(cur,run,tick,wall)
        if action=='order' and not existing:
            a=require(one(cur,'SELECT * FROM paper_trade.accounts WHERE id=%s',(run['account_id'],)),'帳號')
            kind=data['order_type']; direction=data['direction']; target=data.get('target'); stop=data.get('stop_loss'); take=data.get('take_profit')
            ref=slipped(tick['price'],direction,a['slippage']) if kind=='MARKET' else target
            if kind!='MARKET' and target is None: raise ValueError('請輸入委託點位')
            if clock >= run['end_at']: raise ValueError('回放時段已結束，不可新增委託')
            tif=normalize_tif(kind,data.get('time_in_force'))
            effect=data.get('position_effect','OPEN')
            if effect=='CLOSE':
                if stop is not None or take is not None: raise ValueError('平倉委託不可附加新倉停損停利')
                allocation_plan(opposite_positions(cur,dict(run_id=run_id,product=data['product'],direction=direction)),data['quantity'],effect)
            else: bracket_valid(direction,ref,stop,take)
            trigger_direction=data.get('trigger_direction') if kind=='STOP' else None
            if kind=='STOP': trigger_direction=trigger_direction or ('ABOVE' if direction=='LONG' else 'BELOW')
            if kind=='MARKET': target=None
            order=one(cur,'''INSERT INTO paper_trade.orders(run_id,request_id,product,direction,quantity,order_type,target,stop_loss,take_profit,position_effect,time_in_force,trigger_direction,status,
              submitted_at,submitted_tick_id,submitted_clock_at,submitted_client_at,fee_tx,fee_mtx,fee_tmf,slippage,tax_rate)
              VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,'PENDING',%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) RETURNING *''',
              (run_id,request_id,data['product'],direction,data['quantity'],kind,target,stop,take,effect,tif,trigger_direction,tick['trade_datetime'],tick['id'],clock,wall,a['fee_tx'],a['fee_mtx'],a['fee_tmf'],a['slippage'],TAX))
            # Market: immediate known tick. Marketable limit/stop: immediate known tick, no queue model.
            decision=initial_order_decision(kind,direction,target,tick['price'],tif,trigger_direction)
            if decision=='FILL': fill(cur,order,tick,wall,kind=='LIMIT')
            elif decision=='CANCEL': cancel_pending(cur,order['id'],clock,wall,tif+'：當下價格不符合限價')
        elif action=='cancel':
            cur.execute("UPDATE paper_trade.orders SET status='CANCELLED',cancelled_at=%s,cancelled_client_at=%s WHERE id=%s AND run_id=%s AND status='PENDING'",(clock,wall,data['item_id'],run_id))
            if not cur.rowcount: raise ValueError('委託已成交、已取消或不存在')
        elif action in ('close','close_all'):
            args=(run_id,) if action=='close_all' else (run_id,data['item_id'])
            trades=many(cur,TRADE_SELECT+' WHERE o.run_id=%s AND t.exit_time IS NULL'+('' if action=='close_all' else ' AND t.id=%s'),args)
            if not trades: raise ValueError('沒有可平倉部位')
            for p in trades: close_trade(cur,p,tick,wall,'MANUAL')
        expire_run_orders(cur,run,clock,wall)
        result=snapshot(cur,run,dec(tick['price'])); conn.commit(); return result


def delete_trade(trade_id):
    with connection() as conn,cursor(conn) as cur:
        row=require(one(cur,TRADE_SELECT+' WHERE t.id=%s',(trade_id,)),'交易')
        lock_run(cur,row['run_id'])
        # Delete only the selected execution slice; sibling lots and order audit survive.
        cur.execute('DELETE FROM paper_trade.trades WHERE id=%s',(trade_id,)); conn.commit(); return {'deleted':trade_id}


def statistics(trades, equity, product=None):
    seq=sorted((t for t in trades if t['exit_time'] is not None),key=lambda t:(t['exit_server_at'],t['id']))
    vals=[t['comparison'][product] if product else t['actual'] for t in seq]
    nets=[v['net'] for v in vals]; wins=[x for x in nets if x>0]; losses=[x for x in nets if x<0]
    total=sum(nets,D(0)); running=dec(equity); peak=running; dd=D(0); curve=[]
    for t,n in zip(seq,nets):
        running+=n; peak=max(peak,running); dd=max(dd,peak-running)
        curve.append({'trade_id':t['id'],'time':t['exit_server_at'],'historical_time':t['exit_time'],'equity':running})
    return {'count':len(vals),'wins':len(wins),'losses':len(losses),'breakeven':len(vals)-len(wins)-len(losses),
        'win_rate':len(wins)/len(vals)*100 if vals else None,'gross':sum((v['gross'] for v in vals),D(0)),
        'fee':sum((v['fee'] for v in vals),D(0)),'tax':sum((v['tax'] for v in vals),D(0)), 'net':total,
        'avg':total/len(vals) if vals else None,'profit_factor':sum(wins)/abs(sum(losses)) if losses else None,
        'max_drawdown':dd,'equity':running,'return_pct':total/dec(equity)*100,'curve':curve}


def performance(account_id, run_id=None):
    with connection() as conn,cursor(conn) as cur:
        a=require(one(cur,'SELECT * FROM paper_trade.accounts WHERE id=%s',(account_id,)),'帳號')
        sql=TRADE_SELECT+' WHERE r.account_id=%s'; args=(account_id,)
        if run_id is not None: sql+=' AND r.id=%s'; args+=(run_id,)
        rows=many(cur,sql+' ORDER BY t.id DESC',args)
        trades=[enrich(t) for t in rows]; equity=a['initial_equity']
        return {'account':a,'trades':trades,'actual':statistics(trades,equity),
                'comparison':{p:statistics(trades,equity,p) for p in PRODUCTS},'open_count':sum(t['exit_time'] is None for t in trades)}

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

import pandas as pd

from common.report_columns import order_futures_report_columns, order_taiex_report_columns


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RawReportConfig:
    name: str
    view: str
    date_column: str = "日期"
    where_sql: str = ""
    where_params: tuple = ()


TAIWAN_RAW_REPORTS = {
    # 讀有日期索引的實體快取，避免每次載入／翻頁都重跑多層策略 View。
    "taiex": RawReportConfig("加權指數報表", "taiex_report_dashboard_cache_v2"),
    # 直接讀有索引的實體結果快取，避免每次載入重跑 corrected View 的
    # 全歷史 LAG 視窗與策略函式。快取由期貨報表更新流程同步。
    "futures": RawReportConfig("台指期報表", "v_futures_dashboard_turning"),
}

US_RAW_REPORTS = {
    "us_ixic": RawReportConfig("NASDAQ 原始資料", "fm_us_stock_daily", "date", "stock_id = ?", ("^IXIC",)),
    "us_sox": RawReportConfig("費城半導體原始資料", "fm_us_stock_daily", "date", "stock_id = ?", ("^SOX",)),
    "us_dji": RawReportConfig("道瓊原始資料", "fm_us_stock_daily", "date", "stock_id = ?", ("^DJI",)),
    "us_gspc": RawReportConfig("S&P 500 原始資料", "fm_us_stock_daily", "date", "stock_id = ?", ("^GSPC",)),
    "us_vix": RawReportConfig("VIX 原始資料", "fm_us_stock_daily", "date", "stock_id = ?", ("^VIX",)),
    "us_tsm": RawReportConfig("TSM ADR 原始資料", "fm_us_stock_daily", "date", "stock_id = ?", ("TSM",)),
}

RAW_REPORTS = {**TAIWAN_RAW_REPORTS, **US_RAW_REPORTS}

PAGE_SIZES = (10, 30, 60, 120, 240)


def _quote_identifier(value: str) -> str:
    return '"' + value.replace('"', '""') + '"'


def _escape_like(value: str) -> str:
    return value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")


def get_report_config(report: str) -> RawReportConfig:
    try:
        return RAW_REPORTS[report]
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise ValueError("不支援的原始資料報表") from exc


def load_raw_report(
    report: str,
    start_date: str | None = None,
    end_date: str | None = None,
    limit: int = 30,
    offset: int = 0,
    sort_column: str | None = None,
    sort_direction: str = "desc",
    search_column: str | None = None,
    search_text: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict]:
    from common import db

    config = get_report_config(report)
    if report == "taiex":
        from module.taiex_report_cache import taiex_dashboard_cache_available
        if not taiex_dashboard_cache_available():
            raise ValueError("加權報表快取尚未初始化；請先按一次「期貨報表更新」並勾選加權報表。")
    if report == "futures" and db.query_single_value("SELECT to_regclass('report.v_futures_dashboard_turning')") is None:
        from module.futures_turning import ensure_turning_views
        ensure_turning_views()
    if limit not in PAGE_SIZES:
        raise ValueError("不支援的顯示筆數")
    if offset < 0:
        raise ValueError("資料位置不可小於零")

    empty_frame = db.query_to_df(f'SELECT * FROM "{config.view}" LIMIT 0')
    columns = list(empty_frame.columns)
    if report == "taiex":
        columns = order_taiex_report_columns(columns)
    elif report == "futures":
        columns = order_futures_report_columns(columns)
    if not columns:
        raise ValueError("報表目前沒有可用欄位")
    sort_column = sort_column or config.date_column
    sort_direction = sort_direction.lower()
    if sort_column not in columns:
        raise ValueError("找不到指定的排序欄位")
    if sort_direction not in {"asc", "desc"}:
        raise ValueError("排序方向只支援 asc 或 desc")
    search_text = (search_text or "").strip()
    if search_text and search_column not in columns:
        raise ValueError("找不到指定的搜尋欄位")

    source_where = f"WHERE {config.where_sql}" if config.where_sql else ""
    bounds = db.query_to_df(
        f'SELECT MIN("{config.date_column}") AS min_date, MAX("{config.date_column}") AS max_date '
        f'FROM "{config.view}" {source_where}',
        config.where_params,
    )
    min_date = pd.Timestamp(bounds.iloc[0]["min_date"]).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    max_date = pd.Timestamp(bounds.iloc[0]["max_date"]).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    start_date = start_date or min_date
    end_date = end_date or max_date
    if pd.Timestamp(start_date) > pd.Timestamp(end_date):
        raise ValueError("開始日期不可晚於結束日期")

    conditions = []
    params: list = []
    if config.where_sql:
        conditions.append(config.where_sql)
        params.extend(config.where_params)
    conditions.append(f'"{config.date_column}" BETWEEN ? AND ?')
    params.extend([start_date, end_date])
    if search_text:
        conditions.append(
            f'CAST({_quote_identifier(search_column)} AS TEXT) ILIKE ? ESCAPE \'\\\''
        )
        params.append(f"%{_escape_like(search_text)}%")
    where = "WHERE " + " AND ".join(conditions)
    total = int(db.query_single_value(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "{config.view}" {where}', params) or 0)
    order_sql = f'{_quote_identifier(sort_column)} {sort_direction.upper()} NULLS LAST'
    if sort_column != config.date_column:
        order_sql += f', "{config.date_column}" DESC'
    select_columns = ", ".join(_quote_identifier(column) for column in columns)
    frame = db.query_to_df(
        f'SELECT {select_columns} FROM "{config.view}" {where} '
        f'ORDER BY {order_sql} LIMIT ? OFFSET ?',
        (*params, limit, offset),
    )
    return frame, {
        "key": report,
        "name": config.name,
        "min_date": min_date,
        "max_date": max_date,
        "start_date": start_date,
        "end_date": end_date,
        "total": total,
        "limit": limit,
        "offset": offset,
        "sort_column": sort_column,
        "sort_direction": sort_direction,
        "search_column": search_column if search_text else "",
        "search_text": search_text,
    }


def export_raw_report(
    report: str,
    start_date: str | None = None,
    end_date: str | None = None,
    columns: list[str] | None = None,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict]:
    from common import db

    config = get_report_config(report)
    if report == "taiex":
        from module.taiex_report_cache import taiex_dashboard_cache_available
        if not taiex_dashboard_cache_available():
            raise ValueError("加權報表快取尚未初始化；請先按一次「期貨報表更新」並勾選加權報表。")
    if report == "futures" and db.query_single_value("SELECT to_regclass('report.v_futures_dashboard_turning')") is None:
        from module.futures_turning import ensure_turning_views
        ensure_turning_views()
    source_where = f"WHERE {config.where_sql}" if config.where_sql else ""
    bounds = db.query_to_df(
        f'SELECT MIN("{config.date_column}") AS min_date, MAX("{config.date_column}") AS max_date '
        f'FROM "{config.view}" {source_where}',
        config.where_params,
    )
    min_date = pd.Timestamp(bounds.iloc[0]["min_date"]).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    max_date = pd.Timestamp(bounds.iloc[0]["max_date"]).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    start_date = start_date or min_date
    end_date = end_date or max_date
    conditions = []
    params: list = []
    if config.where_sql:
        conditions.append(config.where_sql)
        params.extend(config.where_params)
    conditions.append(f'"{config.date_column}" BETWEEN ? AND ?')
    params.extend([start_date, end_date])
    frame = db.query_to_df(
        f'SELECT * FROM "{config.view}" WHERE {" AND ".join(conditions)} '
        f'ORDER BY "{config.date_column}" DESC',
        params,
    )
    if report == "taiex":
        frame = frame.loc[:, order_taiex_report_columns(list(frame.columns))]
    elif report == "futures":
        frame = frame.loc[:, order_futures_report_columns(list(frame.columns))]
    if columns:
        unknown = [column for column in columns if column not in frame.columns]
        if unknown:
            raise ValueError(f"找不到指定欄位：{', '.join(unknown)}")
        frame = frame.loc[:, columns]
    return frame, {
        "key": report,
        "name": config.name,
        "start_date": start_date,
        "end_date": end_date,
    }

"""Historical replay, read-only. All input timestamps are Asia/Taipei wall time."""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, time
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import re

TZ = ZoneInfo('Asia/Taipei')
PERIODS = (1, 5, 15, 30, 60)
MARKETS = ('tx_day', 'tx_night', 'stock')
MAX_CHUNK = 250000


def parse_time(value):
    try:
        t = datetime.fromisoformat(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ValueError('請輸入有效的台北日期時間') from exc
    if t.tzinfo is not None:
        raise ValueError('請使用台北本地時間，不含時區')
    return t


def ms(t):
    return t.replace(tzinfo=TZ).timestamp() * 1000


def validate(market, symbol, contract, period):
    if market not in MARKETS or period not in PERIODS:
        raise ValueError('不支援的市場或週期')
    if market == 'stock':
        if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9]{1,16}', symbol):
            raise ValueError('請輸入有效股票代號或 TAIEX')
    elif not re.fullmatch(r'\d{6}', contract or ''):
        raise ValueError('請指定實際期貨契約月份（YYYYMM）')


def session_bounds(market, anchor):
    day = anchor.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
    if market == 'tx_night':
        if anchor.hour < 6:
            day -= timedelta(days=1)
        return day + timedelta(hours=15), day + timedelta(days=1, hours=5, minutes=1)
    if market == 'tx_day':
        return day + timedelta(hours=8, minutes=45), day + timedelta(hours=13, minutes=46)
    return day + timedelta(hours=9), day + timedelta(hours=13, minutes=31)


def bucket(t, market, period):
    origin, _ = session_bounds(market, t)
    return origin + timedelta(minutes=(int((t-origin).total_seconds()//60)//period)*period)


def validate_range(market, start, end):
    left, right = session_bounds(market, start)
    if not left <= start < end <= right:
        raise ValueError('起訖時間必須位於同一交易時段；夜盤請使用實際日曆日期（可跨午夜）')


def _query(sql, args):
    from common import db
    return db.query_to_df(sql, args)


def contracts(market, start, end):
    if market not in ('tx_day', 'tx_night'):
        raise ValueError('僅台指期需要選擇契約')
    a, b = parse_time(start), parse_time(end)
    validate_range(market, a, b)
    # Only list months, never disclose future prices or volume-based rankings.
    df = _query('''SELECT DISTINCT contract_date FROM raw_finmind.fm_taiwan_futures_tick
        WHERE futures_id='TX' AND source_date BETWEEN ? AND ?
          AND trade_datetime >= ? AND trade_datetime < ? AND contract_date ~ '^[0-9]{6}$'
        ORDER BY contract_date''', (a.date()-timedelta(days=1), b.date()+timedelta(days=1), a, b))
    return {'contracts': df['contract_date'].tolist()}


def aggregate_history(rows, market, period):
    result = []
    for t, o, h, l, c, v in rows:
        k = int(ms(bucket(t, market, period)) / 1000)
        if not result or result[-1]['time'] != k:
            result.append(dict(time=k, open=float(o), high=float(h), low=float(l), close=float(c), volume=float(v)))
        else:
            bar = result[-1]
            bar['high'] = max(bar['high'], float(h)); bar['low'] = min(bar['low'], float(l))
            bar['close'] = float(c); bar['volume'] += float(v)
    return result


def initialize(market, symbol, contract, period, start, end):
    validate(market, symbol, contract, period)
    a, b = parse_time(start), parse_time(end)
    validate_range(market, a, b)
    first = bucket(a, market, period)
    # Use completed minutes strictly before the current bucket. A partial bucket
    # is reconstructed from events, never from its final historical OHLC.
    earliest = first - timedelta(days=90)
    if market == 'stock':
        df = _query('''SELECT date+minute, open, high, low, close, volume
            FROM raw_finmind.fm_taiwan_stock_kbar_1m
            WHERE stock_id=? AND date BETWEEN ? AND ? AND date+minute < ?
            AND minute >= TIME '09:00' AND minute <= TIME '13:30'
            ORDER BY date, minute''', (symbol, earliest.date(), first.date(), first))
    else:
        session = 'position' if market == 'tx_day' else 'after_market'
        df = _query('''SELECT bar_datetime, open, high, low, close, volume
            FROM raw_finmind.fm_taiwan_futures_kbar_1m
            WHERE futures_id='TX' AND contract_date=? AND trading_session=?
            AND bar_datetime >= ? AND bar_datetime < ? ORDER BY bar_datetime''',
            (contract, session, earliest, first))
    history = aggregate_history(df.itertuples(index=False, name=None), market, period)[-6000:]
    return {'history': history, 'event_start': first.isoformat(), 'start_ms': ms(a), 'end_ms': ms(b),
            'resolution': 'minute' if market == 'stock' else 'tick',
            'volume_available': not (market == 'stock' and symbol == 'TAIEX')}


def events(market, symbol, contract, period, start, end, final=False):
    validate(market, symbol, contract, period)
    a, b = parse_time(start), parse_time(end)
    validate_range(market, a, b)
    if b-a > timedelta(minutes=15):
        raise ValueError('單次資料請求不可超過 15 分鐘')
    if market == 'stock':
        # Conservative availability convention: stored minute is bar start;
        # expose its OHLC only one minute later, never invent an intraminute path.
        x, y = a-timedelta(minutes=1), b-timedelta(minutes=1)
        if final: y += timedelta(microseconds=1)
        df = _query('''SELECT date+minute, open, high, low, close, volume
            FROM raw_finmind.fm_taiwan_stock_kbar_1m
            WHERE stock_id=? AND date BETWEEN ? AND ? AND date+minute >= ? AND date+minute < ?
            AND minute >= TIME '09:00' AND minute <= TIME '13:30'
            ORDER BY date, minute''', (symbol, x.date(), y.date(), x, y))
        data = [[ms(t+timedelta(minutes=1)), int(ms(bucket(t, market, period))/1000),
                 float(o),float(h),float(l),float(c),float(v)] for t,o,h,l,c,v in df.itertuples(index=False,name=None)]
    else:
        upper = b + timedelta(microseconds=1) if final else b
        df = _query('''SELECT trade_datetime, price, volume, id
            FROM raw_finmind.fm_taiwan_futures_tick
            WHERE futures_id='TX' AND contract_date=? AND trade_datetime >= ? AND trade_datetime < ?
            ORDER BY trade_datetime, source_row_no, id LIMIT ?''', (contract,a,upper,MAX_CHUNK+1))
        if len(df)>MAX_CHUNK:
            raise ValueError('逐筆資料過多，請縮短查詢區間')
        data = [[ms(t),int(ms(bucket(t,market,period))/1000),float(p),float(p),float(p),float(p),float(v)/2,str(tid)]
                for t,p,v,tid in df.itertuples(index=False,name=None)]
    return {'events':data}

    "finished_at": None,
    "error": None,
    "modules": [],
    "completed_modules": [],
    "skipped_modules": [],
    "results": {},
    "current_index": 0,
    "total_modules": 0,
    "force": False,
}


def _set_state(**values) -> None:
    with _STATE_LOCK:
        _STATE.update(values)


def get_report_update_status() -> dict:
    with _STATE_LOCK:
        return dict(_STATE)


def _cache_name(module: str) -> str:
    return f"{CACHE_PREFIX}{module}"


def _get_cache_rows() -> dict[str, dict]:
    try:
        frame = db.query_to_df(
            """
            SELECT cache_name, refreshed_at, row_count, elapsed_seconds
            FROM core.report_cache_status
            WHERE cache_name LIKE ?
            """,
            (f"{CACHE_PREFIX}%",),
        )
    except Exception:
        return {}
    rows: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for row in frame.to_dict("records"):
        module = str(row["cache_name"])[len(CACHE_PREFIX):]
        refreshed = row.get("refreshed_at")
        rows[module] = {
            "refreshed_at": None if refreshed is None else refreshed.isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            "row_count": int(row.get("row_count") or 0),
            "elapsed_seconds": row.get("elapsed_seconds"),
        }
    return rows


def _last_refresh(module: str) -> datetime | None:
    value = db.query_single_value(
        "SELECT refreshed_at FROM core.report_cache_status WHERE cache_name = ?",
        (_cache_name(module),),
    )
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value
    return datetime.fromisoformat(str(value))


def _is_fresh(module: str) -> bool:
    ttl = int(UPDATE_ITEMS[module].get("ttl_minutes", 0))
    if ttl <= 0:
        return False
    try:
        refreshed = _last_refresh(module)
    except Exception:
        return False
    return refreshed is not None and datetime.now() - refreshed < timedelta(minutes=ttl)


def _mark_refresh(module: str, row_count: int, elapsed_seconds: float) -> None:
    ok = db.execute_sql(
        """
        INSERT INTO core.report_cache_status (cache_name, refreshed_at, row_count, elapsed_seconds)
        VALUES (?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT (cache_name) DO UPDATE SET
            refreshed_at = EXCLUDED.refreshed_at,
            row_count = EXCLUDED.row_count,
            elapsed_seconds = EXCLUDED.elapsed_seconds
        """,
        (_cache_name(module), int(row_count), float(elapsed_seconds)),
    )
    if not ok:
        print(f"[Dashboard 更新快取] 無法記錄 {module} 的完成時間；不影響資料更新結果。")


def get_update_catalog() -> dict:
    cache = _get_cache_rows()
    sections = []
    for section in UPDATE_SECTIONS:
        items = []
        for item in section["items"]:
            module = item["id"]
            items.append({**item, "cache": cache.get(module)})
        sections.append({
            "id": section["id"],
            "name": section["name"],
            "icon": section["icon"],
            "description": section["description"],
            "items": items,
        })
    return {"sections": sections, "status": get_report_update_status()}


def _normalize_modules(modules: Iterable[str] | None) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    values = list(modules or ("taiex_report", "futures_report"))
    seen: set[str] = set()
    ordered: list[str] = []
    for value in values:
        module = str(value).strip()
        if not module or module in seen:
            continue
        if module not in UPDATE_ITEMS:
            raise ValueError(f"不支援的更新模組：{module}")
        seen.add(module)
        ordered.append(module)
    if not ordered:
        raise ValueError("請至少選擇一個更新模組")
    return tuple(ordered)


def _row_count_from_result(result) -> int:
    if result is None:
        return 0
    if hasattr(result, "shape"):
        return int(result.shape[0])
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        total = 0
        for value in result.values():
            if hasattr(value, "shape"):
                total += int(value.shape[0])
            elif isinstance(value, (int, float)):
                total += int(value)
        return total
    try:
        return int(len(result))
    except Exception:
        return 0


def _run_module(module: str, *, selected_modules: set[str]) -> tuple[int, dict]:
    if module == "taiex_report":
        from main.stock_report_taiex import run_report_pipeline
        result = run_report_pipeline(export_csv=False)
        return _row_count_from_result(result), {}

    if module == "taiex_kbar":
        from main.intraday_pipeline import update_taiex_kbar_1m
        result = update_taiex_kbar_1m(datetime.now())
        return _row_count_from_result(result), {}

    if module == "futures_report":
        from main.futures import run_report_pipeline
        # 同一輪若另有 futures_kbar，就不要在報表流程裡再打一輪 Tick API。
        result = run_report_pipeline(
            refresh_cache=False,
            export_csv=False,
            sync_intraday="futures_kbar" not in selected_modules,
        )
        return _row_count_from_result(result), {}

    if module == "futures_kbar":
        from main.intraday_pipeline import update_tx_kbar_1m
        result = update_tx_kbar_1m(
            datetime.now(),
            refresh_turning="futures_report" not in selected_modules,
        )
        return _row_count_from_result(result), {}

    if module == "tw_margin_maintenance":
        from module.margin_maintenance import update_taiwan_total_margin_maintenance

        result = update_taiwan_total_margin_maintenance(datetime.now())
        return int(result.written_rows), {
            "requested_start": result.requested_start.isoformat(),
            "requested_end": result.requested_end.isoformat(),
            "first_date": None if result.first_date is None else result.first_date.isoformat(),
            "last_date": None if result.last_date is None else result.last_date.isoformat(),
        }

    raise ValueError(f"模組 {module} 必須由批次更新器處理")


def _run_us_batch(modules: list[str]) -> dict[str, dict]:
    from module.us_market import update_us_stock_daily_incremental

    symbols = [UPDATE_ITEMS[module]["symbol"] for module in modules]
    by_symbol = update_us_stock_daily_incremental(symbols, datetime.now(), lookback_days=7)
    return {
        module: by_symbol.get(UPDATE_ITEMS[module]["symbol"], {})
        for module in modules
    }


def _refresh_futures_derivatives_after_late_kbar() -> None:
    """報表先跑、K 線後跑時，只重算依賴 K 線的衍生層，不再抓 API。"""
    from module.futures_turning import ensure_turning_views, refresh_turning_levels
    from module.report_cache import refresh_futures_dashboard_cache, refresh_futures_report_tail_cache

    refresh_turning_levels()
    refresh_futures_report_tail_cache()
    refresh_futures_dashboard_cache(recent_days=14, force_full=False)
    ensure_turning_views()


def _run(modules: tuple[str, ...], force: bool) -> None:
    completed: list[str] = []
    skipped: list[str] = []
    results: dict[str, dict] = {}
    selected_set = set(modules)
    try:
        index = 0
        while index < len(modules):
            module = modules[index]

            if module.startswith("us_"):
                batch: list[str] = []
                while index < len(modules) and modules[index].startswith("us_"):
                    candidate = modules[index]
                    if not force and _is_fresh(candidate):
                        skipped.append(candidate)
                        results[candidate] = {"status": "cached"}
                    else:
                        batch.append(candidate)
                    index += 1
                if batch:
                    _set_state(
                        step=batch[0],
                        current_index=len(completed) + len(skipped) + 1,
                        message=f"正在更新外國股市資料（{len(batch)} 項）…",
                    )
                    started = time.perf_counter()
                    batch_result = _run_us_batch(batch)
                    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
                    each_elapsed = elapsed / max(1, len(batch))
                    for candidate in batch:
                        info = batch_result.get(candidate, {})
                        rows = int(info.get("written_rows") or info.get("rows") or 0)
                        _mark_refresh(candidate, rows, each_elapsed)
                        completed.append(candidate)
                        results[candidate] = {"status": "updated", **info}
                    _set_state(completed_modules=list(completed), skipped_modules=list(skipped), results=dict(results))
                continue

            _set_state(
                step=module,
                current_index=len(completed) + len(skipped) + 1,
                message=f"正在更新{UPDATE_NAMES[module]}…",
            )
            if not force and _is_fresh(module):
                skipped.append(module)
                results[module] = {"status": "cached"}
                _set_state(skipped_modules=list(skipped), results=dict(results))
                index += 1
                continue

            started = time.perf_counter()
            rows, details = _run_module(module, selected_modules=selected_set)
            elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
            _mark_refresh(module, rows, elapsed)
            completed.append(module)
            results[module] = {"status": "updated", "rows": rows, "elapsed_seconds": round(elapsed, 3), **details}
            _set_state(completed_modules=list(completed), results=dict(results))
            index += 1

        # 若使用者把「原始資料」排在「K 線」前面，期貨報表當下刻意不重抓 K 線；
        # K 線完成後再刷新依賴 K 線的轉折與尾端快取，避免重複 API。
        if "futures_report" in modules and "futures_kbar" in modules:
            if modules.index("futures_report") < modules.index("futures_kbar") and "futures_kbar" in completed:
                _set_state(step="finalize", message="正在刷新期貨 K 線衍生資料…")
                _refresh_futures_derivatives_after_late_kbar()

        updated_names = "、".join(UPDATE_NAMES[module] for module in completed)
        if skipped:
            cached_names = "、".join(UPDATE_NAMES[module] for module in skipped)
            message = f"更新完成；已更新：{updated_names or '無'}；快取略過：{cached_names}"
        else:
            message = f"{updated_names}更新完成"
        _set_state(
            running=False,
            step="completed",
            message=message,
            current_index=len(modules),
            completed_modules=list(completed),
            skipped_modules=list(skipped),
            results=dict(results),
            finished_at=datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        if getattr(exc, "is_data_pending", False):
            _set_state(
                running=False,
                step="pending",
                message=str(exc),
                error=None,
                completed_modules=list(completed),
                skipped_modules=list(skipped),
                results=dict(results),
                finished_at=datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            )
        else:
            traceback.print_exc()
            _set_state(
                running=False,
                step="failed",
                message=f"更新失敗：{exc}",
                error=str(exc),
                completed_modules=list(completed),
                skipped_modules=list(skipped),
                results=dict(results),
                finished_at=datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            )
    finally:
        _LOCK.release()


def start_report_update(
    modules: list[str] | tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
    *,
    force: bool = False,
) -> dict:
    ordered = _normalize_modules(modules)
    if not _LOCK.acquire(blocking=False):
        return get_report_update_status()
    _set_state(
        running=True,
        step="starting",
        message="正在準備更新…",
        started_at=datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        finished_at=None,
        error=None,
        modules=list(ordered),
        completed_modules=[],
        skipped_modules=[],
        results={},
        current_index=0,
        total_modules=len(ordered),
        force=bool(force),
    )
    threading.Thread(
        target=_run,
        args=(ordered, bool(force)),
        name="dashboard-global-update",
        daemon=True,
    ).start()
    return get_report_update_status()

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime

import pandas as pd

from common import db


_UPDATE_LOCK = threading.Lock()


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UpdateResult:
    taiex_max_date: str
    tx_max_date: str
    tx_rows_synced: int


def _latest_date(table: str, date_column: str, where_sql: str = "") -> pd.Timestamp | None:
    value = db.query_single_value(
        f'SELECT MAX("{date_column}") FROM {table} {where_sql}'
    )
    return pd.Timestamp(value).normalize() if value is not None else None


def _sync_recent_tx_prices(start_date: pd.Timestamp, end_date: pd.Timestamp) -> int:
    """將近期 TX 日盤及對應夜盤 OHLC 同步到既有期貨報表。"""
    from module import futures_utils as fu

    dates_df = db.query_to_df(
        """
        SELECT DISTINCT date
        FROM fm_taiwan_futures_daily
        WHERE futures_id = 'TX'
          AND trading_session = 'position'
          AND date BETWEEN ? AND ?
        ORDER BY date
        """,
        (start_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), end_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")),
    )
    if dates_df.empty:
        return 0

    rows: list[tuple] = []
    prior_df = db.query_to_df(
        """
        SELECT 日盤收
        FROM futures_report_daily_raw
        WHERE futures_id = 'TX' AND 日期 < ?
        ORDER BY 日期 DESC
        LIMIT 1
        """,
        (start_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),),
    )
    rolling_previous_close = (
        float(prior_df.iloc[0, 0])
        if not prior_df.empty and pd.notna(prior_df.iloc[0, 0])
        else None
    )
    for trading_date in pd.to_datetime(dates_df["date"]).dt.normalize():
        contract_month = fu._get_front_contract_month(trading_date, "TX")
        row = fu._get_month_contract_row(trading_date, "position", contract_month, "TX")
        if row is None:
            continue

        next_after_market_date = fu._get_next_after_market_date(trading_date, "TX")
        night_row = None
        if next_after_market_date is not None:
            night_contract_month = fu._get_front_contract_month(next_after_market_date, "TX")
            night_row = fu._get_month_contract_row(
                next_after_market_date,
                "after_market",
                night_contract_month,
                "TX",
            )

        open_price = float(row["open"])
        high_price = float(row["max"])
        low_price = float(row["min"])
        close_price = float(row["close"])
        day_range = high_price - low_price
        close_open = close_price - open_price
        close_change = close_price - rolling_previous_close if rolling_previous_close is not None else None

        rows.append(
            (
                "TX", trading_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), trading_date.year, trading_date.month,
                fu._weekday_text(trading_date), fu._week_no(trading_date), fu._day_type_text(trading_date),
                open_price, close_price, high_price, low_price,
                close_change, day_range, day_range / open_price if open_price else None,
                day_range / rolling_previous_close if rolling_previous_close else None,
                close_open, close_open / rolling_previous_close if rolling_previous_close else None,
                float(row["volume"]) if pd.notna(row["volume"]) else None,
                float(night_row["open"]) if night_row is not None and pd.notna(night_row["open"]) else None,
                float(night_row["close"]) if night_row is not None and pd.notna(night_row["close"]) else None,
                float(night_row["max"]) if night_row is not None and pd.notna(night_row["max"]) else None,
                float(night_row["min"]) if night_row is not None and pd.notna(night_row["min"]) else None,
                float(night_row["volume"]) if night_row is not None and pd.notna(night_row["volume"]) else None,
            )
        )
        rolling_previous_close = close_price

    if not rows:
        return 0

    ok = db.execute_sql(
        """
        INSERT INTO futures_report_daily_raw (
            futures_id, 日期, 年, 月, 星期, 週次, 天別,
            日盤開, 日盤收, 日盤高, 日盤低,
            日漲跌, 日振幅, 日振幅開盤比, 日振幅昨收比,
            日收減日開, 日收開昨收比, 日成交量,
            夜盤開, 夜盤收, 夜盤高, 夜盤低, 夜成交量
        )
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT (futures_id, 日期) DO UPDATE SET
            年 = excluded.年,
            月 = excluded.月,
            星期 = excluded.星期,
            週次 = excluded.週次,
            天別 = excluded.天別,
            日盤開 = excluded.日盤開,
            日盤收 = excluded.日盤收,
            日盤高 = excluded.日盤高,
            日盤低 = excluded.日盤低,
            日漲跌 = excluded.日漲跌,
            日振幅 = excluded.日振幅,
            日振幅開盤比 = excluded.日振幅開盤比,
            日振幅昨收比 = excluded.日振幅昨收比,
            日收減日開 = excluded.日收減日開,
            日收開昨收比 = excluded.日收開昨收比,
            日成交量 = excluded.日成交量,
            夜盤開 = COALESCE(excluded.夜盤開, futures_report_daily_raw.夜盤開),
            夜盤收 = COALESCE(excluded.夜盤收, futures_report_daily_raw.夜盤收),
            夜盤高 = COALESCE(excluded.夜盤高, futures_report_daily_raw.夜盤高),
            夜盤低 = COALESCE(excluded.夜盤低, futures_report_daily_raw.夜盤低),
            夜成交量 = COALESCE(excluded.夜成交量, futures_report_daily_raw.夜成交量)
        """,
        rows,
    )
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError("台指期日盤／夜盤資料同步失敗，請查看終端機中的 PostgreSQL 錯誤")
    return len(rows)


def update_price_data() -> UpdateResult:
    if not _UPDATE_LOCK.acquire(blocking=False):
        raise RuntimeError("資料更新正在執行中，請稍候")
    try:
        # 延後匯入，讓使用者即使暫時缺少 FinMind 套件，仍可先瀏覽資料庫既有報表。
        from module import finMind as fm

        today = pd.Timestamp(datetime.now()).normalize()
        from module import futures_utils as fu

        # 只定錨到今天之後的第一個交易日，不再重複累加日曆日。
        futures_fetch_end = fu._get_night_source_end(today, "TX")
        taiex_latest = _latest_date("fm_taiwan_stock_daily", "date", "WHERE stock_id = 'TAIEX'")
        tx_latest = _latest_date("futures_report_daily_raw", "日期", "WHERE futures_id = 'TX'")
        taiex_start = (taiex_latest - pd.Timedelta(days=10)) if taiex_latest is not None else pd.Timestamp("2000-01-01")
        tx_start = (tx_latest - pd.Timedelta(days=10)) if tx_latest is not None else pd.Timestamp("2000-01-01")

        fm.get_tw_stock_daily_price("TAIEX", taiex_start, today)
        fm.get_tw_futures_daily("TX", tx_start, futures_fetch_end)
        try:
            from module.futures_datas import sync_taifex_futures_daily

            sync_taifex_futures_daily("TX", tx_start, futures_fetch_end)
        except Exception as exc:
            # 備援來源故障不應阻斷 FinMind 的正常更新。
            print(f"[期交所備援] 本次同步失敗，暫以既有資料繼續：{exc}")
        synced = _sync_recent_tx_prices(tx_start, today)

        # 不在日常行情更新中刷新整張期貨報表物化快取。
        # 這個動作會重算完整 v_futures_report_daily，可能耗時數分鐘；
        # 若需要完整快取與 CSV，請手動執行 main.futures.rebuild_futures_report_cache_and_csv()。
        print("[報表快取] 略過完整刷新。")

        new_taiex = _latest_date("fm_taiwan_stock_daily", "date", "WHERE stock_id = 'TAIEX'")
        new_tx = _latest_date("futures_report_daily_raw", "日期", "WHERE futures_id = 'TX'")
        return UpdateResult(
            taiex_max_date=new_taiex.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if new_taiex is not None else "無資料",
            tx_max_date=new_tx.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if new_tx is not None else "無資料",
            tx_rows_synced=synced,
        )
    finally:
        _UPDATE_LOCK.release()

from __future__ import annotations

from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path
import copy
import json

import pandas as pd

from machine_learning import yu_key_k_stage1 as stage1
from machine_learning import yu_key_level_rule_discovery as discovery
from machine_learning.yu_candidate_review_system import analyze_as_of, cluster_levels, load_config
from common import db


PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DEFAULT_CONFIG = PROJECT_ROOT / "machine_learning" / "configs" / "yu_candidate_review_v3.json"
STRICT_CONFIG = PROJECT_ROOT / "machine_learning" / "configs" / "yu_candidate_review_strict.json"
YU_HISTORY_START = pd.Timestamp("2025-01-01")
from common.paths import yu_label_path
YU_ACTUAL_LABELS = PROJECT_ROOT / "Yu點位資料整理_2025_2026.xlsx"


def _text(value: object) -> str:
    return "" if value is None or pd.isna(value) else str(value)


def _candidate_config(mode: str) -> dict:
    config = load_config(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
    if mode == "broad":
        return config
    if mode != "strict":
        raise ValueError("候選模式只支援 strict 或 broad")
    strict_spec = json.loads(STRICT_CONFIG.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    result = copy.deepcopy(config)
    result["name"] = strict_spec["name"]
    result["version"] = strict_spec["version"]
    result["candidate"].update(strict_spec["candidate_overrides"])
    return result


def _actual_yu_levels(start: pd.Timestamp, cutoff: pd.Timestamp) -> dict:
    path = yu_label_path(YU_ACTUAL_LABELS)
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError(f"找不到 Yu 整理點位檔：{path}（舊位置 code 或新位置 data/yu）")
    labels = discovery.normalize_taiex_labels([path], start, cutoff)
    close_frame = db.query_to_df(
        'SELECT "收盤價" FROM report.v_taiex_report '
        'WHERE "日期" <= ? ORDER BY "日期" DESC LIMIT 1',
        (cutoff.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),),
    )
    current_close = float(close_frame.iloc[0]["收盤價"]) if not close_frame.empty else 0.0
    zones: list[dict] = []
    if not labels.empty:
        labels = labels.copy()
        labels["Yu加權點位"] = pd.to_numeric(labels["Yu加權點位"], errors="coerce")
        labels = labels.dropna(subset=["Yu加權點位"])
        for rank, (level, group) in enumerate(
            labels.groupby("Yu加權點位", sort=False), start=1
        ):
            analysis_dates = sorted({f"{pd.Timestamp(x):%Y-%m-%d}" for x in group["分析日期"]})
            reference_dates = sorted({
                date.strip()
                for value in group["明示參考日期"].fillna("").astype(str)
                for date in value.split("|") if date.strip()
            })
            roles = sorted(set(group["點位角色"].fillna("").astype(str)) - {""})
            categories = sorted(set(group["已整理點位分類"].fillna("").astype(str)) - {""})
            kinds = sorted(set(group["明示點位類型"].fillna("").astype(str)) - {""})
            reasons = [x for x in group["Yu點位子句"].fillna("").astype(str).unique() if x]
            reason_text = "｜".join([
                *roles, *categories, *kinds,
                *(reasons[:3]),
            ])
            zones.append({
                "id": f"YU-ACTUAL-{float(level):.4f}", "rank": rank,
                "lower": round(float(level), 2), "upper": round(float(level), 2),
                "level": round(float(level), 2), "reasons": reason_text,
                "source_dates": reference_dates or analysis_dates,
                "analysis_dates": analysis_dates,
                "source_count": len(group), "status": "YU實際使用",
                "distance": round(float(level) - current_close, 2),
                "importance_score": 100.0, "importance_grade": "S",
                "direction_bias": "未分類", "direction_strength": 0.0,
                "candle_shapes": "Yu實際使用",
            })
    zones.sort(key=lambda row: (row["analysis_dates"][-1], row["level"]), reverse=True)
    for rank, row in enumerate(zones, start=1):
        row["rank"] = rank
    return {
        "start_date": start.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "as_of_date": cutoff.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), "mode": "actual",
        "raw_count": len(labels), "count": len(zones), "zones": zones,
        "note": "直接取自Yu點位資料整理檔的實際使用點位；相同點位合併但保留全部使用日期。",
    }


def load_yu_chart_date_bounds() -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Yu頁面從2025開始，結束日採資料庫實際最新交易日。"""
    bounds = db.query_to_df(
        'SELECT MIN("日期") AS min_date, MAX("日期") AS max_date '
        'FROM report.v_taiex_report WHERE "日期" >= ?',
        (YU_HISTORY_START.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),),
    )
    if bounds.empty or pd.isna(bounds.iloc[0]["max_date"]):
        raise ValueError("加權指數報表目前沒有2025年以後資料")
    source_min = max(YU_HISTORY_START, pd.Timestamp(bounds.iloc[0]["min_date"]).normalize())
    source_max = pd.Timestamp(bounds.iloc[0]["max_date"]).normalize()
    return source_min.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), source_max.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")


@lru_cache(maxsize=16)
def load_yu_chart_levels(start_date: str, as_of_date: str, mode: str = "strict") -> dict:
    start = pd.Timestamp(start_date).normalize()
    cutoff = pd.Timestamp(as_of_date).normalize()
    if start > cutoff:
        raise ValueError("開始日期不可晚於結束日期")
    source_min, source_max = map(pd.Timestamp, load_yu_chart_date_bounds())
    if start < source_min:
        raise ValueError(f"Yu點位資料從 {source_min:%Y-%m-%d} 開始")
    if cutoff > source_max:
        raise ValueError(f"結束日期不可晚於資料庫最新交易日 {source_max:%Y-%m-%d}")
    if mode == "actual":
        return _actual_yu_levels(start, cutoff)
    config = _candidate_config(mode)
    taiex, futures = stage1.load_reports(config, cutoff)
    raw, all_zones, _, _ = analyze_as_of(taiex, futures, cutoff, config)

    # 這個頁面要看的是區間內「曾形成過」的全部 K 棒候選，不是截止日的 30 組審核快照。
    historical_raw = raw.loc[
        raw["market"].eq("TAIEX")
        & raw["source_category"].eq("STATIC_K_LEVEL")
        & pd.to_datetime(raw["source_date"]).between(start, cutoff)
    ].copy()
    current_atr = float(all_zones.attrs.get("current_atr", 1.0))
    historical, _ = cluster_levels(historical_raw, current_atr, config)
    if not historical.empty:
        historical["latest_source_date"] = historical["source_dates"].map(
            lambda value: max(str(value).split("|"))
        )
        historical = historical.sort_values(
            ["latest_source_date", "representative_level"], ascending=[False, False]
        ).reset_index(drop=True)
        historical["history_rank"] = historical.index + 1

    zones = []
    for row in historical.to_dict("records"):
        dates = [date for date in _text(row.get("source_dates")).split("|") if date]
        zones.append({
            "id": _text(row.get("zone_id")), "rank": int(row.get("history_rank", 0)),
            "lower": round(float(row["zone_lower"]), 2),
            "upper": round(float(row["zone_upper"]), 2),
            "level": round(float(row["representative_level"]), 2),
            "reasons": _text(row.get("source_rules")), "source_dates": dates,
            "source_count": int(row.get("source_count", 0)),
            "status": _text(row.get("current_status")),
            "distance": round(float(row.get("distance_from_current", 0)), 2),
            "importance_score": round(float(row.get("importance_score", 0)), 2),
            "importance_grade": _text(row.get("importance_grade")) or "D",
            "direction_bias": _text(row.get("direction_bias")) or "中性",
            "direction_strength": round(float(row.get("direction_strength", 0)), 2),
            "candle_shapes": _text(row.get("candle_shapes")),
        })
    return {
        "start_date": start.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "as_of_date": cutoff.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "mode": mode, "raw_count": len(historical_raw), "count": len(zones), "zones": zones,
        "note": "列出區間內曾形成的全部K棒候選；相近原始點位先合併，且不使用截止日以後資料。",
    }

"""Apply one small Invest update stage to the existing code folder.

Default is a read-only version check. --apply creates a source-file backup first.
No database migration, credential modification, data move, or full code replacement.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from datetime import datetime
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import os

BUNDLE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def fingerprint(path: Path) -> str:
    # User's Windows checkout and source export may use CRLF, BOM, or a final blank line.
    value = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').rstrip()
    return sha256(value.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()


def safe(project: Path, relative: str) -> Path:
    p = Path(relative)
    if p.is_absolute() or '..' in p.parts:
        raise ValueError(f'Unsafe path: {relative}')
    result = project
    for part in p.parts:
        result = result / part
        if result.is_symlink() or (hasattr(result, 'is_junction') and result.is_junction()):
            raise ValueError(f'Symbolic link/junction refused: {result}')
    if not result.resolve().is_relative_to(project.resolve()):
        raise ValueError(f'Path escapes project: {result}')
    return result


def manifest(stage: str):
    return json.loads((BUNDLE/stage/'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['files']


def plan(project: Path, stage: str):
    changes, errors = [], []
    for item in manifest(stage):
        relative = item['path']
        dest = safe(project, 'code/'+relative)
        src = safe(BUNDLE, stage+'/'+relative)
        if not src.is_file() or fingerprint(src) != item['new_sha256']:
            errors.append(f'PACKAGE ERROR: {relative} is missing or changed')
            continue
        if dest.exists() and not dest.is_file():
            errors.append(f'CONFLICT: not a regular file: {dest}')
            continue
        before = fingerprint(dest) if dest.exists() else None
        if before == item['new_sha256']:
            print(f'SAME {relative}')
        elif before in item['allowed_old_sha256']:
            changes.append({**item, 'before_sha256': before})
            print(f'PLAN {"ADD" if before is None else "UPDATE"} {relative}')
        else:
            errors.append(f'CONFLICT: {relative} differs from the provided version (or is missing). Do not overwrite.')
    return changes, errors


def atomic_copy(src: Path, dest: Path):
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.invest-update-', suffix='.tmp', dir=dest.parent)
    os.close(fd)
    temp = Path(name)
    try:
        shutil.copy2(src, temp)
        os.replace(temp, dest)
    finally:
        temp.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def install(project: Path, stage: str, changes: list[dict]):
    if not changes:
        print('This stage is already installed.'); return None
    stamp = datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f')
    backup = safe(project, f'archive/update_backups/{stamp}-{stage}')
    backup.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    log = {'stage':stage,'files':changes,'project':str(project)}
    # Back up every original before replacing even one file.
    for item in changes:
        dest = safe(project, 'code/'+item['path'])
        before = item['before_sha256']
        current = fingerprint(dest) if dest.exists() else None
        if before != current:
            raise RuntimeError(f'File changed after preview: {dest}')
        if before is not None:
            saved = backup/'files'/item['path']
            saved.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(dest, saved)
            if fingerprint(saved) != before:
                raise RuntimeError(f'Backup verification failed: {saved}')
    (backup/'backup.json').write_text(json.dumps(log,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    print(f'BACKUP: {backup}')
    applied=[]
    try:
        for item in changes:
            dest = safe(project,'code/'+item['path'])
            before = item['before_sha256']
            if (fingerprint(dest) if dest.exists() else None) != before:
                raise RuntimeError(f'File changed during installation: {dest}')
            src = safe(BUNDLE,stage+'/'+item['path'])
            atomic_copy(src,dest); applied.append(item)
            if fingerprint(dest)!=item['new_sha256']:
                raise RuntimeError(f'Installed file verification failed: {dest}')
            print(f'UPDATED {item["path"]}')
    except BaseException:
        # Restore only files this process has replaced; don't touch files changed by others.
        for item in reversed(applied):
            dest=safe(project,'code/'+item['path'])
            if dest.is_file() and fingerprint(dest)==item['new_sha256']:
                if item['before_sha256'] is None: dest.unlink()
                else: atomic_copy(backup/'files'/item['path'],dest)
        raise
    return backup


def rollback(project: Path, backup: Path):
    backup=backup.resolve(); parent=safe(project,'archive/update_backups').resolve()
    if backup==parent or not backup.is_relative_to(parent):
        raise ValueError('Select the backup folder printed by apply_update.py under archive/update_backups.')
    log=json.loads((backup/'backup.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    errors=[];todo=[]
    for item in log['files']:
        dest=safe(project,'code/'+item['path']);before=item['before_sha256']
        cur=fingerprint(dest) if dest.exists() else None
        if cur==before:continue
        if cur!=item['new_sha256']:
            errors.append(f'CONFLICT (not overwritten): {dest}');continue
        if before is not None:
            src=backup/'files'/item['path']
            if not src.is_file() or fingerprint(src)!=before:
                errors.append(f'BACKUP ERROR: {src}');continue
        todo.append(item)
    if errors:
        for error in errors:print(error)
        return False
    for item in reversed(todo):
        dest=safe(project,'code/'+item['path'])
        if item['before_sha256'] is None:dest.unlink()
        else:atomic_copy(backup/'files'/item['path'],dest)
        print(f'RESTORED {item["path"]}')
    print('Code-only rollback complete. Database and data locations were NOT rolled back.')
    return True


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('stage',nargs='?',choices=['features','paths'])
    parser.add_argument('--project',type=Path,default=BUNDLE.parent,help='Existing Invest root (defaults to the bundle parent)')
    parser.add_argument('--apply',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--rollback',type=Path,help='Restore only source files from a printed update backup')
    args=parser.parse_args()
    if hasattr(sys.stdout,'reconfigure'):sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
    try:
        project=args.project.resolve()
        if not (project/'code/dashboard/app.py').is_file() or not (project/'code/start_dashboard.py').is_file():
            raise ValueError(f'Existing Invest/code folder was not found: {project}. No new code folder will be created.')
        if args.rollback:
            if args.stage or args.apply:raise ValueError('Use --rollback without a stage or --apply.')
            return 0 if rollback(project,args.rollback) else 2
        if not args.stage:raise ValueError('Choose features or paths.')
        print('Project:',project)
        print('Stage:',args.stage)
        changes,errors=plan(project,args.stage)
        for error in errors:print(error)
        if errors:
            print('Version check failed. Nothing was changed. Share the conflict paths and current files for review.');return 2
        print(f'{len(changes)} files to update. .env, data, output, journal_media and start_dashboard are unchanged.')
        if not args.apply:
            print('Preview OK. Re-run with --apply to install.');return 0
        install(project,args.stage,changes)
        print('Code update completed. See README.md for the next step.')
        return 0
    except (OSError,ValueError,RuntimeError) as exc:
        print(f'ERROR: {exc}\nNo credentials, database records or media files were removed. Check the printed backup path.');return 1


if __name__=='__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

from datetime import date,datetime
from typing import Literal
from fastapi import APIRouter,Query,HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel,Field,model_validator,ConfigDict
from dashboard import journal_service as s
from dashboard.paper_trade_api import call
router=APIRouter(prefix='/api/paper-trade/journals',tags=['Trading journal'])
class Strict(BaseModel):
    model_config=ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
class Link(Strict):
    kind:Literal['account','run','trade','date','order']
    target_id:int|None=Field(default=None,gt=0)
    historical_date:date|None=None
    @model_validator(mode='after')
    def validate_target(self):
        if self.kind=='date':
            if self.historical_date is None or self.target_id is not None: raise ValueError('日期連結需要日期，不可指定 ID')
        elif self.target_id is None or self.historical_date is not None: raise ValueError('紀錄連結需要 ID，不可指定日期')
        return self
class Journal(Strict):
    title:str=Field(min_length=1,max_length=200)
    body:str=Field(default='',max_length=100000)
    journal_date:date
    links:list[Link]=Field(default_factory=list,max_length=500)
    expected_updated_at:datetime|None=None
class Preview(Strict):
    body:str=Field(max_length=100000)
def invoke(fn,*args):
    try: return call(fn,*args)
    except Exception as e:
        if getattr(e,'sqlstate',None)=='23503': raise HTTPException(400,'連結對象已不存在，請重新選擇') from e
        raise
@router.get('')
def list_journals(account_id:int|None=Query(default=None,gt=0),run_id:int|None=Query(default=None,gt=0),trade_id:int|None=Query(default=None,gt=0),history_date:date|None=None,start:date|None=None,end:date|None=None,keyword:str|None=Query(default=None,max_length=200),limit:int=Query(default=50,ge=1,le=100),offset:int=Query(default=0,ge=0),link_kind:Literal['account','run','trade','date','order']|None=None):
    return invoke(s.search,account_id,run_id,trade_id,history_date,start,end,keyword,limit,offset,link_kind)
@router.post('/preview')
def preview(data:Preview):
    return {'html':s.render_markdown(data.body)}
@router.post('')
def create(data:Journal): return invoke(s.save,data.model_dump())
@router.get('/{journal_id}')
def get(journal_id:int): return invoke(s.get,journal_id)
@router.put('/{journal_id}')
def update(journal_id:int,data:Journal): return invoke(s.save,data.model_dump(),journal_id)
@router.delete('/{journal_id}')
def delete(journal_id:int,expected_updated_at:datetime): return invoke(s.delete,journal_id,expected_updated_at)
