"""Local project media library. Only explicit allowlisted files are served."""
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4
from urllib.parse import quote, unquote
import re
import json
from hashlib import sha256
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request, Query
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse

router = APIRouter(prefix='/api/journal-media', tags=['Journal media'])
# dashboard/ -> code/ -> project root; separate from source and database.
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'journal_media'
TYPES = {'.png':'image/png','.jpg':'image/jpeg','.jpeg':'image/jpeg','.gif':'image/gif',
         '.webp':'image/webp','.avif':'image/avif','.bmp':'image/bmp',
         '.mp4':'video/mp4','.webm':'video/webm','.ogg':'video/ogg','.ogv':'video/ogg',
         '.mov':'video/quicktime','.pdf':'application/pdf','.txt':'text/plain',
         '.csv':'text/csv','.zip':'application/zip'}
PREFIX = '/api/journal-media/files/'
MAX_BYTES = 500 * 1024 * 1024

def kind_for(name):
    mime = TYPES.get(Path(name).suffix.lower(), '')
    return 'image' if mime.startswith('image/') else 'video' if mime.startswith('video/') else 'file'

def valid_name(name):
    return (bool(name) and len(name)<=240 and name not in ('.','..') and not name.startswith('.')
            and not any(c in name for c in '/\\:\x00') and not any(ord(c)<32 for c in name)
            and Path(name).suffix.lower() in TYPES)

def media_root():
    ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if ROOT.is_symlink(): raise HTTPException(500,'媒體資料夾不可為符號連結')
    return ROOT.resolve()

def resolve_file(name):
    if not valid_name(name): raise HTTPException(404,'找不到檔案')
    root=media_root(); path=root/name
    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or path.resolve().parent != root:
        raise HTTPException(404,'找不到檔案')
    return path

def alias_path(path):
    # Stable physical filename: rename only the library label, never a journal URL.
    return path.parent / ('.display-'+sha256(path.name.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()+'.json')


def display_name(path):
    alias=alias_path(path)
    if alias.is_file() and not alias.is_symlink():
        try:
            value=json.loads(alias.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['display_name']
            if isinstance(value,str) and value.strip(): return value
        except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError): pass
    return re.sub(r'^[0-9a-f]{32}_','',path.name)


def validate_content(path, suffix):
    """Verify images with Pillow; video signature check is not a codec decoder."""
    mime=TYPES[suffix]
    if mime.startswith('image/'):
        from PIL import Image, UnidentifiedImageError
        formats={'.png':'PNG','.jpg':'JPEG','.jpeg':'JPEG','.gif':'GIF','.webp':'WEBP','.avif':'AVIF','.bmp':'BMP'}
        try:
            with Image.open(path) as image:
                if image.format!=formats[suffix]: raise ValueError('圖片格式與副檔名不符')
                if image.width*image.height>100_000_000: raise ValueError('圖片像素過大')
                image.verify()
        except (OSError,ValueError,Image.DecompressionBombError) as e:
            raise HTTPException(400,'無效圖片或圖片格式不符') from e
    elif mime.startswith('video/'):
        with path.open('rb') as f: header=f.read(4096)
        valid=(suffix in ('.mp4','.mov') and len(header)>=12 and header[4:8] in (b'ftyp',b'moov',b'mdat',b'wide',b'free')) or (suffix=='.webm' and header.startswith(b'\x1a\x45\xdf\xa3')) or (suffix in ('.ogg','.ogv') and header.startswith(b'OggS'))
        if not valid: raise HTTPException(400,'影片檔頭與副檔名不符；請確認檔案格式')


def media_names(body):
    """Parse Markdown links, including reference-style links, not raw substrings."""
    from markdown_it import MarkdownIt
    names=set()
    def walk(tokens):
        for token in tokens:
            url=token.attrGet('src') if token.type=='image' else token.attrGet('href') if token.type=='link_open' else None
            if url:
                try: parsed=urlsplit(url)
                except ValueError: continue
                if (not parsed.netloc or parsed.hostname in ('localhost','127.0.0.1','::1')) and parsed.path.startswith(PREFIX):
                    name=unquote(parsed.path[len(PREFIX):])
                    if valid_name(name): names.add(name)
            if token.children: walk(token.children)
    walk(MarkdownIt('commonmark',{'html':False}).enable(['table','strikethrough']).parse(body))
    return names


def references(cur,name):
    from dashboard import paper_trade_service as p
    rows=p.many(cur,'SELECT id,title,journal_date,body FROM paper_trade.journals ORDER BY journal_date DESC,id DESC')
    return [{k:r[k] for k in ('id','title','journal_date')} for r in rows if name in media_names(r['body'])]


class Rename(BaseModel):
    display_name:str=Field(min_length=1,max_length=240)


@router.get('/references/{name}')
def get_references(name:str):
    resolve_file(name)
    from dashboard import paper_trade_service as p
    with p.connection() as conn,p.cursor(conn) as cur:
        return {'items':references(cur,name)}


@router.put('/rename/{name}')
def rename(name:str,data:Rename):
    path=resolve_file(name); value=data.display_name.strip()
    if not valid_name(value) or Path(value).suffix.lower()!=path.suffix.lower():
        raise HTTPException(400,'請保留原副檔名並使用有效檔名')
    target=alias_path(path); temp=path.parent/('.'+uuid4().hex+'.alias')
    try:
        temp.write_text(json.dumps({'display_name':value},ensure_ascii=False),encoding='utf-8')
        temp.replace(target)
    finally: temp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return file_info(path)


@router.delete('/files/{name}')
def delete_file(name:str):
    # Exclusive against journal saves; only unreferenced saved files may be removed.
    from dashboard import paper_trade_service as p
    with p.connection() as conn,p.cursor(conn) as cur:
        cur.execute('LOCK TABLE paper_trade.journals IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE')
        path=resolve_file(name)
        refs=references(cur,name)
        if refs: raise HTTPException(409,'仍有日記引用此檔案，請先移除連結')
        path.unlink(); alias_path(path).unlink(missing_ok=True)
        conn.commit(); return {'deleted':name}


def file_info(path):
    name=path.name
    display=display_name(path)
    return {'name':name,'display_name':display,'kind':kind_for(name),'size':path.stat().st_size,
            'url':PREFIX+quote(name,safe='')}

@router.get('')
def list_files(keyword: str=Query('',max_length=200), kind: str=Query('all',pattern='^(all|image|video|file)$'), unused:bool=False):
    files=[]; used=set()
    if unused:
        from dashboard import paper_trade_service as p
        with p.connection() as conn,p.cursor(conn) as cur:
            for row in p.many(cur,'SELECT body FROM paper_trade.journals'):
                used.update(media_names(row['body']))
    for path in media_root().iterdir():
        if path.name in used: continue
        if not valid_name(path.name) or path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file(): continue
        info=file_info(path)
        if keyword.casefold() not in info['display_name'].casefold() or kind!='all' and kind!=info['kind']: continue
        files.append(info)
    return {'items':sorted(files,key=lambda x:x['display_name'].casefold())}

@router.post('/upload')
async def upload(request: Request, filename: str=Query(...,max_length=240)):
    # A raw request body avoids multipart dependencies and permits bounded streaming.
    if request.headers.get("content-type", "").split(";")[0].strip().lower() != "application/octet-stream":
        raise HTTPException(415,"請使用檔案上傳功能")
    if not valid_name(filename): raise HTTPException(400,'不支援的副檔名或檔名')
    root=media_root(); suffix=Path(filename).suffix.lower()
    # Avoid Windows reserved characters and overly long UTF-8 filenames.
    stem=re.sub(r'[^\w.\- ]','_',Path(filename).stem,flags=re.UNICODE).strip(' .')[:48] or 'file'
    name=uuid4().hex+'_'+stem+suffix; dest=root/name; temp=root/('.'+uuid4().hex+'.upload')
    size=0
    try:
        with temp.open('xb') as out:
            async for chunk in request.stream():
                size+=len(chunk)
                if size>MAX_BYTES: raise HTTPException(413,'單檔上限 500 MB')
                out.write(chunk)
        if not size: raise HTTPException(400,'檔案不可為空')
        validate_content(temp,suffix)
        temp.rename(dest)
    finally:
        temp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return file_info(dest)

@router.get('/files/{name}')
@router.head('/files/{name}')
def serve(name: str):
    path=resolve_file(name); mime=TYPES[path.suffix.lower()]
    # Browser-renderable media only; all other files download instead of executing.
    inline=kind_for(name) in ('image','video')
    return FileResponse(path,media_type=mime,filename=path.name,
                        content_disposition_type='inline' if inline else 'attachment',
                        headers={'X-Content-Type-Options':'nosniff','Cache-Control':'private, max-age=0'})

def local_video_url(src):
    if not src.startswith(PREFIX): return False
    name=unquote(src[len(PREFIX):])
    return valid_name(name) and kind_for(name)=='video'

"""Independent Markdown journals; execution records are never updated here."""
from dashboard import paper_trade_service as p

VIEW='paper_trade.journal_link_details'

def links(cur, journal_id):
    return p.many(cur,f'SELECT * FROM {VIEW} WHERE journal_id=%s ORDER BY id',(journal_id,))

def get_one(cur, journal_id):
    row=p.require(p.one(cur,'SELECT * FROM paper_trade.journals WHERE id=%s',(journal_id,)),'日記')
    return {**row,'links':links(cur,journal_id)}

def get(journal_id):
    with p.connection() as conn,p.cursor(conn) as cur:
        return get_one(cur,journal_id)

def search(account_id=None,run_id=None,trade_id=None,history_date=None,start=None,end=None,keyword=None,limit=50,offset=0,link_kind=None):
    if start and end and start>end: raise ValueError('起始日期不能晚於結束日期')
    sql='SELECT j.* FROM paper_trade.journals j WHERE TRUE'; args=[]
    conditions=[]; linkargs=[]
    for col,val in [('account_id',account_id),('run_id',run_id)]:
        if val is not None: conditions.append('l.'+col+'=%s');linkargs.append(val)
    if trade_id is not None:
        conditions.append("(l.trade_id=%s OR (l.kind='order' AND l.entry_order_id=(SELECT order_id FROM paper_trade.trades WHERE id=%s)))")
        linkargs.extend((trade_id,trade_id))
    if link_kind is not None:
        # Old trade backlinks asked for kind=trade; include the stable opening group too.
        if link_kind=='trade' and trade_id is not None: conditions.append("l.kind IN ('trade','order')")
        else: conditions.append('l.kind=%s');linkargs.append(link_kind)
    if conditions:
        sql+=f' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {VIEW} l WHERE l.journal_id=j.id AND '+ ' AND '.join(conditions)+')';args+=linkargs
    if history_date: sql+=f' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {VIEW} d WHERE d.journal_id=j.id AND d.historical_date=%s)';args.append(history_date)
    if start: sql+=' AND j.journal_date >= %s';args.append(start)
    if end: sql+=' AND j.journal_date <= %s';args.append(end)
    if keyword: sql+=' AND strpos(lower(j.title || chr(10) || j.body),lower(%s))>0';args.append(keyword)
    sql+=' ORDER BY j.journal_date DESC,j.id DESC LIMIT %s OFFSET %s';args.extend([limit+1,offset])
    with p.connection() as conn,p.cursor(conn) as cur:
        rows=p.many(cur,sql,tuple(args));return {'items':[{**r,'links':links(cur,r['id'])} for r in rows[:limit]],'has_more':len(rows)>limit}

def save(data,journal_id=None):
    title=data['title'].strip()
    if not title: raise ValueError('請輸入日記標題')
    with p.connection() as conn,p.cursor(conn) as cur:
        from dashboard.journal_media import media_names, resolve_file
        # The table lock conflicts with media deletion's SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE lock.
        # An existing broken reference can be kept/removed; newly added references must exist.
        cur.execute('LOCK TABLE paper_trade.journals IN ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE')
        old_body=''
        if journal_id is None:
            for name in media_names(data['body']): resolve_file(name)
            row=p.one(cur,'INSERT INTO paper_trade.journals(title,body,journal_date) VALUES(%s,%s,%s) RETURNING id',(title,data['body'],data['journal_date']));journal_id=row['id']
        else:
            row=p.require(p.one(cur,'SELECT id,updated_at,body FROM paper_trade.journals WHERE id=%s FOR UPDATE',(journal_id,)),'日記')
            if data.get('expected_updated_at') != row['updated_at']: raise ValueError('日記已在其他視窗修改，請重新開啟後再儲存')
            for name in media_names(data['body'])-media_names(row.get('body','')): resolve_file(name)
            cur.execute('UPDATE paper_trade.journals SET title=%s,body=%s,journal_date=%s,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=%s',(title,data['body'],data['journal_date'],journal_id))
        # All edits are atomic, including replacing links. FK validation prevents dangling targets.
        seen=set(); targets=[]
        for original in data['links']:
            l=dict(original)
            if l['kind']=='trade':
                # Open positions are linked by immutable order id so later partial closes stay related.
                trade=p.require(p.one(cur,'SELECT order_id,exit_time FROM paper_trade.trades WHERE id=%s',(l['target_id'],)),'交易')
                if trade['exit_time'] is None: l.update(kind='order',target_id=trade['order_id'])
            if l['kind']=='order':
                p.require(p.one(cur,"SELECT id FROM paper_trade.orders WHERE id=%s AND status='FILLED' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM paper_trade.trades WHERE order_id=paper_trade.orders.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM paper_trade.journal_links WHERE entry_order_id=paper_trade.orders.id AND journal_id=%s))",(l['target_id'],journal_id)),'已成交開倉委託')
            key=(l['kind'],l.get('target_id'),l.get('historical_date'))
            if key in seen: continue
            seen.add(key)
            cols={'account':'account_id','run':'run_id','trade':'trade_id','date':'historical_date','order':'entry_order_id'}
            col=cols[l['kind']]; value=l['historical_date'] if l['kind']=='date' else l['target_id']
            targets.append((col,value))
        cur.execute('DELETE FROM paper_trade.journal_links WHERE journal_id=%s',(journal_id,))
        for col,value in targets:
            cur.execute(f'INSERT INTO paper_trade.journal_links(journal_id,{col}) VALUES(%s,%s)',(journal_id,value))
        result=get_one(cur,journal_id);conn.commit();return result

def delete(journal_id, expected_updated_at):
    with p.connection() as conn,p.cursor(conn) as cur:
        row=p.require(p.one(cur,'SELECT updated_at FROM paper_trade.journals WHERE id=%s FOR UPDATE',(journal_id,)),'日記')
        if expected_updated_at != row['updated_at']: raise ValueError('日記已在其他視窗修改，請重新開啟後再刪除')
        cur.execute('DELETE FROM paper_trade.journals WHERE id=%s',(journal_id,));conn.commit();return {'deleted':journal_id}

def render_markdown(body):
    # Raw HTML disabled, unsafe URL protocols rejected by markdown-it.
    from markdown_it import MarkdownIt
    from html import escape
    from dashboard.journal_media import local_video_url
    md=MarkdownIt('commonmark',{'html':False,'breaks':True}).enable(['table','strikethrough'])
    default_image=md.renderer.rules['image']
    def image_rule(tokens, idx, options, env):
        token=tokens[idx]; src=token.attrGet('src') or ''
        if local_video_url(src):
            safe=escape(src,quote=True)
            return f'<video controls preload="metadata" playsinline src="{safe}"></video>'
        return default_image(tokens,idx,options,env)
    md.renderer.rules['image']=image_rule
    return md.render(body)

from typing import Literal
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import date
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, ConfigDict
from dashboard import paper_trade_service as service

router=APIRouter(prefix='/api/paper-trade',tags=['Historical simulation'])

class Strict(BaseModel):
    model_config=ConfigDict(extra='forbid')

class Account(Strict):
    name:str=Field(min_length=1,max_length=80)
    initial_equity:Decimal=Field(default=1000000,gt=0,le=10**14,max_digits=18,decimal_places=2)
    fee_tx:Decimal=Field(default=50,ge=0,le=10000,decimal_places=2)
    fee_mtx:Decimal=Field(default=30,ge=0,le=10000,decimal_places=2)
    fee_tmf:Decimal=Field(default=15,ge=0,le=10000,decimal_places=2)
    slippage:int=Field(default=0,ge=0,le=1000)

class Run(Strict):
    account_id:int=Field(gt=0)
    market:Literal['tx_day','tx_night']
    contract:str=Field(pattern=r'^\d{6}$')
    start:str
    end:str

class Action(Strict):
    action:Literal['sync','order','cancel','close','close_all']
    tick_id:str=Field(pattern=r'^\d{1,19}$')
    client_at:str
    clock_ms:float=Field(ge=0,allow_inf_nan=False)
    request_id:str|None=None
    item_id:int|None=Field(default=None,gt=0)
    product:Literal['TX','MTX','TMF']='TX'
    direction:Literal['LONG','SHORT']='LONG'
    quantity:int=Field(default=1,ge=1,le=1000)
    order_type:Literal['MARKET','LIMIT','STOP']='MARKET'
    time_in_force:Literal['ROD','IOC','FOK']|None=None
    trigger_direction:Literal['ABOVE','BELOW']|None=None
    position_effect:Literal['AUTO','OPEN','CLOSE']='OPEN'
    target:Decimal|None=Field(default=None,gt=0,le=1000000,decimal_places=4)
    stop_loss:Decimal|None=Field(default=None,gt=0,le=1000000,decimal_places=4)
    take_profit:Decimal|None=Field(default=None,gt=0,le=1000000,decimal_places=4)


def call(fn,*args):
    try: return fn(*args)
    except ValueError as e: raise HTTPException(400,str(e)) from e
    except Exception as e:
        state=getattr(e,'sqlstate',None)
        if state in ('3F000','42P01','42703'): raise HTTPException(503,'尚未安裝模擬交易資料表，請執行 setup_paper_trade.py。') from e
        if state=='23505': raise HTTPException(409,'名稱或識別碼重複。') from e
        if state=='23514': raise HTTPException(400,'交易資料未通過資料庫檢核。') from e
        raise

@router.get('/accounts')
def get_accounts(): return call(service.accounts)
@router.post('/accounts')
def post_account(data:Account): return call(service.save_account,data.model_dump())
@router.put('/accounts/{account_id}')
def put_account(account_id:int,data:Account): return call(service.save_account,data.model_dump(),account_id)
@router.get('/runs')
def get_runs(account_id:int=Query(gt=0),market:str|None=None,contract:str|None=None,start:str|None=None,end:str|None=None):
    if market is not None and not all((contract,start,end)): raise HTTPException(400,'請提供完整回放條件')
    return call(service.run_list,account_id,market,contract,start,end)
@router.post('/runs')
def post_run(data:Run): return call(service.create_run,data.model_dump())
@router.post('/runs/{run_id}/action')
def post_action(run_id:int,data:Action):
    if data.action=='order' and not data.request_id: raise HTTPException(400,'缺少委託識別碼')
    if data.action in ('cancel','close') and data.item_id is None: raise HTTPException(400,'缺少委託／交易識別碼')
    return call(service.execute_action,run_id,data.model_dump())
@router.get('/performance')
def get_performance(account_id:int=Query(gt=0),run_id:int|None=None): return call(service.performance,account_id,run_id)
@router.delete('/trades/{trade_id}')
def delete_trade(trade_id:int): return call(service.delete_trade,trade_id)

"""Local historical simulation. All fills use the exact TX tick selected by replay.
No broker connection. Other products are hypothetical TX-price scenarios.
"""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from uuid import UUID
from dashboard import replay_service as replay

D = Decimal
PRODUCTS = {'TX': 200, 'MTX': 50, 'TMF': 10}
TAX = D('0.00002')
DEFAULT_FEES = {'TX': D(50), 'MTX': D(30), 'TMF': D(15)}


def dec(value):
    return D(str(value))


def money(value):
    return dec(value).quantize(D('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)


def costs(entry, exit, direction, qty, fees, tax_rate=TAX):
    """Round estimated tax per contract/side to NTD; fees are per contract/side."""
    entry, exit = dec(entry), dec(exit)
    points = (exit-entry)*(1 if direction == 'LONG' else -1)
    result = {}
    for product, multiplier in PRODUCTS.items():
        fee = money(dec(fees[product])*2*qty)
        tax = sum((p*multiplier*dec(tax_rate)).quantize(D('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP) for p in (entry,exit))*qty
        gross = money(points*multiplier*qty)
        result[product] = dict(points=points, gross=gross, fee=fee, tax=tax, net=gross-fee-tax)
    return result


def slipped(price, direction, slippage, closing=False):
    sign = (1 if direction=='LONG' else -1)*(-1 if closing else 1)
    return dec(price)+sign*slippage


def triggered(kind, direction, target, price, trigger_direction=None):
    if kind == "MARKET": return True
    price, target = dec(price), dec(target)
    if kind == 'LIMIT': return price<=target if direction=='LONG' else price>=target
    if kind == 'STOP': return price>=target if (trigger_direction or ('ABOVE' if direction=='LONG' else 'BELOW'))=='ABOVE' else price<=target
    return True


def normalize_tif(kind, tif=None):
    tif = tif or ('ROD' if kind == 'LIMIT' else 'IOC')
    if tif not in ('ROD','IOC','FOK') or (kind != 'LIMIT' and tif == 'ROD'):
        raise ValueError('市價及觸價市價僅支援 IOC 或 FOK')
    return tif


def initial_order_decision(kind, direction, target, price, tif, trigger_direction=None):
    # No order book: an eligible tick fills all requested lots in this model.
    # STOP is a conditional order; TIF applies only after activation.
    if kind == 'MARKET' or triggered(kind, direction, target, price, trigger_direction):
        return 'FILL'
    if kind == 'STOP' or tif == 'ROD':
        return 'WAIT'
    return 'CANCEL'


def cancel_pending(cur, order_id, clock, wall, reason):
    cur.execute("UPDATE paper_trade.orders SET status='CANCELLED',cancelled_at=%s,cancelled_client_at=%s,cancel_reason=%s WHERE id=%s AND status='PENDING'",(clock,wall,reason,order_id))


def expire_run_orders(cur, run, clock, wall):
    if clock >= run['end_at']:
        cur.execute("UPDATE paper_trade.orders SET status='CANCELLED',cancelled_at=%s,cancelled_client_at=%s,cancel_reason=%s WHERE run_id=%s AND status='PENDING'",(run['end_at'],wall,'回放時段結束',run['id']))


def exit_trigger(order, price):
    p=dec(price); long=order['direction']=='LONG'
    stop, take=order['stop_loss'],order['take_profit']
    if stop is not None and (p<=stop if long else p>=stop): return 'STOP_LOSS'
    if take is not None and (p>=take if long else p<=take): return 'TAKE_PROFIT'
    return None


def bracket_valid(direction, reference, stop, take):
    ref=dec(reference); long=direction=='LONG'
    if stop is not None and not (dec(stop)<ref if long else dec(stop)>ref): raise ValueError('停損須在預計進場價的虧損方向')
    if take is not None and not (dec(take)>ref if long else dec(take)<ref): raise ValueError('停利須在預計進場價的獲利方向')


def connection():
    from common import db
    return db.get_connection()


def cursor(conn):
    from psycopg.rows import dict_row
    return conn.cursor(row_factory=dict_row)


def one(cur, sql, args=()):
    cur.execute(sql,args); return cur.fetchone()


def many(cur, sql, args=()):
    cur.execute(sql,args); return cur.fetchall()


def require(row, label):
    if not row: raise ValueError(label+'不存在')
    return row


def client_time(value):
    try: t=datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace('Z','+00:00'))
    except (ValueError,AttributeError): raise ValueError('無效的電腦時間')
    if t.tzinfo is None: raise ValueError('電腦時間必須包含時區')
    return t


def account_values(data):
    name=data['name'].strip()
    if not 1<=len(name)<=80: raise ValueError('帳號名稱須為 1–80 字')
    return (name,data['initial_equity'],data['fee_tx'],data['fee_mtx'],data['fee_tmf'],data['slippage'])


def accounts():
    with connection() as conn, cursor(conn) as cur:
        return many(cur,'SELECT * FROM paper_trade.accounts ORDER BY id')


def save_account(data, account_id=None):
    args=account_values(data)
    with connection() as conn, cursor(conn) as cur:
        if account_id is None:
            row=one(cur,'''INSERT INTO paper_trade.accounts(name,initial_equity,fee_tx,fee_mtx,fee_tmf,slippage)
                VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) ON CONFLICT(name) DO NOTHING RETURNING *''',args)
        else:
            row=one(cur,'''UPDATE paper_trade.accounts SET name=%s,initial_equity=%s,fee_tx=%s,fee_mtx=%s,fee_tmf=%s,slippage=%s
                WHERE id=%s RETURNING *''',(*args,account_id))
        if not row: raise ValueError('帳號已存在或不存在')
        conn.commit(); return row


def run_list(account_id, market=None, contract=None, start=None, end=None):
    with connection() as conn, cursor(conn) as cur:
        if market is None: return many(cur,'SELECT * FROM paper_trade.runs WHERE account_id=%s ORDER BY id DESC',(account_id,))
        a,b=replay.parse_time(start),replay.parse_time(end)
        return many(cur,'''SELECT * FROM paper_trade.runs WHERE account_id=%s AND market=%s AND contract=%s AND start_at=%s AND end_at=%s ORDER BY id DESC''',(account_id,market,contract,a,b))


def create_run(data):
    market,contract=data['market'],data['contract']; a,b=replay.parse_time(data['start']),replay.parse_time(data['end'])
    if market not in ('tx_day','tx_night'): raise ValueError('只支援 TX 逐筆回放')
    replay.validate(market,'TAIEX',contract,5); replay.validate_range(market,a,b)
    with connection() as conn, cursor(conn) as cur:
        require(one(cur,'SELECT id FROM paper_trade.accounts WHERE id=%s',(data['account_id'],)),'帳號')
        run=one(cur,'''INSERT INTO paper_trade.runs(account_id,market,contract,start_at,end_at) VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) RETURNING *''',(data['account_id'],market,contract,a,b))
        conn.commit(); return run


def tick_key(t): return (t['trade_datetime'],t['source_row_no'],t['id'])

def run_key(r): return None if r['cursor_id'] is None else (r['cursor_time'],r['cursor_row'],r['cursor_id'])


def get_tick(cur, run, tick_id):
    # Exact row, not the last tick of a second. IDs are strings in JSON to avoid JS precision loss.
    try: tid=int(tick_id)
    except (ValueError,TypeError): raise ValueError('沒有可成交的逐筆行情')
    t=one(cur,'''SELECT id,trade_datetime,source_row_no,price FROM raw_finmind.fm_taiwan_futures_tick
        WHERE id=%s AND futures_id='TX' AND contract_date=%s AND trade_datetime >= %s AND trade_datetime <= %s''',
        (tid,run['contract'],run['start_at'],run['end_at']))
    if not t: raise ValueError('此回放區間的成交資料不存在（原始資料可能已重新匯入，請建立新場次）')
    if not dec(t['price']).is_finite() or dec(t['price'])<=0: raise ValueError('原始成交價無效')
    return t


def lock_run(cur, run_id): return require(one(cur,'SELECT * FROM paper_trade.runs WHERE id=%s FOR UPDATE',(run_id,)),'回放交易場次')


def opposite_positions(cur, order):
    return many(cur, TRADE_SELECT+" WHERE o.run_id=%s AND o.product=%s AND o.direction<>%s AND t.exit_time IS NULL ORDER BY t.entry_time,t.id", (order['run_id'],order['product'],order['direction']))


def allocation_plan(positions, quantity, effect):
    """FIFO allocation, with no new exposure for CLOSE."""
    if effect == 'OPEN': return [], quantity
    available=sum(p['quantity'] for p in positions)
    if effect == 'CLOSE' and available < quantity: raise ValueError('可平倉口數不足；平倉不會反向開新倉')
    remaining=quantity; parts=[]
    for p in positions:
        if not remaining: break
        q=min(remaining,p['quantity']); parts.append((p,q)); remaining-=q
    return parts, remaining


def fill(cur, order, tick, wall, limit=False):
    effect=order.get('position_effect','OPEN')
    positions=opposite_positions(cur,order) if effect!='OPEN' else []
    try: parts, remaining=allocation_plan(positions,order['quantity'],effect)
    except ValueError:
        # A resting close may become invalid after another exit. Cancel instead of opening exposure.
        cur.execute("UPDATE paper_trade.orders SET status='CANCELLED',cancelled_at=%s,cancelled_client_at=%s,cancel_reason=%s WHERE id=%s",(tick['trade_datetime'],wall,'可平倉口數不足',order['id']))
        return
    price=dec(tick['price']) if limit else slipped(tick['price'],order['direction'],order['slippage'])
    if price<=0: raise ValueError('模擬成交價格無效')
    for position,qty in parts:
        close_trade(cur,position,tick,wall,'MANUAL',quantity=qty,price=price,exit_order_id=order['id'])
    if remaining:
        cur.execute('''INSERT INTO paper_trade.trades(order_id,entry_time,entry_tick_id,entry_price,entry_raw_price,entry_client_at,position_quantity)
            VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)''',(order['id'],tick['trade_datetime'],tick['id'],price,dec(tick['price']),wall,remaining))
    cur.execute("UPDATE paper_trade.orders SET status='FILLED' WHERE id=%s",(order['id'],))
    if remaining and (order.get('stop_loss') is not None or order.get('take_profit') is not None):
        position=one(cur,TRADE_SELECT+' WHERE t.order_id=%s AND t.exit_time IS NULL',(order['id'],))
        if position:
            why=exit_trigger(position,tick['price'])
            if why: close_trade(cur,position,tick,wall,why)


def close_trade(cur, trade, tick, wall, reason, quantity=None, price=None, exit_order_id=None):
    price=slipped(tick['price'],trade['direction'],trade['slippage'],True) if price is None else dec(price)
    if price<=0: raise ValueError('模擬平倉價格無效')
    qty=trade['quantity'] if quantity is None else quantity
    if qty<1 or qty>trade['quantity']: raise ValueError('平倉口數無效')
    trade_id=trade['trade_id']
    if qty<trade['quantity']:
        # Preserve the original open row; create a separate immutable closed slice.
        row=one(cur, '''INSERT INTO paper_trade.trades(order_id,entry_time,entry_tick_id,entry_price,entry_raw_price,entry_client_at,entry_server_at,position_quantity)
            SELECT order_id,entry_time,entry_tick_id,entry_price,entry_raw_price,entry_client_at,entry_server_at,%s FROM paper_trade.trades WHERE id=%s AND exit_time IS NULL RETURNING id''',(qty,trade_id))
        cur.execute('UPDATE paper_trade.trades SET position_quantity=%s WHERE id=%s AND exit_time IS NULL',(trade['quantity']-qty,trade_id))
        trade_id=require(row,'部分平倉交易')['id']
    cur.execute('''UPDATE paper_trade.trades SET exit_time=%s,exit_tick_id=%s,exit_price=%s,exit_raw_price=%s,
        exit_client_at=%s,exit_server_at=now(),exit_reason=%s,exit_order_id=%s WHERE id=%s AND exit_time IS NULL''',
        (tick['trade_datetime'],tick['id'],price,dec(tick['price']),wall,reason,exit_order_id,trade_id))


TRADE_SELECT='''SELECT t.*,t.id AS trade_id,o.run_id,o.product,o.direction,COALESCE(t.position_quantity,o.quantity) AS quantity,o.stop_loss,o.take_profit,
 o.fee_tx,o.fee_mtx,o.fee_tmf,o.slippage,o.tax_rate,o.order_type,o.target,o.submitted_at,o.submitted_clock_at,o.submitted_client_at,o.submitted_server_at,
 r.account_id,r.market,r.contract,r.start_at,r.end_at FROM paper_trade.trades t JOIN paper_trade.orders o ON o.id=t.order_id JOIN paper_trade.runs r ON r.id=o.run_id'''


def advance(cur, run, tick, wall):
    old=run_key(run); new=tick_key(tick)
    if old is not None and new<old: raise ValueError('目前已倒回已交易時間之前。請回到原進度，或建立新場次重新練習。')
    if old==new: return
    if old is not None:
        # A source-date reimport can replace tick IDs; do not silently resume a changed tape.
        prior=get_tick(cur,run,old[2])
        if tick_key(prior)!=old: raise ValueError('原始行情已變更，請建立新場次。')
    pending=many(cur,"SELECT * FROM paper_trade.orders WHERE run_id=%s AND status='PENDING' ORDER BY id",(run['id'],))
    positions=many(cur,TRADE_SELECT+' WHERE o.run_id=%s AND t.exit_time IS NULL ORDER BY t.id',(run['id'],))
    protective=[p for p in positions if p['stop_loss'] is not None or p['take_profit'] is not None]
    if old is not None and (pending or protective):
        # Process every intermediate trade, even if the chart skipped frames at 300x.
        # Server-side cursor is monotonic and serialized by row lock.
        rows=many(cur,'''SELECT id,trade_datetime,source_row_no,price FROM raw_finmind.fm_taiwan_futures_tick
           WHERE futures_id='TX' AND contract_date=%s AND (trade_datetime,source_row_no,id)>(%s,%s,%s)
           AND (trade_datetime,source_row_no,id)<=(%s,%s,%s) ORDER BY trade_datetime,source_row_no,id''',
           (run['contract'],*old,*new))
        for t in rows:
            if not pending and not protective: break
            for p in protective[:]:
                why=exit_trigger(p,t['price'])
                if why:
                    close_trade(cur,p,t,wall,why); protective.remove(p)
            for o in pending[:]:
                if triggered(o['order_type'],o['direction'],o['target'],t['price'],o.get('trigger_direction')):
                    fill(cur,o,t,wall,o['order_type']=='LIMIT'); pending.remove(o)
                    # Rebuild protection after closing/splitting/opening positions.
                    if o.get('position_effect','OPEN')!='OPEN':
                        protective=many(cur,TRADE_SELECT+' WHERE o.run_id=%s AND t.exit_time IS NULL AND (o.stop_loss IS NOT NULL OR o.take_profit IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY t.id',(run['id'],))
                    elif o['stop_loss'] is not None or o['take_profit'] is not None:
                        p=one(cur,TRADE_SELECT+' WHERE t.order_id=%s AND t.exit_time IS NULL',(o['id'],)); 
                        if p is not None: protective.append(p)
    cur.execute('UPDATE paper_trade.runs SET cursor_time=%s,cursor_row=%s,cursor_id=%s WHERE id=%s',(*new,run['id']))
    run.update(cursor_time=new[0],cursor_row=new[1],cursor_id=new[2])


def fee_map(row): return {p:row['fee_'+p.lower()] for p in PRODUCTS}


def enrich(row, mark=None):
    row=dict(row); price=row['exit_price'] if row['exit_time'] is not None else (slipped(mark,row['direction'],row['slippage'],True) if mark is not None else None)
    if price is not None:
        row['comparison']=costs(row['entry_price'],price,row['direction'],row['quantity'],fee_map(row),row['tax_rate'])
        row['actual']=row['comparison'][row['product']]
    else: row['comparison']=None; row['actual']=None
    row['tick_points']=None if price is None else (dec(price)-row['entry_price'])*(1 if row['direction']=='LONG' else -1)
    return row


def snapshot(cur, run, mark=None):
    trades=many(cur,TRADE_SELECT+' WHERE o.run_id=%s ORDER BY t.id DESC',(run['id'],))
    orders=many(cur,'SELECT * FROM paper_trade.orders WHERE run_id=%s ORDER BY id DESC',(run['id'],))
    # Never expose a later trade's details in an earlier cursor. Caller disallows rewound snapshots.
    return {'run':{**run,'cursor_id':str(run['cursor_id']) if run['cursor_id'] is not None else None},'mark':mark,'trades':[enrich(t,mark) for t in trades], 'orders':orders}


def execute_action(run_id, data):
    wall=client_time(data['client_at']); action=data['action']
    with connection() as conn, cursor(conn) as cur:
        run=lock_run(cur,run_id); tick=get_tick(cur,run,data['tick_id'])
        try: clock=datetime.fromtimestamp(data['clock_ms']/1000,replay.TZ).replace(tzinfo=None)
        except (ValueError,OverflowError,OSError,TypeError): raise ValueError('回放時鐘無效')
        if not run['start_at']<=clock<=run['end_at'] or clock+timedelta(microseconds=1)<tick['trade_datetime']: raise ValueError('回放時鐘與成交時間不一致')
        clock=max(clock,tick['trade_datetime'])
        # A repeat of the same request must not create another order.
        if action=='order':
            request_id=UUID(data['request_id'])
            existing=one(cur,'SELECT id,run_id FROM paper_trade.orders WHERE request_id=%s',(request_id,))
            if existing and existing['run_id']!=run_id: raise ValueError('委託識別碼已被使用')
        advance(cur,run,tick,wall)
        if action=='order' and not existing:
            a=require(one(cur,'SELECT * FROM paper_trade.accounts WHERE id=%s',(run['account_id'],)),'帳號')
            kind=data['order_type']; direction=data['direction']; target=data.get('target'); stop=data.get('stop_loss'); take=data.get('take_profit')
            ref=slipped(tick['price'],direction,a['slippage']) if kind=='MARKET' else target
            if kind!='MARKET' and target is None: raise ValueError('請輸入委託點位')
            if clock >= run['end_at']: raise ValueError('回放時段已結束，不可新增委託')
            tif=normalize_tif(kind,data.get('time_in_force'))
            effect=data.get('position_effect','OPEN')
            if effect=='CLOSE':
                if stop is not None or take is not None: raise ValueError('平倉委託不可附加新倉停損停利')
                allocation_plan(opposite_positions(cur,dict(run_id=run_id,product=data['product'],direction=direction)),data['quantity'],effect)
            else: bracket_valid(direction,ref,stop,take)
            trigger_direction=data.get('trigger_direction') if kind=='STOP' else None
            if kind=='STOP': trigger_direction=trigger_direction or ('ABOVE' if direction=='LONG' else 'BELOW')
            if kind=='MARKET': target=None
            order=one(cur,'''INSERT INTO paper_trade.orders(run_id,request_id,product,direction,quantity,order_type,target,stop_loss,take_profit,position_effect,time_in_force,trigger_direction,status,
              submitted_at,submitted_tick_id,submitted_clock_at,submitted_client_at,fee_tx,fee_mtx,fee_tmf,slippage,tax_rate)
              VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,'PENDING',%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) RETURNING *''',
              (run_id,request_id,data['product'],direction,data['quantity'],kind,target,stop,take,effect,tif,trigger_direction,tick['trade_datetime'],tick['id'],clock,wall,a['fee_tx'],a['fee_mtx'],a['fee_tmf'],a['slippage'],TAX))
            # Market: immediate known tick. Marketable limit/stop: immediate known tick, no queue model.
            decision=initial_order_decision(kind,direction,target,tick['price'],tif,trigger_direction)
            if decision=='FILL': fill(cur,order,tick,wall,kind=='LIMIT')
            elif decision=='CANCEL': cancel_pending(cur,order['id'],clock,wall,tif+'：當下價格不符合限價')
        elif action=='cancel':
            cur.execute("UPDATE paper_trade.orders SET status='CANCELLED',cancelled_at=%s,cancelled_client_at=%s WHERE id=%s AND run_id=%s AND status='PENDING'",(clock,wall,data['item_id'],run_id))
            if not cur.rowcount: raise ValueError('委託已成交、已取消或不存在')
        elif action in ('close','close_all'):
            args=(run_id,) if action=='close_all' else (run_id,data['item_id'])
            trades=many(cur,TRADE_SELECT+' WHERE o.run_id=%s AND t.exit_time IS NULL'+('' if action=='close_all' else ' AND t.id=%s'),args)
            if not trades: raise ValueError('沒有可平倉部位')
            for p in trades: close_trade(cur,p,tick,wall,'MANUAL')
        expire_run_orders(cur,run,clock,wall)
        result=snapshot(cur,run,dec(tick['price'])); conn.commit(); return result


def delete_trade(trade_id):
    with connection() as conn,cursor(conn) as cur:
        row=require(one(cur,TRADE_SELECT+' WHERE t.id=%s',(trade_id,)),'交易')
        lock_run(cur,row['run_id'])
        # Delete only the selected execution slice; sibling lots and order audit survive.
        cur.execute('DELETE FROM paper_trade.trades WHERE id=%s',(trade_id,)); conn.commit(); return {'deleted':trade_id}


def statistics(trades, equity, product=None):
    seq=sorted((t for t in trades if t['exit_time'] is not None),key=lambda t:(t['exit_server_at'],t['id']))
    vals=[t['comparison'][product] if product else t['actual'] for t in seq]
    nets=[v['net'] for v in vals]; wins=[x for x in nets if x>0]; losses=[x for x in nets if x<0]
    total=sum(nets,D(0)); running=dec(equity); peak=running; dd=D(0); curve=[]
    for t,n in zip(seq,nets):
        running+=n; peak=max(peak,running); dd=max(dd,peak-running)
        curve.append({'trade_id':t['id'],'time':t['exit_server_at'],'historical_time':t['exit_time'],'equity':running})
    return {'count':len(vals),'wins':len(wins),'losses':len(losses),'breakeven':len(vals)-len(wins)-len(losses),
        'win_rate':len(wins)/len(vals)*100 if vals else None,'gross':sum((v['gross'] for v in vals),D(0)),
        'fee':sum((v['fee'] for v in vals),D(0)),'tax':sum((v['tax'] for v in vals),D(0)), 'net':total,
        'avg':total/len(vals) if vals else None,'profit_factor':sum(wins)/abs(sum(losses)) if losses else None,
        'max_drawdown':dd,'equity':running,'return_pct':total/dec(equity)*100,'curve':curve}


def performance(account_id, run_id=None):
    with connection() as conn,cursor(conn) as cur:
        a=require(one(cur,'SELECT * FROM paper_trade.accounts WHERE id=%s',(account_id,)),'帳號')
        sql=TRADE_SELECT+' WHERE r.account_id=%s'; args=(account_id,)
        if run_id is not None: sql+=' AND r.id=%s'; args+=(run_id,)
        rows=many(cur,sql+' ORDER BY t.id DESC',args)
        trades=[enrich(t) for t in rows]; equity=a['initial_equity']
        return {'account':a,'trades':trades,'actual':statistics(trades,equity),
                'comparison':{p:statistics(trades,equity,p) for p in PRODUCTS},'open_count':sum(t['exit_time'] is None for t in trades)}

"""Install and verify the paper trade schema against the Dashboard database."""
from pathlib import Path
from common import db

REQUIRED = {"orders": {"position_effect", "time_in_force", "cancel_reason", "trigger_direction"},
            "trades": {"position_quantity", "exit_order_id"},
            "journals": {"id", "title", "body", "journal_date", "updated_at"},
            "journal_links": {"journal_id", "account_id", "run_id", "trade_id", "historical_date", "entry_order_id"}}


def main():
    try:
        import markdown_it  # noqa: F401
        import PIL  # noqa: F401
    except ImportError as exc:
        raise RuntimeError('Install Markdown dependency: python -m pip install "markdown-it-py>=3.0,<5" "Pillow>=11.3,<13"') from exc
    sql = (Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "dashboard" / "sql" / "paper_trade.sql").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    with db.get_connection() as conn:
        conn.commit()
        conn.autocommit = True
        print("Database:", conn.execute("SELECT current_database()").fetchone()[0])
        try:
            conn.execute(sql, prepare=False)
        except Exception:
            conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise
        rows = conn.execute("SELECT table_name, column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'paper_trade'").fetchall()
        found = {(table, column) for table, column in rows}
        missing = sorted((table, column) for table, columns in REQUIRED.items() for column in columns if (table, column) not in found)
        if missing:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Missing schema columns: {missing}")
        legacy = [(t,c) for t,c in found if t in ("runs","trades") and c in ("note","note_updated_at")]
        if legacy: raise RuntimeError(f"Legacy note columns remain: {legacy}")
        # A unique constraint on order_id would prevent partial position splits.
        old_unique = conn.execute("""SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.conrelid AND a.attnum=c.conkey[1] WHERE c.conrelid='paper_trade.trades'::regclass AND c.contype='u' AND cardinality(c.conkey)=1 AND a.attname='order_id'""").fetchone()
        if old_unique:
            raise RuntimeError("Legacy UNIQUE(order_id) remains; partial closing cannot work.")
        conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(t.position_quantity,o.quantity), t.exit_order_id, o.position_effect, o.time_in_force, o.cancel_reason, o.trigger_direction FROM paper_trade.trades t JOIN paper_trade.orders o ON o.id=t.order_id LIMIT 0")
        conn.execute("SELECT entry_order_id FROM paper_trade.journal_link_details LIMIT 0")
        print("Verified: position fields, time_in_force, trigger_direction, journal opening-order links.")
        print("paper_trade schema ready. Existing market and backtest tables were not changed.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
    from dashboard.journal_media import media_root
    print("Journal media:", media_root())

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from dashboard import journal_media as m
from dashboard.journal_service import render_markdown
import pytest
from io import BytesIO
from PIL import Image

def png():
    out=BytesIO(); Image.new("RGB",(2,2)).save(out,format="PNG"); return out.getvalue()
PNG=png()
VIDEO=b"\x00\x00\x00\x18ftypisom0123456789"

@pytest.fixture
def client(tmp_path,monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(m,'ROOT',tmp_path/'journal_media')
    app=FastAPI(); app.include_router(m.router)
    return TestClient(app)

def upload(client,name,data=PNG):
    return client.post('/api/journal-media/upload',params={'filename':name},content=data,headers={'Content-Type':'application/octet-stream'})

def test_upload_list_reuse_and_range(client):
    r=upload(client,'走勢圖.png'); assert r.status_code==200
    image=r.json(); assert image['kind']=='image' and image['display_name']=='走勢圖.png'
    assert client.get(image['url']).content==PNG
    assert '<img' in render_markdown(f'![圖]({image["url"]})')
    video=upload(client,'回放.mp4',VIDEO).json()
    assert '<video controls' in render_markdown(f'![影片]({video["url"]})')
    r=client.get(video['url'],headers={'Range':'bytes=2-4'}); assert r.status_code==206 and r.content==VIDEO[2:5]
    assert r.headers['x-content-type-options']=='nosniff'
    assert len(client.get('/api/journal-media',params={'kind':'video'}).json()['items'])==1
    assert len(client.get('/api/journal-media',params={'keyword':'走勢'}).json()['items'])==1
    duplicate=upload(client,'走勢圖.png').json(); assert duplicate['name']!=image['name']
    assert client.get(image['url']).content==PNG

from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal as D
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, Mock, patch
import pytest
from dashboard import paper_trade_service as p, journal_service as j, journal_media as m
from dashboard.journal_api import Journal, Link
from dashboard.paper_trade_api import Action

NOW=datetime(2026,11,14,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
TICK={'id':1,'source_row_no':1,'trade_datetime':datetime(2026,11,6,9),'price':100}

@pytest.mark.parametrize('side,condition,price,expected',[
    ('LONG','ABOVE',101,True),('LONG','BELOW',99,True),('SHORT','ABOVE',101,True),('SHORT','BELOW',99,True),
    ('LONG','ABOVE',99,False),('LONG','BELOW',101,False),('SHORT','ABOVE',99,False),('SHORT','BELOW',101,False),
])
def test_independent_trigger(side,condition,price,expected):
    assert p.triggered('STOP',side,100,price,condition)==expected
    assert p.initial_order_decision('STOP',side,100,price,'IOC',condition)==('FILL' if expected else 'WAIT')

@pytest.mark.parametrize('side,price,stop,take,reason',[
    ('LONG',90,95,120,'STOP_LOSS'),('SHORT',110,105,80,'STOP_LOSS'),
    ('LONG',125,95,120,'TAKE_PROFIT'),('SHORT',75,105,80,'TAKE_PROFIT'),
    ('LONG',100,95,120,None),('SHORT',100,105,80,None),
])
def test_fill_rechecks_protection_same_tick(side,price,stop,take,reason):
    cur=Mock(); tick={**TICK,'price':price}
    order={'id':1,'run_id':1,'product':'TX','direction':side,'quantity':1,'position_effect':'OPEN','slippage':2,'stop_loss':D(stop),'take_profit':D(take)}
    pos={'trade_id':5,'quantity':1,'direction':side,'slippage':2,'stop_loss':D(stop),'take_profit':D(take)}
    with patch.object(p,'one',return_value=pos),patch.object(p,'close_trade') as close:
        p.fill(cur,order,tick,NOW,limit=True)
        if reason: close.assert_called_once_with(cur,pos,tick,NOW,reason)
        else: close.assert_not_called()
    assert 'FILLED' in cur.execute.call_args.args[0]


def test_group_link_from_open_trade_and_explicit_group_is_deduplicated():

        c.return_value.__enter__.return_value=conn;cc.return_value.__enter__.return_value=cur
        j.save(data)

def test_trade_reverse_lookup_includes_stable_opening_order():
    with patch.object(p,'connection',return_value=MagicMock()),patch.object(p,'cursor',return_value=MagicMock()),patch.object(p,'many',return_value=[]) as m0:
        j.search(trade_id=20,link_kind='trade')
        sql,args=m0.call_args.args[1:]

        assert args==(20,20,51,0)

def tick(i, price, time=None): return dict(id=i,source_row_no=i,trade_datetime=time or t(),price=price)
def run(cursor=None):
    return dict(id=1,contract='202611',start_at=t(),end_at=t(59),cursor_id=None if cursor is None else cursor['id'],cursor_row=None if cursor is None else cursor['source_row_no'],cursor_time=None if cursor is None else cursor['trade_datetime'])


def test_costs_three_products_and_short():
    f=p.DEFAULT_FEES
    out=p.costs(38874,38974,'LONG',1,f)
    assert [out[x]['gross'] for x in p.PRODUCTS]==[D(20000),D(5000),D(1000)]
    assert [out[x]['tax'] for x in p.PRODUCTS]==[D(311),D(78),D(16)]
    assert [out[x]['net'] for x in p.PRODUCTS]==[D(19589),D(4862),D(954)]
    short=p.costs(38974,38874,'SHORT',2,f)
    assert all(short[x]['net']==2*out[x]['net'] for x in p.PRODUCTS)
    loss=p.costs(38874,38874,'LONG',1,f)
    assert all(loss[x]['net']<0 for x in p.PRODUCTS)


def test_slippage_and_trigger_direction():
    assert p.slipped(100,'LONG',2)==102 and p.slipped(100,'LONG',2,True)==98
    assert p.slipped(100,'SHORT',2)==98 and p.slipped(100,'SHORT',2,True)==102
    assert p.triggered('LIMIT','LONG',100,99) and not p.triggered('LIMIT','LONG',100,101)
    assert p.triggered('LIMIT','SHORT',100,101) and not p.triggered('LIMIT','SHORT',100,99)
    assert p.triggered('STOP','LONG',100,101) and not p.triggered('STOP','LONG',100,99)
    assert p.triggered('STOP','SHORT',100,99) and not p.triggered('STOP','SHORT',100,101)
    p.bracket_valid('LONG',100,90,110);p.bracket_valid('SHORT',100,110,90)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): p.bracket_valid('LONG',100,101,None)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): p.bracket_valid('SHORT',100,None,101)
    assert p.exit_trigger(dict(direction='LONG',stop_loss=95,take_profit=105),94)=='STOP_LOSS'
    assert p.exit_trigger(dict(direction='SHORT',stop_loss=105,take_profit=95),94)=='TAKE_PROFIT'

def test_fast_forward_pending_and_protective_every_tick():
    first=tick(1,100); second=tick(2,99); third=tick(3,94); fourth=tick(4,110)
    r=run(first); c=Mock(); wall=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    o=dict(id=20,order_type='LIMIT',direction='LONG',target=D(99),stop_loss=D(95),take_profit=D(105))
    pos=dict(trade_id=30,direction='LONG',stop_loss=D(95),take_profit=D(105))
    with patch.object(p,'get_tick',return_value=first),patch.object(p,'many',side_effect=[[o],[],[second,third,fourth]]) as m,patch.object(p,'one',return_value=pos),patch.object(p,'fill') as fill,patch.object(p,'close_trade') as close:
        p.advance(c,r,fourth,wall)
        fill.assert_called_once_with(c,o,second,wall,True)
        close.assert_called_once_with(c,pos,third,wall,'STOP_LOSS')

    assert r['cursor_id']==4

def test_statistics_closed_only_and_comparison():
    common=dict(product='MTX',direction='LONG',quantity=1,entry_price=D(10000),fee_tx=D(50),fee_mtx=D(30),fee_tmf=D(15),tax_rate=p.TAX,slippage=0)
    rows=[p.enrich(dict(common,id=1,exit_time=t(1),exit_server_at=datetime(2026,11,12,10,tzinfo=timezone.utc),exit_price=D(10100))),p.enrich(dict(common,id=2,exit_time=t(2),exit_server_at=datetime(2026,11,12,11,tzinfo=timezone.utc),exit_price=D(9950))),p.enrich(dict(common,id=3,exit_time=None,exit_price=None))]
    s=p.statistics(rows,D(1000000)); tx=p.statistics(rows,D(1000000),'TX')
    assert s['count']==2 and s['wins']==1 and s['losses']==1 and s['win_rate']==50
    assert s['net']==sum(r['actual']['net'] for r in rows[:2]);assert s['max_drawdown']==-rows[1]['actual']['net']
    assert tx['net']!=s['net'] and s['equity']==D(1000000)+s['net']
    assert p.statistics([],D(1000))['count']==0

檔案：C:\Users\USER\Desktop\Han\學習\金融策略\Invest\code\Invest_safe_update\paths\backtest\futures_open_to_night_close_convergence.py

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


SOURCE_VIEW = "report.v_futures_report_daily_corrected_turning"

GAP_EDGES = [0.0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00, np.inf]
GAP_LABELS = ["0~0.10", "0.10~0.25", "0.25~0.50", "0.50~0.75", "0.75~1.00", "≥1.00"]
RECOVERY_THRESHOLDS = (25, 50, 75, 100)
FIXED_MOVE_THRESHOLDS = (0.10, 0.25, 0.50)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Settings:
    start: date = date(2018, 1, 1)
    end: date | None = None
    futures_id: str = "TX"
    minimum_sample_size: int = 30
    alpha: float = 0.05

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.end and self.start > self.end:
            raise ValueError("start 不可晚於 end")
        if self.minimum_sample_size < 10:
            raise ValueError("minimum_sample_size 不可小於 10")
        if not 0 < self.alpha < 1:
            raise ValueError("alpha 必須介於 0 與 1 之間")


def load_source(settings: Settings) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """保留 end 之後的資料，讓 end 當日可對齊下一個實際交易日。"""
    from common import db

    sql = f'''
        SELECT
            futures_id,
            "日期",
            "日盤開", "日盤高", "日盤低", "日盤收",
            "夜盤收"
        FROM {SOURCE_VIEW}
        WHERE futures_id = ?
          AND "日期" >= ?
        ORDER BY "日期"
    '''
    return db.sql_to_df(
        sql,
        params=(settings.futures_id, settings.start),
        parse_dates=["日期"],
    )


def _safe_pct(numerator: pd.Series, denominator: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    denominator = pd.to_numeric(denominator, errors="coerce").replace(0, np.nan)
    return pd.to_numeric(numerator, errors="coerce").div(denominator) * 100.0


def _anchor_position(day_close: pd.Series, night_close: pd.Series,
                     target: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    low = pd.concat([day_close, night_close], axis=1).min(axis=1)
    high = pd.concat([day_close, night_close], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    between = target.between(low, high, inclusive="both")
    night_above = night_close > day_close
    night_outer = np.where(night_above, target > night_close, target < night_close)
    day_outer = np.where(night_above, target < day_close, target > day_close)
    same_anchor = night_close == day_close
    labels = np.select(
        [same_anchor, between, night_outer, day_outer],
        ["日收等於夜收", "日收與夜收之間", "夜收外側", "日收外側"],
        default="資料不足",
    )
    return pd.Series(labels, index=target.index, dtype="string")


def prepare_detail(source: pd.DataFrame, settings: Settings) -> pd.DataFrame:
    frame = source.sort_values("日期").reset_index(drop=True).copy()
    for column in ["日盤開", "日盤高", "日盤低", "日盤收", "夜盤收"]:
        frame[column] = pd.to_numeric(frame[column], errors="coerce")

    detail = pd.DataFrame({
        "訊號日": frame["日期"],
        "昨日日盤收": frame["日盤收"],
        "昨日夜盤收": frame["夜盤收"],
        "隔日日盤日期": frame["日期"].shift(-1),
        "隔日日盤開": frame["日盤開"].shift(-1),
        "隔日日盤高": frame["日盤高"].shift(-1),
        "隔日日盤低": frame["日盤低"].shift(-1),
        "隔日日盤收": frame["日盤收"].shift(-1),
    })
    date_mask = detail["訊號日"].dt.date >= settings.start
    if settings.end is not None:
        date_mask &= detail["訊號日"].dt.date <= settings.end
    detail = detail[date_mask].copy()

    required = [
        "昨日日盤收", "昨日夜盤收", "隔日日盤日期", "隔日日盤開",
        "隔日日盤高", "隔日日盤低", "隔日日盤收",
    ]
    detail = detail.dropna(subset=required).reset_index(drop=True)

    detail["開盤減夜收_點"] = detail["隔日日盤開"] - detail["昨日夜盤收"]
    detail["開盤距夜收_點"] = detail["開盤減夜收_點"].abs()
    detail["開盤距夜收_pct"] = _safe_pct(
        detail["開盤距夜收_點"], detail["昨日夜盤收"]
    )
    detail["開盤相對夜收"] = np.select(
        [detail["開盤減夜收_點"] > 0, detail["開盤減夜收_點"] < 0],
        ["開在夜收上方", "開在夜收下方"],
        default="開盤等於夜收",
    )
    detail["夜收方向"] = np.select(
        [detail["昨日夜盤收"] > detail["隔日日盤開"],
         detail["昨日夜盤收"] < detail["隔日日盤開"]],
        ["向上", "向下"],
        default="無距離",
    )

    detail["開盤減昨日日收_點"] = detail["隔日日盤開"] - detail["昨日日盤收"]
    detail["開盤距昨日日收_點"] = detail["開盤減昨日日收_點"].abs()
    detail["開盤距昨日日收_pct"] = _safe_pct(
        detail["開盤距昨日日收_點"], detail["昨日日盤收"]
    )
    detail["開盤錨點位置"] = _anchor_position(
        detail["昨日日盤收"], detail["昨日夜盤收"], detail["隔日日盤開"]
    )

    toward_sign = np.sign(detail["昨日夜盤收"] - detail["隔日日盤開"])
    toward_points = np.where(
        toward_sign > 0,
        detail["隔日日盤高"] - detail["隔日日盤開"],
        detail["隔日日盤開"] - detail["隔日日盤低"],
    )
    away_points = np.where(
        toward_sign > 0,
        detail["隔日日盤開"] - detail["隔日日盤低"],
        detail["隔日日盤高"] - detail["隔日日盤開"],
    )
    detail["盤中最大向夜收_點"] = np.maximum(toward_points, 0.0)
    detail["盤中最大背離夜收_點"] = np.maximum(away_points, 0.0)
    detail["盤中最大向夜收_pct"] = _safe_pct(
        detail["盤中最大向夜收_點"], detail["隔日日盤開"]
    )
    detail["盤中最大背離夜收_pct"] = _safe_pct(
        detail["盤中最大背離夜收_點"], detail["隔日日盤開"]
    )
    detail["盤中收回原始距離_pct"] = _safe_pct(
        detail["盤中最大向夜收_點"], detail["開盤距夜收_點"]
    )
    detail["盤中向夜收幅度大於背離幅度"] = (
        detail["盤中最大向夜收_點"] > detail["盤中最大背離夜收_點"]
    )

    close_points = toward_sign * (detail["隔日日盤收"] - detail["隔日日盤開"])
    detail["收盤向夜收移動_點"] = close_points
    detail["收盤向夜收移動_pct"] = _safe_pct(close_points, detail["隔日日盤開"])
    detail["收盤收回原始距離_pct"] = _safe_pct(
        close_points, detail["開盤距夜收_點"]
    )
    detail["收盤往夜收方向"] = close_points > 0
    detail["收盤比開盤更接近夜收"] = (
        (detail["隔日日盤收"] - detail["昨日夜盤收"]).abs()
        < detail["開盤距夜收_點"]
    )
    detail["收盤抵達或越過夜收"] = detail["收盤收回原始距離_pct"] >= 100.0

    for threshold in RECOVERY_THRESHOLDS:
        detail[f"盤中收回至少{threshold}pct"] = (
            detail["盤中收回原始距離_pct"] >= threshold
        )
    for threshold in FIXED_MOVE_THRESHOLDS:
        label = f"{threshold:.2f}"
        detail[f"盤中向夜收至少{label}pct"] = (
            detail["盤中最大向夜收_pct"] >= threshold
        )

    detail["開盤距夜收桶"] = pd.cut(
        detail["開盤距夜收_pct"], GAP_EDGES, labels=GAP_LABELS,
        right=False, ordered=True,
    )
    detail["開盤距昨日日收桶"] = pd.cut(
        detail["開盤距昨日日收_pct"], GAP_EDGES, labels=GAP_LABELS,
        right=False, ordered=True,
    )

    # 開盤等於夜收時沒有「往夜收方向」，不納入收束研究。
    detail = detail[detail["開盤距夜收_點"] > 0].copy()
    return detail.reset_index(drop=True)


def _rate(group: pd.DataFrame, column: str) -> float:
    return float(group[column].mean() * 100.0) if len(group) else math.nan


def _summary_row(keys: dict[str, object], group: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, object]:
    row: dict[str, object] = {
        **keys,
        "樣本數": len(group),
        "開盤距夜收平均_pct": group["開盤距夜收_pct"].mean(),
        "開盤距夜收中位數_pct": group["開盤距夜收_pct"].median(),
        "盤中最大向夜收平均_pct": group["盤中最大向夜收_pct"].mean(),
        "盤中最大向夜收中位數_pct": group["盤中最大向夜收_pct"].median(),
        "盤中收回原始距離中位數_pct": group["盤中收回原始距離_pct"].median(),
        "盤中向夜收幅度大於背離幅度_pct": _rate(
            group, "盤中向夜收幅度大於背離幅度"
        ),
        "收盤往夜收方向_pct": _rate(group, "收盤往夜收方向"),
        "收盤比開盤更接近夜收_pct": _rate(group, "收盤比開盤更接近夜收"),
        "收盤抵達或越過夜收_pct": _rate(group, "收盤抵達或越過夜收"),
        "收盤向夜收平均移動_pct": group["收盤向夜收移動_pct"].mean(),
        "收盤向夜收中位移動_pct": group["收盤向夜收移動_pct"].median(),
        "收盤收回原始距離中位數_pct": group["收盤收回原始距離_pct"].median(),
    }
    for threshold in RECOVERY_THRESHOLDS:
        row[f"盤中收回至少{threshold}pct_機率"] = _rate(
            group, f"盤中收回至少{threshold}pct"
        )
    for threshold in FIXED_MOVE_THRESHOLDS:
        label = f"{threshold:.2f}"
        row[f"盤中向夜收至少{label}pct_機率"] = _rate(
            group, f"盤中向夜收至少{label}pct"
        )
    return row


def summarize(detail: pd.DataFrame, group_columns: list[str],
              minimum_sample_size: int = 1) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    work = detail.dropna(subset=group_columns)
    grouper = group_columns[0] if len(group_columns) == 1 else group_columns
    for key, group in work.groupby(grouper, observed=True, sort=False):
        if len(group) < minimum_sample_size:
            continue
        values = (key,) if len(group_columns) == 1 else key
        rows.append(_summary_row(dict(zip(group_columns, values)), group))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def build_night_gap_summary(detail: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    overall = summarize(detail, ["開盤距夜收桶"])
    if len(overall):
        overall.insert(0, "分層類型", "距離")
        overall.insert(1, "開盤相對夜收", "全部")
    directional = summarize(detail, ["開盤相對夜收", "開盤距夜收桶"])
    if len(directional):
        directional.insert(0, "分層類型", "方向×距離")
    return pd.concat([overall, directional], ignore_index=True, sort=False)


def build_anchor_position_summary(detail: pd.DataFrame,
                                  minimum_sample_size: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return summarize(
        detail,
        ["開盤錨點位置", "開盤距夜收桶"],
        minimum_sample_size,
    )


def build_gap_matrix(detail: pd.DataFrame,
                     minimum_sample_size: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return summarize(
        detail,
        ["開盤距夜收桶", "開盤距昨日日收桶"],
        minimum_sample_size,
    )


def build_yearly(detail: pd.DataFrame, minimum_sample_size: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    work = detail.copy()
    work["年"] = pd.to_datetime(work["訊號日"]).dt.year
    return summarize(work, ["年", "開盤距夜收桶"], minimum_sample_size)


def _bh_adjust(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    result = pd.Series(np.nan, index=series.index, dtype=float)
    clean = pd.to_numeric(series, errors="coerce").dropna().sort_values()
    if clean.empty:
        return result
    adjusted = (clean * len(clean) / np.arange(1, len(clean) + 1))[::-1].cummin()[::-1]
    result.loc[clean.index] = adjusted.clip(upper=1.0)
    return result


def build_statistical_tests(detail: pd.DataFrame, settings: Settings) -> pd.DataFrame:
    from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency, kruskal, spearmanr

    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    metrics = [
        ("盤中最大向夜收_pct", "盤中向夜收絕對幅度"),
        ("盤中收回原始距離_pct", "盤中收回原始距離比例"),
        ("收盤向夜收移動_pct", "收盤向夜收移動幅度"),
        ("收盤收回原始距離_pct", "收盤收回原始距離比例"),
        ("收盤往夜收方向", "收盤往夜收方向"),
    ]
    scopes = [("全部", detail)] + [
        (str(name), group)
        for name, group in detail.groupby("開盤相對夜收", observed=True)
    ]
    for scope, frame in scopes:
        for column, label in metrics:
            pair = frame[["開盤距夜收_pct", column]].dropna()
            if len(pair) < settings.minimum_sample_size:
                continue
            rho, p_value = spearmanr(pair["開盤距夜收_pct"], pair[column])
            rows.append({
                "檢定類型": "Spearman距離趨勢",
                "範圍": scope,
                "開盤距夜收桶": "全部",
                "結果指標": label,
                "樣本數": len(pair),
                "統計值": rho,
                "p值": p_value,
                "說明": "正值代表開盤距夜收越遠，該收束指標傾向越高",
            })

    usable_positions = ["夜收外側", "日收與夜收之間", "日收外側"]
    for bucket, frame in detail.groupby("開盤距夜收桶", observed=True):
        groups = [
            group for name, group in frame.groupby("開盤錨點位置", observed=True)
            if name in usable_positions and len(group) >= settings.minimum_sample_size
        ]
        if len(groups) < 2:
            continue
        values = [group["盤中收回原始距離_pct"].dropna() for group in groups]
        values = [value for value in values if len(value) >= settings.minimum_sample_size]
        if len(values) >= 2:
            statistic, p_value = kruskal(*values)
            rows.append({
                "檢定類型": "Kruskal位置差異",
                "範圍": "開盤錨點位置",
                "開盤距夜收桶": str(bucket),
                "結果指標": "盤中收回原始距離比例",
                "樣本數": sum(map(len, values)),
                "統計值": statistic,
                "p值": p_value,
                "說明": "相同夜收距離桶內，比較開盤相對昨日日收的位置",
            })

        table = []
        for group in groups:
            success = int(group["收盤往夜收方向"].sum())
            table.append([success, len(group) - success])
        if len(table) >= 2 and all(sum(row) > 0 for row in table):
            statistic, p_value, _, _ = chi2_contingency(table)
            rows.append({
                "檢定類型": "卡方位置差異",
                "範圍": "開盤錨點位置",
                "開盤距夜收桶": str(bucket),
                "結果指標": "收盤往夜收方向",
                "樣本數": sum(map(sum, table)),
                "統計值": statistic,
                "p值": p_value,
                "說明": "相同夜收距離桶內，比較開盤相對昨日日收的位置",
            })

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if len(result):
        result["FDR_q值"] = _bh_adjust(result["p值"])
        result["FDR顯著"] = result["FDR_q值"] < settings.alpha
        result = result.sort_values(["FDR顯著", "FDR_q值"], ascending=[False, True])
    return result.reset_index(drop=True)


def export_reports(detail: pd.DataFrame, night_gap: pd.DataFrame,
                   anchor_position: pd.DataFrame, gap_matrix: pd.DataFrame,
                   yearly: pd.DataFrame, tests: pd.DataFrame,
                   settings: Settings, output_dir: Path) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    end_value = settings.end or pd.to_datetime(detail["訊號日"]).max().date()
    suffix = f"{settings.start:%Y%m%d}_{end_value:%Y%m%d}"
    paths = (
        output_dir / f"open_night_convergence_detail_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"open_night_convergence_by_gap_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"open_night_convergence_by_anchor_position_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"open_night_convergence_gap_matrix_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"open_night_convergence_yearly_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"open_night_convergence_tests_{suffix}.csv",
        output_dir / f"open_night_convergence_manifest_{suffix}.json",
    )
    frames = (detail, night_gap, anchor_position, gap_matrix, yearly, tests)
    for frame, path in zip(frames, paths[:6]):
        frame.to_csv(path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

    manifest = {
        "settings": {
            **asdict(settings),
            "start": settings.start.isoformat(),
            "end": settings.end.isoformat() if settings.end else None,
        },
        "source_view": SOURCE_VIEW,
        "date_alignment": "訊號日之後下一個實際存在的交易日",
        "research_question": "隔日日盤開盤距離昨日夜盤收越遠時，盤中與收盤是否更傾向往夜盤收方向移動",
        "night_gap": "abs(隔日日盤開-昨日夜盤收)/昨日夜盤收*100",
        "intraday_toward": "夜收在開盤上方使用日盤高-開盤；夜收在開盤下方使用開盤-日盤低",
        "intraday_recovery_ratio": "盤中最大向夜收點數/開盤距夜收點數*100；100%代表曾觸及或越過夜收",
        "close_toward": "sign(夜收-開盤)*(日盤收-開盤)；正值代表收盤往夜收方向",
        "close_recovery_ratio": "收盤向夜收移動點數/開盤距夜收點數*100，可為負數或超過100%",
        "closer_at_close": "abs(日盤收-夜盤收) < abs(日盤開-夜盤收)",
        "anchor_position": "隔日開盤相對昨日日盤收與昨日夜盤收的位置",
        "multiple_testing": "所有統計檢定一起使用Benjamini-Hochberg FDR校正",
        "ohlc_limit": "日K可衡量最大向夜收與背離幅度，但無法判斷兩者發生先後；加入停損需改用分鐘K",
    }
    paths[6].write_text(
        json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    return paths


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="隔日日盤開盤向昨日夜盤收方向收束回測")
    parser.add_argument("--start", type=date.fromisoformat, default=date(2018, 1, 1))
    parser.add_argument("--end", type=date.fromisoformat)
    parser.add_argument("--futures-id", default="TX")
    parser.add_argument("--minimum-sample-size", type=int, default=30)
    parser.add_argument("--alpha", type=float, default=0.05)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-dir", type=Path,
        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "output/backtest/futures_open_to_night_close_convergence",
    )
    return parser.parse_args()


def main() -> None:
    args = parse_args()
    settings = Settings(
        args.start, args.end, args.futures_id, args.minimum_sample_size, args.alpha
    )
    detail = prepare_detail(load_source(settings), settings)
    if detail.empty:
        raise SystemExit("查無完整有效資料")
    night_gap = build_night_gap_summary(detail)
    anchor_position = build_anchor_position_summary(
        detail, settings.minimum_sample_size
    )
    gap_matrix = build_gap_matrix(detail, settings.minimum_sample_size)
    yearly = build_yearly(detail, settings.minimum_sample_size)
    tests = build_statistical_tests(detail, settings)
    paths = export_reports(
        detail, night_gap, anchor_position, gap_matrix, yearly, tests,
        settings, args.output_dir,
    )
    print(f"有效交易日：{len(detail):,}")
    print(f"夜收距離摘要：{len(night_gap):,}")
    print(f"開盤錨點位置摘要：{len(anchor_position):,}")
    print(f"雙距離矩陣：{len(gap_matrix):,}")
    print(f"年度摘要：{len(yearly):,}")
    print(f"統計檢定：{len(tests):,}")
    if len(tests):
        print(f"FDR顯著：{int(tests['FDR顯著'].sum()):,}")
    print("\n輸出：")
    for path in paths:
        print(path.resolve())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from common import utils
