class FormationCandidateTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        dates = pd.bdate_range("2026-01-02", periods=80); base = 20000 + np.arange(80) * 5.0
        self.taiex = pd.DataFrame({"日期": dates, "開盤價": base, "最高價": base + 80,
                                   "最低價": base - 60, "收盤價": base + 20, "成交量": 100.0})
        self.taiex.loc[35, ["開盤價", "收盤價", "最高價", "最低價", "成交量"]] = [20150, 20400, 20420, 20120, 350]
        self.futures = pd.DataFrame({"日期": dates, "futures_id": "TX", "全日開": base * 2,
                                     "全日高": base * 2 + 200, "全日低": base * 2 - 180, "全日收": base * 2 + 30})

    def test_future_rows_never_change_formation_score(self):
        cutoff = self.taiex.iloc[50]["日期"]
        old = model.build_candidates_as_of(self.taiex, self.futures, cutoff, config())[0]
        changed = self.taiex.copy(); changed.loc[51:, ["最高價", "最低價", "收盤價", "成交量"]] = [99999, 1, 88888, 999999]
        new = model.build_candidates_as_of(changed, self.futures, cutoff, config())[0]
        pd.testing.assert_series_equal(old["形成重要度"], new["形成重要度"])

    def test_old_k_formation_score_does_not_decay_when_cutoff_advances(self):
        early = model.build_candidates_as_of(self.taiex.iloc[:51], self.futures.iloc[:51], self.taiex.iloc[50]["日期"], config())[0]
        late = model.build_candidates_as_of(self.taiex, self.futures, self.taiex.iloc[-1]["日期"], config())[0]
        source = self.taiex.iloc[35]["日期"]
        a = early.loc[early["日期"].eq(source), "形成重要度"].iloc[0]
        b = late.loc[late["日期"].eq(source), "形成重要度"].iloc[0]
        self.assertAlmostEqual(a, b)

    def test_yu_reference_becomes_positive_without_future_feature(self):
        formation = model.build_candidates_as_of(self.taiex, self.futures, self.taiex.iloc[-1]["日期"], config())[0]
        source = self.taiex.iloc[35]["日期"]
        refs = pd.DataFrame({"來源K日期": [source], "首次標記日期": [self.taiex.iloc[40]["日期"]],
                             "Yu點位": [40000], "Yu點位角色": ["進場"], "Yu原始依據": ["來源高點"], "Yu標註ID": ["x"]})
        table = model.build_k_training_table(formation, refs, self.taiex.iloc[20]["日期"], self.taiex.iloc[60]["日期"], config())
        row = table.loc[table["日期"].eq(source)].iloc[0]
        self.assertEqual(row["Yu曾標記關鍵K"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(row["特徵可用截止日"], source)


if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()

class YuKeyKStage1Test(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        dates = pd.bdate_range("2026-01-02", periods=80)
        base = 20000 + np.arange(80) * 5.0
        self.taiex = pd.DataFrame({
            "日期": dates, "開盤價": base, "最高價": base + 80,
            "最低價": base - 60, "收盤價": base + 20, "成交量": 100.0,
        })
        self.taiex.loc[35, ["開盤價", "收盤價", "最高價", "最低價", "成交量"]] = [20150, 20400, 20420, 20120, 350]
        self.futures = pd.DataFrame({
            "日期": dates, "futures_id": "TX", "全日開": base * 2,
            "全日高": base * 2 + 200, "全日低": base * 2 - 180, "全日收": base * 2 + 30,
        })

    def test_future_rows_never_change_old_cutoff_result(self):
        cutoff = self.taiex.iloc[60]["日期"]
        old = model.analyze_as_of(self.taiex.iloc[:61], self.futures.iloc[:61], cutoff, config())
        future_t = self.taiex.copy()
        future_t.loc[61:, ["最高價", "最低價", "收盤價", "成交量"]] = [99999, 1, 88888, 999999]
        new = model.analyze_as_of(future_t, self.futures, cutoff, config())
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(old[1].reset_index(drop=True), new[1].reset_index(drop=True))
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(old[2].reset_index(drop=True), new[2].reset_index(drop=True))

    def test_volume_spike_is_identified_from_prior_data(self):
        cutoff = self.taiex.iloc[50]["日期"]
        snapshot, _, _ = model.analyze_as_of(self.taiex, self.futures, cutoff, config())
        spike = snapshot.loc[snapshot["日期"] == self.taiex.iloc[35]["日期"]].iloc[0]
        self.assertGreater(spike["量比_20"], 3)
        self.assertIn("大量K", spike["形成原因"])

    def test_current_asof_high_uses_no_future_confirmation(self):
        cutoff = self.taiex.iloc[35]["日期"]
        snapshot, _, _ = model.analyze_as_of(self.taiex, self.futures, cutoff, config())
        row = snapshot.iloc[-1]
        self.assertEqual(row["是否截至當日20日新高"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(row["距今交易日數"], 0)

    def test_mapping_uses_same_date_tx_price(self):
        cutoff = self.taiex.iloc[50]["日期"]
        _, key_k, levels = model.analyze_as_of(self.taiex, self.futures, cutoff, config())
        source_date = key_k.iloc[0]["日期"]
        expected = self.futures.loc[self.futures["日期"] == source_date, "全日高"].iloc[0]
        mapped = levels.loc[
            (levels["加權關鍵K日期"] == source_date) & (levels["TX來源欄位"] == "全日高"),
            "TX關鍵點位",
        ].iloc[0]
        self.assertEqual(mapped, expected)
        self.assertEqual(
            levels.loc[levels["TX來源欄位"] == "全日高", "點位角色"].iloc[0], "壓力候選"
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            levels.loc[levels["TX來源欄位"] == "全日低", "點位角色"].iloc[0], "支撐候選"
        )

    def test_status_can_change_only_when_cutoff_advances(self):
        source = self.taiex.iloc[35]["日期"]
        early, _, _ = model.analyze_as_of(self.taiex, self.futures, source, config())
        advanced = self.taiex.copy()
        advanced.loc[50, ["開盤價", "最高價", "最低價", "收盤價"]] = [20500, 20700, 20480, 20650]
        later, _, _ = model.analyze_as_of(advanced, self.futures, self.taiex.iloc[60]["日期"], config())
        early_status = early.loc[early["日期"] == source, "目前狀態"].iloc[0]
        later_status = later.loc[later["日期"] == source, "目前狀態"].iloc[0]
        self.assertEqual(early_status, "仍在K棒區間")
        self.assertNotEqual(early_status, later_status)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class YuKeyKStage2Test(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        dates = pd.bdate_range("2025-12-01", periods=70)
        base = 20000 + np.arange(70) * 10.0
        self.taiex = pd.DataFrame({
            "日期": dates, "開盤價": base, "最高價": base + 80,
            "最低價": base - 60, "收盤價": base + 20, "成交量": 100.0,
        })
        self.futures = pd.DataFrame({
            "日期": dates, "futures_id": "TX", "全日開": base + 1000,
            "全日高": base + 1100, "全日低": base + 900, "全日收": base + 1020,
        })
        source_i, analysis_i = 35, 45
        self.source_date = dates[source_i]
        self.analysis_date = dates[analysis_i]
        self.yu_point = float(self.futures.iloc[source_i]["全日高"])
        self.labels = pd.DataFrame({
            "分析日期": [self.analysis_date], "進場點": [self.yu_point],
            "進場依據": [f"{self.source_date.month}/{self.source_date.day}高點"], "進場附註": [None],
            "停利1_點位": [np.nan], "停利1_依據": [None], "停利1_附註": [None],
            "停利2_點位": [np.nan], "停利2_依據": [None], "停利2_附註": [None],
            "停損1_點位": [np.nan], "停損1_依據": [None], "停損1_附註": [None],
            "停損2_點位": [np.nan], "停損2_依據": [None], "停損2_附註": [None],
        })

    def test_date_parser_never_returns_future_date(self):
        analysis = pd.Timestamp("2026-01-05")
        dates = model.extract_reference_dates("12/30高點、1/3低點", analysis)
        self.assertEqual(dates, [pd.Timestamp("2025-12-30"), pd.Timestamp("2026-01-03")])
        self.assertTrue(all(x <= analysis for x in dates))

    def test_explicit_date_and_price_find_correct_k(self):
        points, matches, labels, _ = model.compare_history(
            self.labels, self.taiex, self.futures,
            self.analysis_date, self.analysis_date, config(),
        )
        best = matches.loc[matches["候選排名"] == 1].iloc[0]
        self.assertEqual(best["加權關鍵K日期"], self.source_date)
        self.assertEqual(best["點位類型"], "高點")
        self.assertEqual(best["配對可信度"], "高")
        self.assertEqual(labels.iloc[0]["監督標籤"], 1)

    def test_future_market_rows_do_not_change_match(self):
        old = model.compare_history(
            self.labels, self.taiex, self.futures,
            self.analysis_date, self.analysis_date, config(),
        )[1]
        future_t = self.taiex.copy()
        future_f = self.futures.copy()
        mask = future_t["日期"] > self.analysis_date
        future_t.loc[mask, ["最高價", "最低價", "收盤價", "成交量"]] = [99999, 1, 88888, 999999]
        future_f.loc[future_f["日期"] > self.analysis_date, ["全日開", "全日高", "全日低", "全日收"]] = 77777
        new = model.compare_history(
            self.labels, future_t, future_f,
            self.analysis_date, self.analysis_date, config(),
        )[1]
        cols = ["候選排名", "加權關鍵K日期", "TX來源欄位", "TX關鍵點位", "配對分數"]
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(old[cols].reset_index(drop=True), new[cols].reset_index(drop=True))

    def test_no_date_weak_match_is_not_forced_positive(self):
        labels = self.labels.copy()
        labels["進場依據"] = "5日均"
        labels["進場點"] = self.yu_point + 45
        _, matches, positives, _ = model.compare_history(
            labels, self.taiex, self.futures,
            self.analysis_date, self.analysis_date, config(),
        )
        best = matches.loc[matches["候選排名"] == 1].iloc[0]
        self.assertIn(best["配對可信度"], ["低", "不採用"])
        self.assertTrue(positives.empty)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class YuRuleDiscoveryTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        dates = pd.bdate_range("2025-10-01", periods=90)
        base = 28000 + np.arange(len(dates)) * 7.0
        self.taiex = pd.DataFrame({
            "日期": dates, "開盤價": base, "最高價": base + 80,
            "最低價": base - 60, "收盤價": base + 30,
            "成交量": np.where(np.arange(len(dates)) == 45, 500, 100),
        })
        self.futures = pd.DataFrame({
            "日期": dates, "日盤開": base + 110, "日盤高": base + 190,
            "日盤低": base + 50, "日盤收": base + 140,
        })

    def test_normalize_structured_taiex_points(self):
        analysis_date = self.taiex.iloc[55]["日期"]
        source_date = self.taiex.iloc[45]["日期"]
        frame = pd.DataFrame({
            "分析日期": [analysis_date], "壓力1_點位": [self.taiex.iloc[45]["最高價"]],
            "壓力1_依據": [f"{source_date.month}/{source_date.day}大量K高點"],
            "支撐1_點位": [self.taiex.iloc[45]["開盤價"]],
            "支撐1_依據": [f"{source_date.month}/{source_date.day}大量K開盤"],
        })
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = Path(tmp) / "labels.csv"; frame.to_csv(path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
            points = model.normalize_taiex_labels([path], analysis_date, analysis_date)
        self.assertEqual(len(points), 2)
        self.assertTrue(points["明示參考日期"].str.contains(f"{source_date:%Y-%m-%d}").all())
        self.assertTrue(points["規則文字標籤"].str.contains("大量K").all())

    def test_clause_parser_does_not_leak_rule_to_another_date(self):
        analysis_date = pd.Timestamp("2025-11-26")
        frame = pd.DataFrame({
            "分析日期": [analysis_date],
            "壓力1_點位": [27816],
            "壓力1_依據": ["長下影線低點 11/05 27373/下殺K棒開盤 11/14 27816"],
        })
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = Path(tmp) / "labels.csv"; frame.to_csv(path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
            points = model.normalize_taiex_labels([path], analysis_date, analysis_date)
        row = points.iloc[0]
        self.assertEqual(row["明示參考日期"], "2025-11-14")
        self.assertEqual(row["明示點位類型"], "開盤")
        self.assertNotIn("長下影", str(row["規則文字標籤"]))
        self.assertEqual(row["Yu點位子句"], "下殺K棒開盤 11/14 27816")

    def test_daily_description_labels_same_day_point(self):
        analysis_date = pd.Timestamp("2026-01-05")
        frame = pd.DataFrame({
            "分析日期": [analysis_date], "價量描述": ["爆近一年的大量，今天開收高低非常重要"],
            "線型描述": ["多頭趨勢"], "壓力1_點位": [30105],
            "壓力1_依據": ["01/05 高點30339/收盤30105"],
        })
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = Path(tmp) / "labels.csv"; frame.to_csv(path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
            points = model.normalize_taiex_labels([path], analysis_date, analysis_date)
        row = points.iloc[0]
        self.assertEqual(row["明示參考日期"], "2026-01-05")
        self.assertIn("大量K", row["規則文字標籤"])

    def test_structured_point_can_use_reason_without_repeating_number(self):
        analysis_date = pd.Timestamp("2026-01-07")
        frame = pd.DataFrame({
            "分析日期": [analysis_date], "支撐1_點位": [30105],
            "支撐1_依據": ["1/5收盤，大量K"],
        })
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = Path(tmp) / "labels.csv"; frame.to_csv(path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

        self.assertEqual(row["明示點位類型"], "收盤")
        self.assertIn("大量K", row["規則文字標籤"])

    def test_view_gap_and_non_overlap_gap_are_both_kept(self):
        formation = pd.DataFrame({
            "日期": pd.to_datetime(["2026-01-01", "2026-01-02"]),
            "開盤價": [100, 115], "最高價": [110, 120], "最低價": [90, 112],
            "收盤價": [105, 118], "跳空缺口": [np.nan, 10], "ATR": [20, 20],
        })
        enriched = model.add_gap_features(formation, config())
        self.assertEqual(enriched.iloc[1]["View開盤跳空點數"], 10)
        self.assertEqual(enriched.iloc[1]["跳空缺口絕對點數"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(enriched.iloc[1]["View與未重疊缺口方向一致"], 1)

    def test_gap_event_uses_two_trading_days(self):
        market = pd.DataFrame({
            "日期": pd.to_datetime(["2026-01-01", "2026-01-02", "2026-01-05"]),
            "開盤價": [100, 115, 108], "最高價": [110, 120, 112],
            "最低價": [90, 112, 100], "收盤價": [105, 118, 102],
            "成交量": [100, 100, 100], "跳空缺口": [np.nan, 10, -10],
        })
        events = model.build_gap_events(market, pd.Timestamp("2026-01-05"), config())
        up = events.loc[events["缺口方向"].eq("向上")].iloc[0]
        self.assertEqual(up["缺口前交易日"], pd.Timestamp("2026-01-01"))
        self.assertEqual(up["缺口形成日"], pd.Timestamp("2026-01-02"))
        self.assertEqual(up["缺口下緣"], 110)
        self.assertEqual(up["缺口上緣"], 112)
        self.assertEqual(up["首次完全回補日"], pd.Timestamp("2026-01-05"))

    def test_gap_definitions_compare_distinct_boundaries(self):
        market = pd.DataFrame({
            "日期": pd.to_datetime(["2026-01-01", "2026-01-02"]),
            "開盤價": [100, 115], "最高價": [110, 120], "最低價": [90, 112],
            "收盤價": [105, 118], "成交量": [100, 100], "跳空缺口": [np.nan, 10],
        })
        candidates = model.build_gap_definition_candidates(market, pd.Timestamp("2026-01-02"), config())
        edges = candidates.set_index("缺口定義")[["缺口下緣", "缺口上緣"]]
        self.assertEqual(tuple(edges.loc["昨收至今開"]), (105, 115))
        self.assertEqual(tuple(edges.loc["昨收至今收"]), (105, 118))
        self.assertEqual(tuple(edges.loc["前後實體邊界"]), (105, 115))
        self.assertEqual(tuple(edges.loc["前後全K未重疊"]), (110, 112))

    def test_reference_parts_are_not_swing_labels(self):
        source_date = self.taiex.iloc[45]["日期"]
        matches = pd.DataFrame([{"Yu點位ID": "P1", "分析日期": self.taiex.iloc[55]["日期"],
                                "來源K日期": source_date, "候選點位類型": "低點",
                                "規則文字標籤": "大量K", "是否採用正例": 1}])
        training = model.build_k_training(self.taiex, matches, source_date, self.taiex.iloc[60]["日期"], config())
        row = training.loc[training["日期"].eq(source_date)].iloc[0]
        self.assertEqual(row["Yu引用部位_低點"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(row["Yu形成原因_波段低K"], 0)

    def test_pivot_snapshot_never_uses_rows_after_analysis_date(self):
        analysis_date = self.taiex.iloc[55]["日期"]
        source_date = self.taiex.iloc[45]["日期"]
        matches = pd.DataFrame([{
            "Yu點位ID": "P1", "分析日期": analysis_date, "來源K日期": source_date,
            "候選點位類型": "低點", "Yu加權點位": self.taiex.iloc[45]["最低價"],
            "加權候選點位": self.taiex.iloc[45]["最低價"], "是否採用正例": 1,
        }])
        old = model.build_pivot_reference_snapshots(self.taiex, matches, config())
        changed = self.taiex.copy()
        changed.loc[changed["日期"] > analysis_date, ["最高價", "最低價", "收盤價"]] = 99999
        new = model.build_pivot_reference_snapshots(changed, matches, config())
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(old, new)

    def test_matching_never_uses_future_rows(self):
        analysis_date = self.taiex.iloc[55]["日期"]
        source = self.taiex.iloc[45]
        points = pd.DataFrame([{
            "Yu點位ID": "P1", "分析日期": analysis_date, "點位角色": "壓力",
            "Yu加權點位": source["最高價"], "Yu原始依據": f"{source['日期'].month}/{source['日期'].day}大量K高點",
            "來源檔": "x", "來源欄位": "壓力1", "明示參考日期": f"{source['日期']:%Y-%m-%d}",
            "明示點位類型": "高點", "規則文字標籤": "大量K|波段高低", "是否K棒型點位": 1,
        }])
        old = model.match_yu_levels(points, self.taiex, config())
        altered = self.taiex.copy()
        altered.loc[altered["日期"] > analysis_date, ["開盤價", "最高價", "最低價", "收盤價"]] = 99999
        new = model.match_yu_levels(points, altered, config())
        cols = ["來源K日期", "候選點位類型", "加權候選點位", "點位誤差", "配對可信度"]
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(old[cols], new[cols])
        self.assertEqual(old.iloc[0]["來源K日期"], source["日期"])
        self.assertEqual(old.iloc[0]["候選點位類型"], "高點")

    def test_threshold_output_calls_unselected_rows_unlabeled(self):
        training = pd.DataFrame({
            "日期": pd.bdate_range("2026-01-01", periods=8),
            "Yu曾標記關鍵K": [0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1],
            "Yu規則_大量K": [0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1],
            "Yu規則_長紅黑K": [0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0],
            "量比_20": [0.7, 0.9, 1.8, 1.0, 1.1, 2.0, 1.2, 2.1],
            "實體_ATR倍數": [.1, .2, .3, .8, .2, .4, 1.0, .3],
        })
        result = model.discover_thresholds(training, pd.Timestamp("2026-08-31"), config())
        self.assertFalse(result.empty)
        self.assertTrue(result["未標記說明"].str.contains("不等於真正負例").all())
        self.assertIn("樣本外_正例覆蓋率", result.columns)
        self.assertTrue(result["規則答案欄位"].str.startswith("Yu規則_").all())

    def test_mapping_comparison_recovers_source_same_kind(self):
        analysis_date = self.taiex.iloc[55]["日期"]
        source_date = self.taiex.iloc[45]["日期"]
        matches = pd.DataFrame([{
            "Yu點位ID": "P1", "分析日期": analysis_date, "來源K日期": source_date,
            "候選點位類型": "高點", "Yu加權點位": self.taiex.iloc[45]["最高價"],
            "加權候選點位": self.taiex.iloc[45]["最高價"], "是否採用正例": 1,
        }])
        future_points = pd.DataFrame([{
            "期貨點位ID": "F1", "分析日期": analysis_date, "期貨點位角色": "進場",
            "Yu期貨點位": self.futures.iloc[45]["日盤高"],
            "期貨原始依據": f"{source_date.month}/{source_date.day}高點",
            "明示參考日期": f"{source_date:%Y-%m-%d}", "明示點位類型": "高點",
            "規則文字標籤": "",
        }])
        _, summary = model.compare_mapping_methods(matches, future_points, self.taiex, self.futures, config())
        best = summary.iloc[0]
        self.assertEqual(best["映射方法"], "來源K同部位TX_日盤")
        self.assertEqual(best["中位絕對誤差"], 0)

    def test_mapping_rejects_unaligned_kind(self):
        analysis_date = self.taiex.iloc[55]["日期"]
        source_date = self.taiex.iloc[45]["日期"]
        matches = pd.DataFrame([{
            "Yu點位ID": "P1", "分析日期": analysis_date, "來源K日期": source_date,
            "候選點位類型": "收盤", "Yu加權點位": self.taiex.iloc[45]["收盤價"],
            "加權候選點位": self.taiex.iloc[45]["收盤價"], "是否採用正例": 1,
        }])
        future_points = pd.DataFrame([{
            "期貨點位ID": "F1", "分析日期": analysis_date, "期貨點位角色": "進場",
            "Yu期貨點位": self.futures.iloc[45]["日盤高"], "期貨原始依據": "歷史高點",
            "明示參考日期": f"{source_date:%Y-%m-%d}", "明示點位類型": "高點",
            "規則文字標籤": "",
        }])
        detail, summary = model.compare_mapping_methods(matches, future_points, self.taiex, self.futures, config())
        self.assertTrue(detail.empty)
        self.assertTrue(summary.empty)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class YuPointSelectorV3Test(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        dates = pd.bdate_range("2026-01-02", periods=12)
        close = np.arange(30000, 30120, 10, dtype=float)
        self.futures = pd.DataFrame({
            "日期": dates, "futures_id": "TX", "全日開": close - 20, "全日收": close,
            "全日高": close + 100, "全日低": close - 100, "全振幅": 200,
            "全成交量": 10000, "全5MA": close - 30, "動能": np.tile([-1, 1], 6),
        })
        self.taiex = pd.DataFrame({
            "日期": dates, "開盤價": close / 2, "收盤價": close / 2 + 5,
            "最高價": close / 2 + 50, "最低價": close / 2 - 50,
            "成交量": [100, 100, 300, 100, 100, 100, 100, 100, 100, 100, 100, 100],
            "20日均量": 100, "實體_pct": .005, "日振幅_昨收_pct": .01,
            "跳空缺口_昨收_pct": 0, "K線型態": "中實體K", "趨勢": np.tile(["空", "多"], 6),
        })
        self.labels = pd.DataFrame({
            "分析日期": dates, "方案序號": 1, "交易方向": "多", "分析方向": "多",
            "進場點": close - 100, "進場條件": "回測支撐", "進場依據": "前低", "進場附註": "",
        })

    def test_samples_label_candidate_near_yu_entry(self):
        samples = model.build_candidate_samples(self.labels, self.futures, self.taiex, config())
        first = samples.loc[samples["分析日期"] == self.labels.iloc[0]["分析日期"]]
        self.assertTrue((first["是否命中Yu點位"] == 1).any())
        self.assertEqual(first["歷史同情境樣本數"].max(), 0)

    def test_history_features_do_not_see_same_day_label(self):
        labels = pd.concat([self.labels, self.labels.iloc[[0]].assign(方案序號=2)], ignore_index=True)
        samples = model.build_candidate_samples(labels, self.futures, self.taiex, config())
        first_day = samples.loc[samples["分析日期"] == self.labels.iloc[0]["分析日期"]]
        self.assertEqual(first_day["歷史同情境樣本數"].max(), 0)
        second_day = samples.loc[samples["分析日期"] == self.labels.iloc[1]["分析日期"]]
        self.assertEqual(second_day["歷史同情境樣本數"].max(), 2)

    def test_forbidden_yu_target_field_is_rejected(self):
        bad = config()
        bad["selector"]["yu_context_fields"] = ["進場點"]
        import json, tempfile
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".json", encoding="utf-8", delete=False) as handle:
            json.dump(bad, handle, ensure_ascii=False)
            name = handle.name
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            model.load_config(name)

    def test_walk_forward_has_no_prediction_before_minimum_plans(self):
        samples = model.build_candidate_samples(self.labels, self.futures, self.taiex, config())
        details, metrics = model.walk_forward_experiments(
            samples, config(), self.labels.iloc[0]["分析日期"], self.labels.iloc[-1]["分析日期"]
        )
        self.assertFalse(metrics.empty)
        self.assertTrue((metrics["訓練計畫數"] >= 4).all())
        self.assertEqual(set(metrics["特徵組合"]), {"A", "B"})

    def test_summary_reports_top_k(self):
        metrics = pd.DataFrame({
            "特徵組合": ["A", "A"], "可命中候選存在": [1, 1],
            "Top1命中": [1, 0], "Top3命中": [1, 1], "Top5命中": [1, 1],
            "倒數排名MRR": [1, .5], "Top1差距點數": [0, 20], "輸入欄位數": [5, 5],
            "僅研究用途": [False, False],
        })
        summary = model.summarize_experiments(metrics)
        self.assertEqual(summary.iloc[0]["Top1命中率_pct"], 50)
        self.assertEqual(summary.iloc[0]["Top3命中率_pct"], 100)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from machine_learning import yu_strategy_model_v2 as model

class YuStrategyV2Test(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        dates = pd.bdate_range("2026-01-02", periods=12)
        close = np.arange(30000, 30120, 10, dtype=float)
        self.futures = pd.DataFrame({
            "日期": dates, "futures_id": "TX", "全日開": close - 20, "全日收": close,
            "全日高": close + 100, "全日低": close - 100, "全振幅": 200,
            "全成交量": 10000, "全5MA": close - 30, "動能": np.tile([-1, 1], 6),
        })
        self.taiex = pd.DataFrame({
            "日期": dates, "開盤價": close / 2, "收盤價": close / 2 + 5,
            "最高價": close / 2 + 50, "最低價": close / 2 - 50,
            "成交量": [100, 100, 100, 300, 100, 100, 100, 100, 100, 100, 100, 100],
            "20日均量": 100, "實體_pct": 0.005, "日振幅_昨收_pct": 0.01,
            "跳空缺口_昨收_pct": 0.0, "K線型態": "中實體K",
            "趨勢": np.tile(["空", "多"], 6),
        })

    def test_taiex_selects_date_but_candidate_uses_futures_price(self):
        target = self.futures.iloc[-1]["日期"]
        raw = model.generate_raw_candidates(self.futures, self.taiex, target, config())
        key_date = self.taiex.iloc[3]["日期"]
        mapped = raw.loc[(raw["來源日期"] == key_date) & (raw["點位類型"] == "收盤")]
        self.assertFalse(mapped.empty)
        self.assertEqual(mapped.iloc[0]["候選點位"], self.futures.iloc[3]["全日收"])
        self.assertNotEqual(mapped.iloc[0]["候選點位"], self.taiex.iloc[3]["收盤價"])

    def test_clusters_merge_nearby_levels(self):
        target = self.futures.iloc[-1]["日期"]
        raw = model.generate_raw_candidates(self.futures, self.taiex, target, config())
        clusters = model.cluster_candidates(raw, config())
        self.assertLess(len(clusters), len(raw))
        self.assertTrue((clusters["依據數"] > 1).any())

    def test_four_scenarios_have_correct_side(self):
        clusters = pd.DataFrame({"距參考收盤點數": [-100, 100]})
        self.assertEqual(model.scenario_compatible(clusters, "回測做多", config()).tolist(), [True, False])
        self.assertEqual(model.scenario_compatible(clusters, "突破做多", config()).tolist(), [False, True])
        self.assertEqual(model.scenario_compatible(clusters, "反彈做空", config()).tolist(), [False, True])
        self.assertEqual(model.scenario_compatible(clusters, "跌破做空", config()).tolist(), [True, False])

    def test_infer_scenario_from_text_then_price_fallback(self):
        self.assertEqual(model.infer_scenario(pd.Series({"交易方向": "多", "進場條件": "突破前高", "進場依據": "", "進場附註": ""}), 30000), "突破做多")
        self.assertEqual(model.infer_scenario(pd.Series({"交易方向": "空", "進場條件": "跌破支撐", "進場依據": "", "進場附註": ""}), 30000), "跌破做空")
        self.assertEqual(model.infer_scenario(pd.Series({"交易方向": "多", "進場條件": "", "進場依據": "", "進場附註": "", "進場點": 29900}), 30000), "回測做多")

    def test_prediction_ranking_differs_by_scenario(self):
        target = self.futures.iloc[-1]["日期"]
        raw = model.generate_raw_candidates(self.futures, self.taiex, target, config())
        clusters = model.cluster_candidates(raw, config())
        ranked = model.rank_clusters(clusters, pd.DataFrame(), self.futures.iloc[-1], target, config())
        self.assertEqual(set(ranked["進場情境"]), set(model.SCENARIOS))
        below = ranked.loc[ranked["進場情境"].isin(["回測做多", "跌破做空"]), "距參考收盤點數"]
        above = ranked.loc[ranked["進場情境"].isin(["突破做多", "反彈做空"]), "距參考收盤點數"]
        self.assertTrue((below < 0).all())
        self.assertTrue((above > 0).all())

    def test_evaluation_start_does_not_remove_prior_training(self):
        combined = model.merge_direction_report(self.taiex, self.futures, config())
        labels = pd.DataFrame({
            "分析日期": self.futures["日期"],
            "分析方向": np.tile(["空", "多"], 6),
            "交易方向": np.tile(["空", "多"], 6),
        })
        samples = model.build_direction_samples(labels, combined, config())
        start = self.futures.iloc[8]["日期"]
        results, _, _ = model.direction_walk_forward(samples, config(), evaluation_start=start)
        self.assertEqual(results.iloc[0]["分析日期"], start)
        self.assertNotEqual(results.iloc[0]["交易判斷路徑"], "訓練資料不足（0/4）")

    def test_source_summary_is_split_by_scenario(self):
        matches = pd.DataFrame({
            "分析日期": pd.to_datetime(["2026-01-02", "2026-01-03", "2026-01-04"]),
            "比對狀態": ["命中", "命中", "未命中：超過容許點數"],
            "進場情境": ["回測做多", "反彈做空", "回測做多"],
            "主要類型": ["收盤", "高點", "低點"], "主要盤別": ["全日", "日盤", "全日"],
            "差距點數": [3.0, 5.0, 80.0],
        })
        summary = model.summarize_historical_matches(matches)
        self.assertEqual(summary["命中筆數"].sum(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(set(summary["進場情境"]), {"回測做多", "反彈做空"})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from machine_learning import yu_strategy_model as model


def test_config():
    return {
        "date_column": "日期",
        "direction_features": ["動能", "策略"],
        "direction_model": {"minimum_training_rows": 4, "max_depth": 2, "min_samples_leaf": 1, "random_seed": 42},
        "candidate": {
            "lookback_rows": 5, "match_tolerance_points": 20, "cluster_tolerance_points": 10,
            "reference_price_field": "全日收", "volume_field": "全成交量", "round_steps": [50],
            "raw_fields": [
                {"field": "全日開", "session": "全日", "kind": "開盤"},
                {"field": "全日收", "session": "全日", "kind": "收盤"},
                {"field": "全日高", "session": "全日", "kind": "高點"},
                {"field": "全日低", "session": "全日", "kind": "低點"},
            ],
            "current_fields": [{"field": "全5MA", "session": "全日", "kind": "5日均"}],
        },
    }


class YuStrategyModelTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        dates = pd.bdate_range("2026-01-02", periods=12)
        close = np.arange(10000, 10120, 10, dtype=float)
        self.report = pd.DataFrame({
            "日期": dates, "全日開": close - 5, "全日收": close,
            "全日高": close + 30, "全日低": close - 40, "全5MA": close - 15,
            "全成交量": np.arange(1000, 1120, 10), "動能": np.tile([-1.0, 1.0], 6),
            "策略": np.tile(["空", "多"], 6),
        })

    def test_candidates_never_use_future_rows(self):
        target = self.report.iloc[5]["日期"]
        candidates = model.generate_candidates(self.report, target, test_config())
        self.assertFalse(candidates.empty)
        self.assertLessEqual(candidates["來源日期"].max(), target)

    def test_reason_date_and_kind_break_equal_price_tie(self):
        target = self.report.iloc[5]["日期"]
        candidates = model.generate_candidates(self.report, target, test_config())
        source = self.report.iloc[2]
        plan = pd.Series({
            "分析日期": target, "方案序號": 1, "分析方向_標籤": "多", "交易方向_標籤": "多",
            "樣本型態": "新交易計畫", "進場點": source["全日收"],
            "進場依據": f"{source['日期'].month}/{source['日期'].day}收盤", "資料品質狀態": "OK",
        })
        match = model.match_entry_to_candidate(plan, candidates, test_config())
        self.assertEqual(match["比對狀態"], "命中")
        self.assertEqual(match["點位類型"], "收盤")
        self.assertEqual(pd.Timestamp(match["來源日期"]), source["日期"])

    def test_existing_position_is_not_treated_as_new_point(self):
        plan = pd.Series({
            "分析日期": self.report.iloc[-1]["日期"], "方案序號": 1,
            "分析方向_標籤": "多", "交易方向_標籤": "多", "樣本型態": "既有持倉",
            "進場點": 10000, "進場依據": "抱單中", "資料品質狀態": "OK",
        })
        match = model.match_entry_to_candidate(plan, pd.DataFrame(), test_config())
        self.assertIn("既有持倉", match["比對狀態"])

    def test_walk_forward_uses_only_prior_labels(self):
        labels = pd.DataFrame({
            "分析日期": self.report["日期"], "分析方向_標籤": np.tile(["空", "多"], 6),
            "交易方向_標籤": np.tile(["空", "多"], 6),
        })
        samples = labels.merge(self.report, left_on="分析日期", right_on="日期")
        results, rules = model.walk_forward_direction(samples, test_config())
        self.assertTrue(results.iloc[:4]["交易預測"].isna().all())
        self.assertTrue(results.iloc[4:]["交易預測"].notna().all())
        self.assertIn("Yu 交易方向", rules)

    def test_candidate_rankings_are_split_by_direction(self):
        target = self.report.iloc[-1]["日期"]
        candidates = model.generate_candidates(self.report, target, test_config())
        matches = pd.DataFrame({
            "分析日期": [self.report.iloc[2]["日期"], self.report.iloc[3]["日期"]],
            "比對狀態": ["命中", "命中"], "交易方向": ["多", "空"],
            "點位類型": ["收盤", "高點"], "盤別": ["全日", "全日"],
        })
        ranked = model.candidate_rankings_for_date(target, candidates, matches, top_n=5)
        self.assertEqual(set(ranked["預測交易方向"]), {"多", "空"})
        self.assertEqual(len(ranked), 10)

    def test_current_direction_prediction_excludes_same_date_label(self):
        labels = pd.DataFrame({
            "分析日期": self.report["日期"], "分析方向_標籤": np.tile(["空", "多"], 6),
            "交易方向_標籤": np.tile(["空", "多"], 6),
        })
        samples = labels.merge(self.report, left_on="分析日期", right_on="日期")
        target = self.report.iloc[-1]["日期"]
        prediction = model.predict_direction_for_date(
            samples, self.report.iloc[[-1]], target, test_config()
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(prediction), 1)
        self.assertIn(prediction.iloc[0]["交易預測"], {"多", "空", "無"})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
