# 4. 期貨最後結算價
# =========================================================
def get_tw_futures_final_settlement_price(
    futures_id: Union[str, list[str]],
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    print(f"--- run finMind.get_tw_futures_final_settlement_price--[{futures_id}]")
    target_table = "fm_taiwan_futures_final_settlement_price"

    req_s = utils._to_norm_ts(start_date)
    req_e = utils._to_norm_ts(end_date)
    if req_s > req_e:
        raise ValueError("start_date 不可大於 end_date")
    utils._fetch_with_cache.req_s = req_s
    utils._fetch_with_cache.req_e = req_e

    def fetcher(fid: str, fs: pd.Timestamp, fe: pd.Timestamp):
        params = {
            "dataset": "TaiwanFuturesFinalSettlementPrice",
            "data_id": fid,
            "start_date": utils._dstr(fs),
            "end_date": utils._dstr(fe),
            "token": token,
        }
        resp = requests.get(apiUrl, params=params, timeout=60)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        data = resp.json()

        if "data" not in data:
            raise ValueError(f"FinMind API 回傳格式異常: {data}")

        df = pd.DataFrame(data["data"])
        if df.empty:
            return pd.DataFrame()

        df = df.copy()
        df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])
        df = df[(df["date"] >= fs) & (df["date"] <= fe)]
        if df.empty:
            return pd.DataFrame()

        df["date"] = df["date"].dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        df = utils._to_str_cols(df, ["contract_month", "futures_id"])
        df = utils._fill_text_cols(df, ["futures_type", "futures_name", "underlying_code"])
        df = utils._to_num_cols(df, ["settlement_price", "notional_value"])
        return df

    upsert_sql = f"""
    INSERT INTO {target_table}
    (
        date, contract_month, futures_type, futures_id, futures_name,
        settlement_price, underlying_code, notional_value
    )
    VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
    ON CONFLICT(date, contract_month, futures_id) DO UPDATE SET
        futures_type      = excluded.futures_type,
        futures_name      = excluded.futures_name,
        settlement_price  = excluded.settlement_price,
        underlying_code   = excluded.underlying_code,
        notional_value    = excluded.notional_value
    """

    def upsert_df(df: pd.DataFrame):
        params = list(
            df[
                [
                    "date", "contract_month", "futures_type", "futures_id", "futures_name",
                    "settlement_price", "underlying_code", "notional_value",
                ]
            ].itertuples(index=False, name=None)
        )
        if params:
            db.execute_sql(upsert_sql, params)

    return utils._fetch_with_cache(
        ids=futures_id,
        target_table=target_table,
        idx_field="futures_id",
        fetcher=fetcher,
        upsert_df=upsert_df,
        select_cols_sql="""
            date, contract_month, futures_type, futures_id, futures_name,
            settlement_price, underlying_code, notional_value
        """,
        order_by_sql="date, contract_month",
        debug_name="futures_final_settlement",
        output_csv=None,
    )


# =========================================================
# 5. 選擇權日成交資訊
# =========================================================
def get_tw_option_daily(
    option_id: Union[str, list[str]],
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
    force_refresh: bool = False,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    print(f"--- run finMind.get_tw_option_daily--[{option_id}]")
    api = getDataLoader()
    target_table = "fm_taiwan_option_daily"

    req_s = utils._to_norm_ts(start_date)
    req_e = utils._to_norm_ts(end_date)
    if req_s > req_e:
        raise ValueError("start_date 不可大於 end_date")

    utils._fetch_with_cache.req_s = req_s
    utils._fetch_with_cache.req_e = req_e

    def fetcher(oid: str, fs: pd.Timestamp, fe: pd.Timestamp):
        all_month_df = []
        current = fs.normalize()

        while current <= fe:
            month_end = (current + pd.offsets.MonthEnd(0)).normalize()
            if month_end > fe:
                month_end = fe

            print(f"抓取 {oid} {current.date()} ~ {month_end.date()}")

            try:
                df = api.taiwan_option_daily(
                    option_id=oid,
                    start_date=utils._dstr(current),
                    end_date=utils._dstr(month_end),
                )
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 當月失敗：{e}")
                current = month_end + pd.Timedelta(days=1)
                continue

            if df is not None and not df.empty:
                df = utils._normalize_date_col(df, "date")
                df = utils._to_str_cols(df, ["option_id", "contract_date", "call_put", "trading_session"])
                df = utils._to_num_cols(
                    df,
                    [
                        "strike_price", "open", "max", "min", "close",
                        "volume", "settlement_price", "open_interest",
                    ],
                )
                all_month_df.append(df)

            current = month_end + pd.Timedelta(days=1)

        return pd.concat(all_month_df, ignore_index=True) if all_month_df else pd.DataFrame()

    upsert_sql = f"""
    INSERT INTO {target_table}
    (
        date, option_id, contract_date, strike_price, call_put,
        open, max, min, close, volume,
        settlement_price, open_interest, trading_session
    )
    VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
    ON CONFLICT(date, option_id, contract_date, strike_price, call_put, trading_session) DO UPDATE SET
      open             = excluded.open,
      max              = excluded.max,
      min              = excluded.min,
      close            = excluded.close,
      volume           = excluded.volume,
      settlement_price = excluded.settlement_price,
      open_interest    = excluded.open_interest
    """

    def upsert_df(df: pd.DataFrame):
        params = list(
            df[
                [
                    "date", "option_id", "contract_date",
                    "strike_price", "call_put",
                    "open", "max", "min", "close",
                    "volume", "settlement_price", "open_interest", "trading_session",
                ]
            ].itertuples(index=False, name=None)
        )
        if params:
            db.execute_sql(upsert_sql, params)

    return utils._fetch_with_cache(
        ids=option_id,
        target_table=target_table,
        idx_field="option_id",
        fetcher=fetcher,
        upsert_df=upsert_df,
        select_cols_sql="""
            date, option_id, contract_date, strike_price, call_put,
            open, max, min, close, volume,
            settlement_price, open_interest, trading_session
        """,
        order_by_sql="date, contract_date, strike_price, call_put, trading_session",
        debug_name="option_daily",
        output_csv=None,
        force_refresh=force_refresh,
    )

# =========================================================
# 6. 選擇權最後結算價
# =========================================================
def get_tw_option_final_settlement_price(
    option_id: Union[str, list[str]],
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    print(f"--- run finMind.get_tw_option_final_settlement_price--[{option_id}]")
    target_table = "fm_taiwan_option_final_settlement_price"

    req_s = utils._to_norm_ts(start_date)
    req_e = utils._to_norm_ts(end_date)
    if req_s > req_e:
        raise ValueError("start_date 不可大於 end_date")
    utils._fetch_with_cache.req_s = req_s
    utils._fetch_with_cache.req_e = req_e

    def fetcher(oid: str, fs: pd.Timestamp, fe: pd.Timestamp):
        params = {
            "dataset": "TaiwanOptionFinalSettlementPrice",
            "data_id": oid,
            "start_date": utils._dstr(fs),
            "end_date": utils._dstr(fe),
            "token": token,
        }
        resp = requests.get(apiUrl, params=params, timeout=60)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        data = resp.json()

        if "data" not in data:
            raise ValueError(f"FinMind API 回傳格式異常: {data}")

        df = pd.DataFrame(data["data"])
        if df.empty:
            return pd.DataFrame()

        df = df.copy()
        df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])
        df = df[(df["date"] >= fs) & (df["date"] <= fe)]
        if df.empty:
            return pd.DataFrame()

        df["date"] = df["date"].dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        df = utils._to_str_cols(df, ["contract_month", "option_id"])
        df = utils._fill_text_cols(df, ["option_type", "option_name", "underlying_code"])
        df = utils._to_num_cols(df, ["settlement_price", "notional_value"])
        return df

    upsert_sql = f"""
    INSERT INTO {target_table}
    (
        date, contract_month, option_type, option_id, option_name,
        settlement_price, underlying_code, notional_value
    )
    VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
    ON CONFLICT(date, contract_month, option_id) DO UPDATE SET
        option_type       = excluded.option_type,
        option_name       = excluded.option_name,
        settlement_price  = excluded.settlement_price,
        underlying_code   = excluded.underlying_code,
        notional_value    = excluded.notional_value
    """

    def upsert_df(df: pd.DataFrame):
        params = list(
            df[
                [
                    "date", "contract_month", "option_type", "option_id", "option_name",
                    "settlement_price", "underlying_code", "notional_value",
                ]
            ].itertuples(index=False, name=None)
        )
        if params:
            db.execute_sql(upsert_sql, params)

    return utils._fetch_with_cache(
        ids=option_id,
        target_table=target_table,
        idx_field="option_id",
        fetcher=fetcher,
        upsert_df=upsert_df,
        select_cols_sql="""
            date, contract_month, option_type, option_id, option_name,
            settlement_price, underlying_code, notional_value
        """,
        order_by_sql="date, contract_month",
        debug_name="option_final_settlement",
        output_csv=str(FINMIND_OUTPUT_ROOT / "finMind_option_final_settlement_price.csv"),
    )


# =========================================================
# 7. 台股／加權指數 1 分 K（TaiwanStockKBar）
# =========================================================
def _intraday_request_dates(
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
) -> list[pd.Timestamp]:
    """从交易日表取得 API 应请求日期，避免浪费每日请求额度。"""
    req_s = utils._to_norm_ts(start_date)
    req_e = min(utils._to_norm_ts(end_date), utils._taipei_today())
    if req_s > req_e:
        raise ValueError("start_date 不可大於 end_date，且不可全部位於未來")

    trading_dates = db.query_to_df(
        """
        SELECT date
        FROM fm_taiwan_stock_trading_date
        WHERE date >= ? AND date <= ?
        ORDER BY date
        """,
        (utils._dstr(req_s), utils._dstr(req_e)),
    )
    if trading_dates is None or trading_dates.empty:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "fm_taiwan_stock_trading_date 在指定区间没有资料；"
            "请先执行 get_tw_stock_trading_dates()，再下载分 K／期货 Tick。"
        )
    return [pd.Timestamp(value).normalize() for value in trading_dates["date"]]


def _futures_tick_request_dates(
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
) -> list[pd.Timestamp]:
    """取得期貨 Tick 所需日曆日期，包含每個交易日的隔日凌晨檔。"""
    req_s = utils._to_norm_ts(start_date)
    req_e = min(utils._to_norm_ts(end_date), utils._taipei_today())
    if req_s > req_e:
        raise ValueError("start_date 不可大於 end_date，且不可全部位於未來")

    trading_dates = db.query_to_df(
        """
        SELECT date
        FROM fm_taiwan_stock_trading_date
        WHERE date >= ? AND date <= ?
        ORDER BY date
        """,
        (utils._dstr(req_s - pd.Timedelta(days=1)), utils._dstr(req_e)),
    )
    if trading_dates is None or trading_dates.empty:
        raise RuntimeError("交易日表在指定區間沒有資料，請先更新交易日表")

    dates: set[pd.Timestamp] = set()
    for value in trading_dates["date"]:
        trading_date = pd.Timestamp(value).normalize()
        for request_date in (trading_date, trading_date + pd.Timedelta(days=1)):
            if req_s <= request_date <= req_e:
                dates.add(request_date)
    return sorted(dates)


def _stored_intraday_dates(
    target_table: str,
    id_field: str,
    id_value: str,
    date_field: str,
    start_date: pd.Timestamp,
    end_date: pd.Timestamp,
) -> set[pd.Timestamp]:
    df = db.query_to_df(
        f"""
        SELECT DISTINCT {date_field} AS stored_date
        FROM {target_table}
        WHERE {id_field} = ?
          AND {date_field} >= ?
          AND {date_field} <= ?
        """,
        (id_value, utils._dstr(start_date), utils._dstr(end_date)),
    )
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return set()
    return {
        pd.Timestamp(value).normalize()
        for value in df["stored_date"]
        if pd.notna(value)
    }


def get_tw_stock_kbar(
    stock_id: Union[str, list[str]],
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
    *,
    force_refresh: bool = False,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """下载 TaiwanStockKBar 并写入 fm_taiwan_stock_kbar_1m。

    FinMind 一次只提供一天，因此函数会依交易日逐日检查缺口。
    已有日期自动跳过；今天会固定重抓，避免盘中半成品被视为完成。
    回传值是每个商品、日期的同步结果摘要，不会把多年分 K 全部载回内存。
    """
    print(f"--- run finMind.get_tw_stock_kbar--[{stock_id}]")
    target_table = "fm_taiwan_stock_kbar_1m"
    ids = [str(value).strip() for value in utils._ensure_list(stock_id)]
    request_dates = _intraday_request_dates(start_date, end_date)
    today = utils._taipei_today()
    recent_refresh_dates = (
        set(request_dates[-1:])
        if request_dates[-1] >= today - pd.Timedelta(days=3)
        else set()
    )
    summary: list[dict] = []

    upsert_sql = f"""
    INSERT INTO {target_table}
    (
        date, minute, stock_id, open, high, low, close, volume, updated_at
    )
    VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
    ON CONFLICT(date, minute, stock_id) DO UPDATE SET
        open       = EXCLUDED.open,
        high       = EXCLUDED.high,
        low        = EXCLUDED.low,
        close      = EXCLUDED.close,
        volume     = EXCLUDED.volume,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    """

    for sid in ids:
        stored_dates = _stored_intraday_dates(
            target_table,
            "stock_id",
            sid,
            "date",
            request_dates[0],
            request_dates[-1],
        )

        for request_date in request_dates:
            date_str = utils._dstr(request_date)
            if not force_refresh and request_date not in recent_refresh_dates and request_date in stored_dates:
                summary.append({"stock_id": sid, "date": date_str, "status": "cached", "rows": 0})
                continue

            df = api.taiwan_stock_kbar(stock_id=sid, date=date_str)
            if df is None or df.empty:
                summary.append({"stock_id": sid, "date": date_str, "status": "empty", "rows": 0})
                print(f"⚠️ TaiwanStockKBar [{sid}] {date_str} 回传空资料")
                continue

            df = df.copy()
            required = {"date", "minute", "stock_id", "open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"}
            missing = required.difference(df.columns)
            if missing:
                raise ValueError(f"TaiwanStockKBar 缺少栏位：{sorted(missing)}")

            df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"], errors="coerce").dt.date
            df["minute"] = pd.to_datetime(df["minute"], format="%H:%M:%S", errors="coerce").dt.time
            df["stock_id"] = df["stock_id"].fillna(sid).astype(str)
            for column in ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]:
                df[column] = pd.to_numeric(df[column], errors="coerce")
            df = df.dropna(subset=["date", "minute", "open", "high", "low", "close"])
            df["volume"] = df["volume"].fillna(0).round().astype("int64")
            df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["date", "minute", "stock_id"], keep="last")

            params = list(
                df[["date", "minute", "stock_id", "open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]]
                .itertuples(index=False, name=None)
            )
            if params and not db.execute_sql(upsert_sql, params):
                raise RuntimeError(f"写入 {target_table} 失败：{sid} {date_str}")

            summary.append({"stock_id": sid, "date": date_str, "status": "stored", "rows": len(params)})
            print(f"✅ TaiwanStockKBar [{sid}] {date_str}：写入 {len(params)} 笔")

        utils._sync_date_span_from_actual_table(
            target_table=target_table,
            idx_key=sid,
            idx_field="stock_id",
            date_field="date",
        )

    return pd.DataFrame(summary)


# =========================================================
# 8. 期货逐笔成交（TaiwanFuturesTick）
# =========================================================
def _replace_futures_tick_day(
    target_table: str,
    futures_id: str,
    source_date: str,
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> int:
    """在同一交易中替换单一 API 日期，避免重复执行产生重复 Tick。"""
    rows = []
    for row in df.itertuples(index=False):
        rows.append(
            (
                source_date,
                row.trade_datetime.to_pydatetime(),
                str(row.futures_id),
                str(row.contract_date),
                float(row.price),
                int(row.volume),
                int(row.source_row_no),
            )
        )

    with db.get_connection() as conn:
        try:
            with conn.cursor() as cur:
                cur.execute(
                    f"DELETE FROM {target_table} WHERE futures_id = %s AND source_date = %s",
                    (futures_id, source_date),
                )
                with cur.copy(
                    f"""COPY {target_table}
                    (source_date, trade_datetime, futures_id, contract_date, price, volume, source_row_no)
                    FROM STDIN"""
                ) as copy:
                    for row in rows:
                        copy.write_row(row)
            conn.commit()
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise
    return len(rows)


def get_tw_futures_tick(
    futures_id: Union[str, list[str]],
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
    *,
    force_refresh: bool = False,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """下载 TaiwanFuturesTick 并写入 fm_taiwan_futures_tick。

    完整保留 FinMind 的双边 volume，不在原始层除以 2。
    source_row_no 只用于保留同秒、同价、同量的重复成交及重复执行去重。
    回传值是每日同步摘要，不会把大量 Tick 重新读取到 Python。
    """
    print(f"--- run finMind.get_tw_futures_tick--[{futures_id}]")
    target_table = "fm_taiwan_futures_tick"
    ids = [str(value).strip() for value in utils._ensure_list(futures_id)]
    # 夜盤跨越午夜；除了交易日本身，也必須下載隔日 00:00～05:00 的日曆檔。
    request_dates = _futures_tick_request_dates(start_date, end_date)
    if not request_dates:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=["futures_id", "date", "status", "rows"])
    today = utils._taipei_today()
    # 週一的尾端請求日通常是 [週五, 週六, 週一]。三個都必須
    # 重抓，否則只抓最後兩個會漏掉週五 15:00～24:00。
    recent_refresh_dates = (
        set(request_dates[-3:])
        if request_dates[-1] >= today - pd.Timedelta(days=4)
        else set()
    )
    summary: list[dict] = []

    for fid in ids:
        stored_dates = _stored_intraday_dates(
            target_table,
            "futures_id",
            fid,
            "source_date",
            request_dates[0],
            request_dates[-1],
        )

        for request_date in request_dates:
            date_str = utils._dstr(request_date)
            if not force_refresh and request_date not in recent_refresh_dates and request_date in stored_dates:
                summary.append({"futures_id": fid, "date": date_str, "status": "cached", "rows": 0})
                continue

            df = api.taiwan_futures_tick(futures_id=fid, date=date_str)
            if df is None or df.empty:
                summary.append({"futures_id": fid, "date": date_str, "status": "empty", "rows": 0})
                print(f"⚠️ TaiwanFuturesTick [{fid}] {date_str} 回传空资料")
                continue

            df = df.copy()
            required = {"contract_date", "date", "futures_id", "price", "volume"}
            missing = required.difference(df.columns)
            if missing:
                raise ValueError(f"TaiwanFuturesTick 缺少栏位：{sorted(missing)}")

            df["trade_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"], errors="coerce")
            df["futures_id"] = df["futures_id"].fillna(fid).astype(str)
            df["price"] = pd.to_numeric(df["price"], errors="coerce")
            df["volume"] = pd.to_numeric(df["volume"], errors="coerce")
            df = df.dropna(subset=["trade_datetime", "contract_date", "price", "volume"])
            df["contract_date"] = df["contract_date"].astype(str)
            df["volume"] = df["volume"].round().astype("int64")
            df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
            df["source_row_no"] = df.index.astype("int64") + 1
            df = df[["trade_datetime", "futures_id", "contract_date", "price", "volume", "source_row_no"]]

            written = _replace_futures_tick_day(target_table, fid, date_str, df)
            summary.append({"futures_id": fid, "date": date_str, "status": "stored", "rows": written})
            print(f"✅ TaiwanFuturesTick [{fid}] {date_str}：写入 {written} 笔")

        utils._sync_date_span_from_actual_table(
            target_table=target_table,
            idx_key=fid,
            idx_field="futures_id",
            date_field="source_date",
        )

    return pd.DataFrame(summary)


# =========================================================
# 9. 台指期 1 分 K（由 TaiwanFuturesTick 汇总）
# =========================================================
def build_tw_futures_kbar_1m(
    futures_id: str,
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """将已入库的期货 Tick 汇总成各契约一分钟 K。

    规则：
    - 00:00～05:00：source_date 当日夜盘，交易日为 source_date。
    - 08:45～13:45：source_date 当日日盘，交易日为 source_date。
    - 15:00～24:00：次一交易日夜盘，交易日由交易日表向后寻找。
    - 只汇总 contract_date 为 YYYYMM 的单一契约，排除价差／组合契约。
    - raw_volume 保存 FinMind 双边量；volume 除以 2 转为单边口数。
    - 指定 source_date 区间采用整段重建，确保 Tick 重抓后 K 棒同步修正。
    """
    fid = str(futures_id).strip()
    req_s = utils._to_norm_ts(start_date)
    req_e = min(utils._to_norm_ts(end_date), utils._taipei_today())
    if req_s > req_e:
        raise ValueError("start_date 不可大於 end_date，且不可全部位於未來")

    source_table = "fm_taiwan_futures_tick"
    target_table = "fm_taiwan_futures_kbar_1m"
    start_str = utils._dstr(req_s)
    end_str = utils._dstr(req_e)
    print(f"--- run finMind.build_tw_futures_kbar_1m--[{fid}] {start_str}~{end_str}")

    insert_sql = f"""
    WITH source_dates AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT source_date
        FROM {source_table}
        WHERE futures_id = %s
          AND source_date >= %s
          AND source_date <= %s
    ),
    next_trading_dates AS (
        SELECT
            sd.source_date,
            (
                SELECT MIN(td.date)
                FROM fm_taiwan_stock_trading_date td
                WHERE td.date > sd.source_date
            ) AS next_trading_date,
            (
                SELECT MIN(td.date)
                FROM fm_taiwan_stock_trading_date td
                WHERE td.date >= sd.source_date
            ) AS current_or_next_trading_date
        FROM source_dates sd
    ),
    classified AS (
        SELECT
            t.source_date,
            t.trade_datetime,
            date_trunc('minute', t.trade_datetime) AS bar_datetime,
            t.futures_id,
            t.contract_date,
            t.price,
            t.volume,
            t.source_row_no,
            CASE
                WHEN t.trade_datetime::time >= TIME '15:00:00' THEN 'after_market'
                WHEN t.trade_datetime::time <= TIME '05:00:00' THEN 'after_market'
                WHEN t.trade_datetime::time BETWEEN TIME '08:45:00' AND TIME '13:45:59.999999'
                    THEN 'position'
                ELSE NULL
            END AS trading_session,
            CASE
                WHEN t.trade_datetime::time >= TIME '15:00:00'
                    THEN ntd.next_trading_date
                WHEN t.trade_datetime::time <= TIME '05:00:00'
                    THEN ntd.current_or_next_trading_date
                ELSE t.source_date
            END AS trading_date
        FROM {source_table} t
        JOIN next_trading_dates ntd
          ON ntd.source_date = t.source_date
        WHERE t.futures_id = %s
          AND t.source_date >= %s
          AND t.source_date <= %s
          AND t.contract_date ~ '^[0-9]{{6}}$'
    ),
    valid_ticks AS (
        SELECT *
        FROM classified
        WHERE trading_session IS NOT NULL
          AND trading_date IS NOT NULL
    )
    INSERT INTO {target_table}
    (
        source_date, trading_date, bar_datetime,
        futures_id, contract_date, trading_session,
        open, high, low, close,
        volume, raw_volume, tick_count, updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        source_date,
        trading_date,
        bar_datetime,
        futures_id,
        contract_date,
        trading_session,
        (array_agg(price ORDER BY trade_datetime, source_row_no))[1] AS open,
        MAX(price) AS high,
        MIN(price) AS low,
        (array_agg(price ORDER BY trade_datetime DESC, source_row_no DESC))[1] AS close,
        (SUM(volume) / 2)::bigint AS volume,
        SUM(volume)::bigint AS raw_volume,
        COUNT(*)::bigint AS tick_count,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    FROM valid_ticks
    GROUP BY
        source_date, trading_date, bar_datetime,
        futures_id, contract_date, trading_session
    ON CONFLICT(futures_id, contract_date, bar_datetime) DO UPDATE SET
        source_date     = EXCLUDED.source_date,
        trading_date    = EXCLUDED.trading_date,
        trading_session = EXCLUDED.trading_session,
        open            = EXCLUDED.open,
        high            = EXCLUDED.high,
        low             = EXCLUDED.low,
        close           = EXCLUDED.close,
        volume          = EXCLUDED.volume,
        raw_volume      = EXCLUDED.raw_volume,
        tick_count      = EXCLUDED.tick_count,
        updated_at      = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    """

    with db.get_connection() as conn:
        try:
            with conn.cursor() as cur:
                cur.execute(
                    f"""
                    DELETE FROM {target_table}
                    WHERE futures_id = %s
                      AND source_date >= %s
                      AND source_date <= %s
                    """,
                    (fid, start_str, end_str),
                )
                deleted_rows = cur.rowcount
                cur.execute(
                    insert_sql,
                    (fid, start_str, end_str, fid, start_str, end_str),
                )
                inserted_rows = cur.rowcount
            conn.commit()
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise

    utils._sync_date_span_from_actual_table(
        target_table=target_table,
        idx_key=fid,
        idx_field="futures_id",
        date_field="source_date",
    )

    result = db.query_to_df(
        f"""
        SELECT
            futures_id,
            MIN(source_date) AS source_min_date,
            MAX(source_date) AS source_max_date,
            MIN(trading_date) AS trading_min_date,
            MAX(trading_date) AS trading_max_date,
            COUNT(*) AS bar_count,
            COUNT(DISTINCT contract_date) AS contract_count
        FROM {target_table}
        WHERE futures_id = ?
          AND source_date >= ?
          AND source_date <= ?
        GROUP BY futures_id
        """,
        (fid, start_str, end_str),
    )
    if result.empty:
        result = pd.DataFrame([{
            "futures_id": fid,
            "source_min_date": None,
            "source_max_date": None,
            "trading_min_date": None,
            "trading_max_date": None,
            "bar_count": 0,
            "contract_count": 0,
        }])
    result["deleted_rows"] = deleted_rows
    result["inserted_rows"] = inserted_rows
    print(f"✅ {fid} 一分钟 K 重建完成：删除 {deleted_rows} 笔，写入 {inserted_rows} 笔")
    return result

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
import re
from datetime import datetime

import pandas as pd
import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from common import db


TAIFEX_DAILY_URL = "https://www.taifex.com.tw/cht/3/futDataDown"
TAIFEX_DAILY_PAGE = "https://www.taifex.com.tw/cht/3/futDailyMarketView"
TARGET_TABLE = "taifex_futures_daily"
REQUIRED_COLUMN_ALIASES = {
    "交易日期": ("交易日期", "日期"),
    "契約": ("契約",),
    "到期月份(週別)": ("到期月份(週別)", "到期月份"),
    "開盤價": ("開盤價",),
    "最高價": ("最高價",),
    "最低價": ("最低價",),
    # 期交所下載檔曾使用「收盤價」及「最後成交價」兩種名稱。
    "最後成交價": ("最後成交價", "收盤價"),
    "成交量": ("成交量", "合計成交量"),
    "交易時段": ("交易時段",),
}
OPTIONAL_COLUMN_ALIASES = {
    "結算價": ("結算價",),
    "未沖銷契約數": ("未沖銷契約數", "未沖銷契約量"),
}


def _http_session() -> requests.Session:
    retry = Retry(
        total=4,
        connect=4,
        read=4,
        backoff_factor=0.8,
        status_forcelist=(429, 500, 502, 503, 504),
        allowed_methods=frozenset({"POST"}),
    )
    session = requests.Session()
    session.mount("https://", HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry))
    session.headers.update({
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) InvestDashboard/1.0",
        "Referer": TAIFEX_DAILY_PAGE,
        "Origin": "https://www.taifex.com.tw",
    })
    return session


def _number(value, *, integer: bool = False):
    text = str(value or "").strip().replace(",", "")
    if not text or text in {"-", "--"}:
        return None
    number = pd.to_numeric(text, errors="coerce")
    if pd.isna(number):
        return None
    return int(number) if integer else float(number)


def _normalise_header(value: str) -> str:
    """統一期交所 CSV 表頭的換行、空白與星號。"""
    return re.sub(r"\s+", "", str(value or "").replace("\ufeff", "")).lstrip("*")


def _canonicalise_columns(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    normalised_to_actual = {
        _normalise_header(column): column
        for column in frame.columns
    }
    rename_map: dict[str, str] = {}
    missing: list[str] = []

    for canonical, aliases in REQUIRED_COLUMN_ALIASES.items():
        actual = next(
            (
                normalised_to_actual[_normalise_header(alias)]
                for alias in aliases
                if _normalise_header(alias) in normalised_to_actual
            ),
            None,
        )
        if actual is None:
            missing.append(canonical)
        else:
            rename_map[actual] = canonical

    for canonical, aliases in OPTIONAL_COLUMN_ALIASES.items():
        actual = next(
            (
                normalised_to_actual[_normalise_header(alias)]
                for alias in aliases
                if _normalise_header(alias) in normalised_to_actual
            ),
            None,
        )
        if actual is not None:
            rename_map[actual] = canonical

    if missing:
        actual_headers = ", ".join(str(column) for column in frame.columns)
        raise ValueError(
            f"期交所 CSV 缺少欄位：{', '.join(missing)}；"
            f"實際表頭：{actual_headers}"
        )
    return frame.rename(columns=rename_map)


def _parse_csv(content: bytes) -> pd.DataFrame:
    text = content.decode("cp950", errors="ignore").replace("\ufeff", "")
    lines = text.splitlines()
    header_index = next(
        (index for index, line in enumerate(lines) if line.lstrip().startswith("交易日期")),
        None,
    )
    if header_index is None:
        raise ValueError("期交所回應中找不到交易行情 CSV 表頭")

    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO("\n".join(lines[header_index:])))
    rows = list(reader)
    header = [column.strip() for column in rows[0]]

    records: list[list[str]] = []
    for raw_row in rows[1:]:
        row = [column.strip() for column in raw_row]
        while len(row) > len(header) and row[-1] == "":
            row.pop()
        if len(row) == len(header):
            records.append(row)
    return _canonicalise_columns(pd.DataFrame(records, columns=header))


def fetch_daily_market_data(
    start_date: str | datetime | pd.Timestamp,
    end_date: str | datetime | pd.Timestamp,
    commodity_id: str = "TX",
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """下載期交所官方期貨每日交易行情，僅回傳純月份合約。"""
    start = pd.Timestamp(start_date).normalize()
    end = pd.Timestamp(end_date).normalize()
    if start > end:
        raise ValueError("開始日期不可晚於結束日期")

    payload = {
        "down_type": "1",
        "commodity_id": commodity_id,
        "commodity_id2": "",
        "queryStartDate": start.strftime("%Y/%m/%d"),
        "queryEndDate": end.strftime("%Y/%m/%d"),
        "commodity_idt": commodity_id,
        "commodity_id2t": "",
        "button3": "下載",
    }
    with _http_session() as session:
        response = session.post(TAIFEX_DAILY_URL, data=payload, timeout=(10, 60))
        response.raise_for_status()
    source = _parse_csv(response.content)
    source = source.loc[
        (source["契約"].str.strip() == commodity_id)
        & source["到期月份(週別)"].str.strip().str.fullmatch(r"\d{6}", na=False)
    ].copy()
    if source.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=[
            "trade_date", "futures_id", "contract_month", "trading_session",
            "open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "settlement_price", "open_interest",
        ])

    session_map = {"一般": "position", "盤後": "after_market"}
    output = pd.DataFrame({
        "trade_date": pd.to_datetime(source["交易日期"], format="%Y/%m/%d", errors="coerce"),
        "futures_id": source["契約"].str.strip(),
        "contract_month": source["到期月份(週別)"].str.strip(),
        "trading_session": source["交易時段"].str.strip().map(session_map),
        "open": source["開盤價"].map(_number),
        "high": source["最高價"].map(_number),
        "low": source["最低價"].map(_number),
        "close": source["最後成交價"].map(_number),
        "volume": source["成交量"].map(lambda value: _number(value, integer=True)),
        "settlement_price": source.get("結算價", pd.Series(index=source.index, dtype=object)).map(_number),
        "open_interest": source.get("未沖銷契約數", pd.Series(index=source.index, dtype=object)).map(
            lambda value: _number(value, integer=True)
        ),
    })
    output = output.dropna(subset=["trade_date", "trading_session"])
    output["trade_date"] = output["trade_date"].dt.date
    return output.reset_index(drop=True)


def _stored_dates(futures_id: str, start: pd.Timestamp, end: pd.Timestamp) -> set[pd.Timestamp]:
    frame = db.query_to_df(
        f"""
        SELECT DISTINCT trade_date FROM {TARGET_TABLE}
        WHERE futures_id = ? AND trade_date BETWEEN ? AND ?
        """,
        (futures_id, start.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), end.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")),
    )
    return set(pd.to_datetime(frame["trade_date"]).dt.normalize()) if not frame.empty else set()


def _expected_dates(futures_id: str, start: pd.Timestamp, end: pd.Timestamp) -> list[pd.Timestamp]:
    frame = db.query_to_df(
        """
        SELECT DISTINCT date
        FROM fm_taiwan_futures_daily
        WHERE futures_id = ? AND trading_session = 'position' AND date BETWEEN ? AND ?
        ORDER BY date
        """,
        (futures_id, start.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), end.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")),
    )
    dates = list(pd.to_datetime(frame["date"]).dt.normalize()) if not frame.empty else []
    # FinMind 尚未出現的最新幾天仍需向官方查詢；週末不會成為永久缺口。
    recent_start = max(start, end - pd.Timedelta(days=10))
    dates.extend(pd.date_range(recent_start, end, freq="B"))
    return sorted(set(dates))


def sync_taifex_futures_daily(
    futures_id: str,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    *,
    recent_refresh_days: int = 10,
    chunk_days: int = 30,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """依資料庫快取下載期交所行情；近期區間固定重抓以接收延遲補檔。"""
    start = pd.Timestamp(start_date).normalize()
    end = pd.Timestamp(end_date).normalize()
    # 期交所範圍下載若帶入未來日期，可能回傳非 CSV 頁面。
    # FinMind 可依下一交易日歸屬日取得夜盤，但官方同步一律不查今日以後。
    end = min(end, pd.Timestamp.now().normalize())
    if start > end:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    refresh_start = max(start, end - pd.Timedelta(days=max(0, recent_refresh_days)))
    stored = _stored_dates(futures_id, start, end)
    expected = _expected_dates(futures_id, start, end)
    needed = [date for date in expected if date >= refresh_start or date not in stored]
    if needed:
        ranges: list[tuple[pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]] = []
        range_start = range_end = needed[0]
        for date in needed[1:]:
            if (date - range_end).days <= 7 and (date - range_start).days < chunk_days:
                range_end = date
            else:
                ranges.append((range_start, range_end))
                range_start = range_end = date
        ranges.append((range_start, range_end))

        for first, last in ranges:
            frame = fetch_daily_market_data(first, last, futures_id)
            if not frame.empty:
                ok = db.execute_sql(
                    f"""
                    INSERT INTO {TARGET_TABLE} (
                        trade_date, futures_id, contract_month, trading_session,
                        open, high, low, close, volume, settlement_price, open_interest
                    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                    ON CONFLICT (trade_date, futures_id, contract_month, trading_session) DO UPDATE SET
                        open = excluded.open, high = excluded.high, low = excluded.low,
                        close = excluded.close, volume = excluded.volume,
                        settlement_price = excluded.settlement_price,
                        open_interest = excluded.open_interest,
                        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    """,
                    list(frame.itertuples(index=False, name=None)),
                )
                if not ok:
                    raise RuntimeError("期交所官方行情寫入 PostgreSQL 失敗")

    return db.query_to_df(
        f"SELECT * FROM {TARGET_TABLE} WHERE futures_id = ? AND trade_date BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY trade_date, trading_session, contract_month",
        (futures_id, start.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), end.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")),
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    today = pd.Timestamp.today().normalize()
    print(sync_taifex_futures_daily("TX", today - pd.Timedelta(days=14), today + pd.Timedelta(days=4)))

"""Shared TX minute-bar contract selection used by charts and turning reports.

The input CTE must be named ``tx_contract_candidates`` and contain:
``bar_datetime, trading_date, trading_session, contract_date, volume`` plus
the OHLC columns needed by its consumer.

Selection is performed once for the whole trading date/session.  It first
uses the same front-month calendar rule as the daily futures report; if that
contract is unavailable, it falls back to the session's largest total volume.
This intentionally avoids switching contracts minute by minute.
"""

TX_FIXED_CONTRACT_CTES = r"""
, tx_contract_totals AS (
    SELECT
        trading_date,
        trading_session,
        contract_date,
        SUM(COALESCE(volume, 0)) AS session_volume
    FROM tx_contract_candidates
    GROUP BY trading_date, trading_session, contract_date
), tx_contract_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        totals.*,
        front.contract_month AS calendar_front_month,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY totals.trading_date, totals.trading_session
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN front.contract_month IS NOT NULL
                     AND totals.contract_date = front.contract_month THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END,
                totals.session_volume DESC,
                totals.contract_date ASC
        ) AS contract_rank
    FROM tx_contract_totals totals
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT settlement.contract_month
        FROM fm_taiwan_futures_final_settlement_price settlement
        WHERE settlement.futures_id = 'TX'
          AND settlement.futures_type = 'index'
          AND settlement.contract_month NOT LIKE '%W%'
          AND LENGTH(settlement.contract_month) = 6
          AND settlement.date >= totals.trading_date
        ORDER BY settlement.date ASC
        LIMIT 1
    ) front ON TRUE
), tx_selected_contracts AS (
    SELECT trading_date, trading_session, contract_date
    FROM tx_contract_ranked
    WHERE contract_rank = 1
), tx_selected_minutes AS (
    SELECT candidates.*
    FROM tx_contract_candidates candidates
    JOIN tx_selected_contracts selected
      ON selected.trading_date = candidates.trading_date
     AND selected.trading_session = candidates.trading_session
     AND selected.contract_date = candidates.contract_date
)
"""

"""TX five-minute session turning levels. No candles after the session are used."""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json
import math

from module.futures_kline_contract import TX_FIXED_CONTRACT_CTES

COLUMNS = ('日盤轉折支撐', '日盤轉折壓力', '夜盤轉折支撐', '夜盤轉折壓力')
TURNING_RULE_VERSION = '2026-10-20-v2-last-extreme-time'


def calculate_bars(rows, seed=None):
    """SMA-seeded EMA12/26, continuous across sessions, with resumable state."""
    state = dict(seed or {'n': 0, 'fast_sum': 0., 'slow_sum': 0.,
                          'fast': None, 'slow': None, 'dif': None})
    result = []
    for source in rows:
        row = dict(source)
        close = float(row['close'])
        state['n'] += 1
        n = state['n']
        if n <= 12: state['fast_sum'] += close
        if n <= 26: state['slow_sum'] += close
        if n == 12: state['fast'] = state['fast_sum'] / 12
        elif n > 12: state['fast'] += (close - state['fast']) * 2 / 13
        if n == 26: state['slow'] = state['slow_sum'] / 26
        elif n > 26: state['slow'] += (close - state['slow']) * 2 / 27
        previous = state['dif']
        dif = None if state['slow'] is None else state['fast'] - state['slow']
        direction = None if dif is None or previous is None else (1 if dif > previous else -1 if dif < previous else 0)
        state['dif'] = dif
        row.update(dif=dif, direction=direction, ema_state=dict(state))
        result.append(row)
    return result


def find_turning_match(bars, support=True, previous_direction=None, previous_close=None):
    """Return provenance using the same ranking/search used for report values."""
    key = 'low' if support else 'high'
    wanted = 1 if support else -1
    candidates = sorted(range(len(bars)), key=lambda i: (float(bars[i][key]) * (1 if support else -1), bars[i]['time']))
    # Only the session's first candle at its absolute extreme may bypass reversal.
    # The previous candle is historical; no candle after this session is consulted.
    if candidates and candidates[0] == 0 and previous_close is not None:
        first = bars[0]
        if (first['direction'] == wanted and previous_direction == wanted
                and (float(first['close']) - float(previous_close)) * wanted > 0):
            return dict(value=float(first['close']), candidate_index=0,
                        selected_index=0, candidate_rank=1,
                        rule='優先例外：首根極值K、前後DIF同向、收盤同向')
    for rank, index in enumerate(candidates, 1):
        direction = bars[index]['direction']
        selected = None
        rule = ''
        if direction == -wanted:
            selected = next((i for i in range(index + 1, len(bars)) if bars[i]['direction'] == wanted), None)
            rule = '規則1：右側第一根DIF反向K'
        elif direction == wanted:
            left = bars[index - 1]['direction'] if index else previous_direction
            if left == -wanted:
                selected = index
                rule = '規則2：左側立即前一根DIF反向'
        if selected is not None:
            return dict(value=float(bars[selected]['close']), candidate_index=index,
                        selected_index=selected, candidate_rank=rank, rule=rule)
    return None


def find_turning(bars, support=True, previous_direction=None, previous_close=None):
    match = find_turning_match(bars, support, previous_direction, previous_close)
    return match['value'] if match else None


def session_trend(bars):
    """依最後一次最高／最低點的實際一分 K 時間判定時段走勢。"""
    if not bars:
        return None
    highest = max(float(bar['high']) for bar in bars)
    lowest = min(float(bar['low']) for bar in bars)
    if highest == lowest:
        return None
    last_high_time = max(
        bar.get('high_time', bar['time'])
        for bar in bars if float(bar['high']) == highest
    )
    last_low_time = max(
        bar.get('low_time', bar['time'])
        for bar in bars if float(bar['low']) == lowest
    )
    if last_high_time > last_low_time:
        return '漲勢盤'
    if last_low_time > last_high_time:
        return '跌勢盤'
    return None


def _is_settlement_session(items, session):
    """Whether the selected day-session contract expires on this trading day."""
    return session == 'position' and any(
        bool(item.get('is_settlement_day', False)) for item in items
    )


def _session_window(day, session, settlement_day=False):
    start = datetime.combine(day, datetime.min.time()) + (
        timedelta(hours=8, minutes=45)
        if session == 'position'
        else timedelta(hours=15)
    )
    # The expiring TX contract stops at 13:30 on its final settlement day.
    # Other day sessions still have to cover the normal 13:45 close.
    if session == 'position' and settlement_day:
        return start, datetime.combine(day, datetime.min.time()) + timedelta(hours=13, minutes=30)
    return start, start + (
        timedelta(hours=5) if session == 'position' else timedelta(hours=14)
    )


def _session_is_complete(items, day, session, now):
    start, end = _session_window(
        day, session, _is_settlement_session(items, session)
    )
    return (
        now >= end
        and items[0]['time'] <= start + timedelta(minutes=5)
        and items[-1]['last_time'] >= end - timedelta(minutes=5)
    )


def session_results(bars, now=None, previous_direction=None, previous_close=None):
    now = now or datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Taipei')).replace(tzinfo=None)
    groups = {}
    previous = previous_direction
    prior_close = previous_close
    for bar in bars:
        key = (bar['session_date'], bar['session'])
        if key not in groups: groups[key] = ([], previous, prior_close)
        groups[key][0].append(bar)
        previous = bar['direction']
        prior_close = bar['close']
    results = []
    for (date, session), (items, left, left_close) in groups.items():
        # Incomplete/in-progress sessions cannot represent the whole interval.
        complete = _session_is_complete(items, date, session, now)
        results.append((date, session, find_turning(items, True, left, left_close) if complete else None,
                        find_turning(items, False, left, left_close) if complete else None))
    return results

);
ALTER TABLE report.futures_turning_5m_bars
 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS contract_date text;
ALTER TABLE report.futures_turning_5m_bars
 ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_settlement_day boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

def ensure_turning_views():
    """Wrap the public report, keeping old dependent views/cache layouts intact."""
    from common import db
    current_comment = str(db.query_single_value(
        "SELECT obj_description(to_regclass('report.futures_turning_levels'), 'pg_class')"
    ) or '')
    rule_changed = TURNING_RULE_VERSION not in current_comment
    if not db.execute_sql(DDL): raise RuntimeError('建立轉折結果資料表失敗')
    # Renaming preserves existing dependent objects; the new public name exposes
    # columns at the required ordinal positions without DROP ... CASCADE.
    statement = '''
DO $turning$
DECLARE fields text;
DECLARE additions text :=
 't."日盤走勢", '
 't."日盤轉折支撐", t."日盤轉折壓力", '
 't."夜盤走勢", '
 't."夜盤轉折支撐", t."夜盤轉折壓力"';
BEGIN
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(26100451);
 IF to_regclass('report.v_futures_report_daily_without_turning') IS NULL THEN
   ALTER VIEW report.v_futures_report_daily RENAME TO v_futures_report_daily_without_turning;
 END IF;
 -- PostgreSQL cannot insert columns in the middle with CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW.
 -- Rename the old wrappers instead of dropping them: database objects depending
 -- on their OIDs remain valid, while the public names can expose the new order.
 IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
            WHERE n.nspname='report' AND c.relname='v_futures_report_daily')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute
                    WHERE attrelid=to_regclass('report.v_futures_report_daily')
                      AND attname='日盤走勢' AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped) THEN
   IF to_regclass('report.v_futures_report_daily_without_session_trend') IS NULL THEN
     ALTER VIEW report.v_futures_report_daily RENAME TO v_futures_report_daily_without_session_trend;
   ELSE
     RAISE EXCEPTION '舊版相容 View 已存在，但公開 View 尚無日盤走勢，請檢查資料庫遷移狀態';
   END IF;
 END IF;
 IF to_regclass('report.v_futures_report_daily_corrected_turning') IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute
                    WHERE attrelid=to_regclass('report.v_futures_report_daily_corrected_turning')
                      AND attname='日盤走勢' AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped) THEN
   IF to_regclass('report.v_futures_report_daily_corrected_turning_without_session_trend') IS NULL THEN
     ALTER VIEW report.v_futures_report_daily_corrected_turning
       RENAME TO v_futures_report_daily_corrected_turning_without_session_trend;
   ELSE
     RAISE EXCEPTION '舊版修正版相容 View 已存在，但公開 View 尚無日盤走勢';
   END IF;
 END IF;
 IF to_regclass('report.v_futures_dashboard_turning') IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute
                    WHERE attrelid=to_regclass('report.v_futures_dashboard_turning')
                      AND attname='日盤走勢' AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped) THEN
   IF to_regclass('report.v_futures_dashboard_turning_without_session_trend') IS NULL THEN
     ALTER VIEW report.v_futures_dashboard_turning
       RENAME TO v_futures_dashboard_turning_without_session_trend;
   ELSE
     RAISE EXCEPTION '舊版 Dashboard 相容 View 已存在，但公開 View 尚無日盤走勢';
   END IF;
 END IF;
 SELECT string_agg(format('b.%I', attname) || CASE WHEN attname='買賣權比_週五' THEN ', '||additions ELSE '' END, ', ' ORDER BY attnum)
 INTO fields FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='report.v_futures_report_daily_without_turning'::regclass AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped;
 EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW report.v_futures_report_daily AS SELECT '||fields||
 ' FROM report.v_futures_report_daily_without_turning b LEFT JOIN report.futures_turning_levels t ON t.futures_id=b.futures_id AND t."日期"=b."日期"';
 SELECT string_agg(format('b.%I', attname) || CASE WHEN attname='買賣權比_週五' THEN ', '||additions ELSE '' END, ', ' ORDER BY attnum)
 INTO fields FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='report.v_futures_report_daily_corrected'::regclass AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped;
 EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW report.v_futures_report_daily_corrected_turning AS SELECT '||fields||
 ' FROM report.v_futures_report_daily_corrected b LEFT JOIN report.futures_turning_levels t ON t.futures_id=b.futures_id AND t."日期"=b."日期"';
 IF to_regclass('report.futures_report_daily_dashboard_cache') IS NOT NULL THEN
   SELECT string_agg(format('b.%I', attname) || CASE WHEN attname='買賣權比_週五' THEN ', '||additions ELSE '' END, ', ' ORDER BY attnum)
   INTO fields FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='report.futures_report_daily_dashboard_cache'::regclass AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped;
   EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW report.v_futures_dashboard_turning AS SELECT '||fields||
   ' FROM report.futures_report_daily_dashboard_cache b LEFT JOIN report.futures_turning_levels t ON t.futures_id=b.futures_id AND t."日期"=b."日期"';
 END IF;
END $turning$;
'''
    if not db.execute_sql(statement): raise RuntimeError('安裝轉折報表 View 失敗')
    return rule_changed


SOURCE_SQL = f'''
WITH tx_contract_candidates AS (
 SELECT bar_datetime, trading_date, trading_session, contract_date,
        open, high, low, close, volume
 FROM fm_taiwan_futures_kbar_1m
 WHERE futures_id='TX'
   AND trading_session IN ('position','after_market')
   AND contract_date ~ '^[0-9]{{6}}$'
   AND bar_datetime >= ?
)
{TX_FIXED_CONTRACT_CTES}
, sessions AS (
 SELECT selected.*,
   CASE WHEN trading_session='position' THEN bar_datetime::date
   WHEN bar_datetime::time >= TIME '15:00' THEN bar_datetime::date ELSE bar_datetime::date-1 END AS session_date
  , EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM fm_taiwan_futures_final_settlement_price settlement
      WHERE settlement.futures_id = 'TX'
        AND settlement.futures_type = 'index'
        AND settlement.contract_month = selected.contract_date
        AND settlement.date = selected.trading_date
    ) AS is_settlement_day
 FROM tx_selected_minutes selected
 WHERE TRUE
 AND ((trading_session='position' AND bar_datetime::time BETWEEN TIME '08:45' AND TIME '13:45')
 OR (trading_session='after_market' AND (bar_datetime::time>=TIME '15:00' OR bar_datetime::time<=TIME '05:00')))
), buckets AS (
 SELECT *, session_date + CASE WHEN trading_session='position' THEN TIME '08:45' ELSE TIME '15:00' END AS origin
 FROM sessions
), grouped AS (
 SELECT *, origin + floor(extract(epoch FROM (bar_datetime-origin))/300)*INTERVAL '5 minutes' AS bar_time
 FROM buckets
)
SELECT min(bar_datetime) AS time, session_date, trading_session AS session,
 min(contract_date) AS contract_date,
 bool_or(is_settlement_day) AS is_settlement_day,
 max(high) AS high, min(low) AS low,
 (array_agg(bar_datetime ORDER BY high DESC, bar_datetime DESC))[1] AS high_time,
 (array_agg(bar_datetime ORDER BY low ASC, bar_datetime DESC))[1] AS low_time,
 (array_agg(close ORDER BY bar_datetime DESC))[1] AS close, max(bar_datetime) AS last_time
FROM grouped GROUP BY session_date,trading_session,bar_time ORDER BY time
'''


AUDIT_FIELDS = ['日期', '時段', '選用契約', '是否結算日', '欄位', '轉折值', '狀態', '規則', '候選順位',
    '候選K時間', '候選高', '候選低', '候選收', '候選DIF', '候選前DIF', '候選DIF方向',
    '取價K時間', '取價K最後1分時間', '取價K收', '取價DIF', '取價前DIF', '取價DIF方向',
    '左側K時間', '左側DIF', '左側DIF方向', '區間開始', '區間結束', '實際首K時間', '實際末1分時間', '是否首根極值例外', '左側K收盤']


def turning_audit_rows(bars, now=None):
    now = now or datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Taipei')).replace(tzinfo=None)
    groups = {}
    previous = None
    for source in bars:
        bar = dict(source)
        bar['previous_dif'] = previous.get('dif') if previous else None
        key = (bar['session_date'], bar['session'])
        if key not in groups: groups[key] = ([], previous)
        groups[key][0].append(bar)
        previous = bar
    output = []
    direction_name = lambda value: {1: '上', -1: '下', 0: '平'}.get(value, '不足')
    for (day, session), (items, prior) in groups.items():
        settlement_day = _is_settlement_session(items, session)
        start, end = _session_window(day, session, settlement_day)
        status = '尚未收盤' if now < end else ('區間資料不完整' if items[0]['time'] > start + timedelta(minutes=5) or items[-1]['last_time'] < end - timedelta(minutes=5) else '完整')
        for support, field in zip((True, False), COLUMNS[:2] if session == 'position' else COLUMNS[2:]):
            row = dict.fromkeys(AUDIT_FIELDS, '')
            row.update({'日期': day, '時段': '日盤' if session == 'position' else '夜盤',
                '選用契約': items[0].get('contract_date', ''), '是否結算日': '是' if settlement_day else '否', '欄位': field,
                '狀態': status, '區間開始': start, '區間結束': end,
                '實際首K時間': items[0]['time'], '實際末1分時間': items[-1]['last_time']})
            match = find_turning_match(items, support, prior.get('direction') if prior else None, prior.get('close') if prior else None) if status == '完整' else None
            if match:
                candidate = items[match['candidate_index']]
                selected = items[match['selected_index']]
                left = items[match['candidate_index'] - 1] if match['candidate_index'] else prior
                row.update({'轉折值': match['value'], '狀態': '命中',
                    '是否首根極值例外': '是' if match['rule'].startswith('優先例外') else '否',
                    '左側K收盤': left['close'] if left else '', '規則': match['rule'], '候選順位': match['candidate_rank'],
                    '候選K時間': candidate['time'], '候選高': candidate['high'], '候選低': candidate['low'], '候選收': candidate['close'],
                    '候選DIF': candidate.get('dif'), '候選前DIF': candidate.get('previous_dif'), '候選DIF方向': direction_name(candidate['direction']),
                    '取價K時間': selected['time'], '取價K最後1分時間': selected['last_time'], '取價K收': selected['close'],
                    '取價DIF': selected.get('dif'), '取價前DIF': selected.get('previous_dif'), '取價DIF方向': direction_name(selected['direction']),
                    '左側K時間': left['time'] if left else '', '左側DIF': left.get('dif') if left else '',
                    '左側DIF方向': direction_name(left['direction']) if left else '不足'})
            elif status == '完整': row['狀態'] = '未找到符合規則的轉折'
            output.append(row)
    return output


def export_turning_audit(output_path=None):
    """Overwrite one UTF-8 BOM CSV from the full cached bar history, atomically."""
    import csv
    import os
    import tempfile
    from pathlib import Path
    from common import db
    path = Path(output_path) if output_path else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'output' / 'futures_turning_debug.csv'
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    frame = db.query_to_df('SELECT bar_time AS time, session_date, session, contract_date, is_settlement_day, high, low, close, last_time, dif, direction FROM report.futures_turning_5m_bars ORDER BY bar_time')
    bars = frame.to_dict('records')
    for bar in bars:
        for key in ('dif', 'direction'):
            if bar[key] is not None and not math.isfinite(float(bar[key])): bar[key] = None
        if hasattr(bar['session_date'], 'date'): bar['session_date'] = bar['session_date'].date()
    temporary = None
    try:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='', dir=path.parent, delete=False) as stream:
            temporary = stream.name
            writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=AUDIT_FIELDS)
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(turning_audit_rows(bars))
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if temporary and os.path.exists(temporary): os.unlink(temporary)
    print(f'[轉折除錯CSV] {path}')
    return path


def _refresh_turning_levels(*, full=False, start_date=None):
    """Initial history build, then exact EMA continuation over a refreshed tail.

    For revisions earlier than the tail, use full=True or the earliest changed
    start_date; all later EMA/session results are rebuilt from that point.
    """
    from common import db
    rule_changed = ensure_turning_views()
    latest = db.query_single_value('SELECT max(bar_time) FROM report.futures_turning_5m_bars')
    start = datetime(1900,1,1) if full or rule_changed or latest is None else datetime.combine((latest - timedelta(days=14)).date(), datetime.min.time()) + timedelta(hours=8, minutes=45)
    if start_date is not None and not full:
        start = min(start, datetime.combine(start_date, datetime.min.time()) + timedelta(hours=8, minutes=45))
    checkpoint = db.query_to_df('SELECT direction,close,ema_state FROM report.futures_turning_5m_bars WHERE bar_time < ? ORDER BY bar_time DESC LIMIT 1', (start,))
    seed = None if checkpoint.empty else checkpoint.iloc[0]['ema_state']
    if isinstance(seed, str): seed = json.loads(seed)
    prior_value = None if checkpoint.empty else checkpoint.iloc[0]['direction']
    prior = int(prior_value) if prior_value is not None and math.isfinite(float(prior_value)) else None
    frame = db.query_to_df(SOURCE_SQL, (start,))
    rows = frame.to_dict('records')
    for row in rows:
        row['time'] = row['time'].to_pydatetime() if hasattr(row['time'],'to_pydatetime') else row['time']
        row['last_time'] = row['last_time'].to_pydatetime() if hasattr(row['last_time'],'to_pydatetime') else row['last_time']
        if hasattr(row['session_date'],'date'): row['session_date'] = row['session_date'].date()
    bars = calculate_bars(rows, seed)
    now = datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Taipei')).replace(tzinfo=None)
    results = session_results(bars, now=now, previous_direction=prior,
                              previous_close=None if checkpoint.empty else checkpoint.iloc[0].get('close'))
    grouped_bars = {}
    for bar in bars:
        grouped_bars.setdefault((bar['session_date'], bar['session']), []).append(bar)
    trends = {
        key: session_trend(items) if _session_is_complete(items, key[0], key[1], now) else None
        for key, items in grouped_bars.items()
    }
    # Replace the refreshed tail and its levels in one transaction.
    with db.get_connection() as conn:
        conn.execute('DELETE FROM report.futures_turning_5m_bars WHERE bar_time >= %s', (start,))
        conn.execute('DELETE FROM report.futures_turning_levels WHERE "日期" >= %s', (start.date(),))
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.executemany('''
                INSERT INTO report.futures_turning_5m_bars
                    (bar_time, session_date, session, contract_date, is_settlement_day,
                     high, low, close, last_time, dif, direction, ema_state)
                VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s::jsonb)
            ''',
                [(b['time'],b['session_date'],b['session'],b.get('contract_date'),bool(b.get('is_settlement_day',False)),float(b['high']),float(b['low']),float(b['close']),b['last_time'],b['dif'],b['direction'],json.dumps(b['ema_state'])) for b in bars])
            for date, session, support, resistance in results:
                names = COLUMNS[:2] if session=='position' else COLUMNS[2:]
                trend_name = '日盤走勢' if session == 'position' else '夜盤走勢'
                trend = trends.get((date, session))
                cur.execute(f'INSERT INTO report.futures_turning_levels (futures_id,"日期","{names[0]}","{names[1]}","{trend_name}") VALUES (\'TX\',%s,%s,%s,%s) ON CONFLICT (futures_id,"日期") DO UPDATE SET "{names[0]}"=EXCLUDED."{names[0]}","{names[1]}"=EXCLUDED."{names[1]}","{trend_name}"=EXCLUDED."{trend_name}"', (date,support,resistance,trend))
        conn.commit()
    if not db.execute_sql(
        "COMMENT ON TABLE report.futures_turning_levels IS "
        f"'{TURNING_RULE_VERSION}；走勢依最後一次最高／最低點時間判定。'"
    ):
        raise RuntimeError('寫入轉折規則版本失敗')
    try:
        export_turning_audit()
    except OSError as exc:
        print(f'[轉折除錯CSV] 寫入失敗（資料庫結果已提交）：{exc}')
    return len(results)


def refresh_turning_levels(*, full=False, start_date=None):
    from common import db
    # Serialize report/minute-bar refreshes to protect the exact EMA checkpoint.
    with db.get_connection() as lock_connection:
        lock_connection.execute('SELECT pg_advisory_lock(26100450)')
        try:
            return _refresh_turning_levels(full=full, start_date=start_date)
        finally:
            lock_connection.execute('SELECT pg_advisory_unlock(26100450)')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import argparse
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--full',action='store_true');parser.add_argument('--audit-only',action='store_true')
    args=parser.parse_args()
    if args.audit_only: export_turning_audit()
    else: print(f'轉折支撐壓力更新完成：{refresh_turning_levels(full=args.full)} 個時段')

from datetime import datetime
import pandas as pd
from common import db
from module import finMind as fm

# =========================================================
# 共用工具
# =========================================================
def _to_ts(x) -> pd.Timestamp:
    return pd.Timestamp(x).normalize()


def _dstr(x) -> str:
    return _to_ts(x).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")


def _weekday_text(ts: pd.Timestamp) -> str:
    mapping = {
        0: "星期一",
        1: "星期二",
        2: "星期三",
        3: "星期四",
        4: "星期五",
        5: "星期六",
        6: "星期日",
    }
    return mapping[ts.weekday()]


def _day_type_text(ts: pd.Timestamp) -> str:
    weekday = ts.weekday()
    if weekday == 0:
        return "頭"
    if weekday in (1, 2, 3):
        return "週間"
    if weekday == 4:
        return "尾"
    return "週間"


def _classify_k_type(open_price, close_price, high_price, low_price):
    values = (open_price, close_price, high_price, low_price)
    if any(v is None or pd.isna(v) for v in values):
        return None

    price_range = high_price - low_price
    if price_range == 0:
        return None

    body = abs(close_price - open_price) / price_range
    upper = (high_price - max(open_price, close_price)) / price_range
    lower = (min(open_price, close_price) - low_price) / price_range

    if abs(close_price - open_price) < 1e-6 or body < 0.05:
        return "⬜ 十字線"

    color = "🟥" if close_price > open_price else "🟩"
    if lower > 0.5 and body < 0.3:
        return f"{color} 錘子線"
    if upper > 0.5 and body < 0.3:
        return f"{color} 流星線"
    if body > 0.6:
        return f"{color} 長紅K" if close_price > open_price else f"{color} 長黑K"
    return f"{color} 中實體K"


def _week_no(ts: pd.Timestamp) -> int:
    return int(ts.isocalendar().week)


def _sync_date_span_from_table(
    target_table: str,
    idx_key: str,
    idx_field: str,
    date_field: str,
):
    span_df = db.query_to_df(
        f"""
        SELECT MIN({date_field}) AS min_date, MAX({date_field}) AS max_date
        FROM {target_table}
        WHERE {idx_field} = ?
        """,
        (str(idx_key),),
    )

    actual_s = (
        pd.Timestamp(span_df.loc[0, "min_date"]).normalize()
        if not span_df.empty and pd.notna(span_df.loc[0, "min_date"])
        else None
    )
    actual_e = (
        pd.Timestamp(span_df.loc[0, "max_date"]).normalize()
        if not span_df.empty and pd.notna(span_df.loc[0, "max_date"])
        else None
    )

    print(
        f"[sync_date_span] table={target_table}, idx_key={idx_key}, "
        f"actual_s={_dstr(actual_s) if actual_s is not None else None}, "
        f"actual_e={_dstr(actual_e) if actual_e is not None else None}"
    )

    if actual_s is None or actual_e is None:
        return

    db.execute_sql(
        """
        INSERT INTO date_span (target_table, idx_key, start_date, end_date, updated_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
        ON CONFLICT(target_table, idx_key) DO UPDATE SET
          start_date = excluded.start_date,
          end_date   = excluded.end_date,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        """,
        (target_table, str(idx_key), _dstr(actual_s), _dstr(actual_e)),
    )

# 來源資料 helper
