"""加權報表成交金額規則的一次性全歷史升級標記。"""
from __future__ import annotations

from common import db


RULE_NAME = "taiex-price-volume-basis"
# 這個版本只代表「價量欄位改用成交金額計算」。欄位排列是 View 的版面
# 問題，不能再改動此版本，否則日常更新會誤判成需要重算 1999 年至今。
# v3 才完整涵蓋最大量／均量／量增率／價量等所有量能衍生欄位。
# v1、v2 可能只更新部分公式，不能視為相容，否則歷史列不會重算。
RULE_VERSION = "2026-10-23-v3-all-volume-derived-from-trading-money"
COMPATIBLE_RULE_VERSIONS = {RULE_VERSION}
_VIEW_READY = False


def ensure_rule_table() -> None:
    if db.query_single_value("SELECT to_regclass('report.report_rule_versions')") is None and not db.execute_sql(
        """
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS report.report_rule_versions (
            rule_name text PRIMARY KEY,
            rule_version text NOT NULL,
            applied_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        )
        """
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("無法建立報表規則版本表")

    ensure_turnover_view()


def ensure_turnover_view() -> None:
    """只在 View 不存在或欄位版本過舊時建立，不在查詢時反覆重建。"""
    global _VIEW_READY
    if _VIEW_READY:
        return

    order_is_correct = bool(db.query_single_value(
        """
        WITH positions AS (
          SELECT column_name, ordinal_position
          FROM information_schema.columns
          WHERE table_schema = 'report'
            AND table_name = 'v_taiex_report_turnover'
        )
        SELECT
          (SELECT ordinal_position FROM positions WHERE column_name = '成交金額') =
          (SELECT ordinal_position FROM positions WHERE column_name = '成交股數') + 1
          AND
          (SELECT ordinal_position FROM positions WHERE column_name = '總成交金額_億') =
          (SELECT ordinal_position FROM positions WHERE column_name = '布林下軌') + 1
        """
    ))
    if order_is_correct:
        _VIEW_READY = True
        return

    # PostgreSQL 的 CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW 不能調整既有欄位順序，因此只在
    # 欄位順序錯誤時重建一次。基底 View 原有的「總成交金額_億」位置會保留，
    # 也就是緊接在「布林下軌」之後。
    if not db.execute_sql(
        """
        DO $turnover$
        DECLARE fields text;
        BEGIN
          PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('report.v_taiex_report_turnover'));
          SELECT string_agg(
            CASE
              WHEN attname = '成交量' THEN
                format('b.%I AS %I, b.%I AS %I',
                       '成交量', '成交股數', '總成交金額_億', '成交金額')
              ELSE format('b.%I', attname)
            END,
            ', ' ORDER BY attnum
          ) INTO fields
          FROM pg_attribute
          WHERE attrelid = 'report.v_taiex_report'::regclass
            AND attnum > 0 AND NOT attisdropped;
          DROP VIEW IF EXISTS report.v_taiex_report_turnover;
          EXECUTE 'CREATE VIEW report.v_taiex_report_turnover AS SELECT '
                  || fields || ' FROM report.v_taiex_report b';
        END $turnover$;
        """
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("無法建立成交金額版加權報表 View")
    _VIEW_READY = True


def taiex_base_view_uses_trading_money() -> bool:
    """確認 View 的量能視窗公式已經使用總成交金額，而非成交股數。"""
    definition = db.query_single_value(
        "SELECT pg_get_viewdef('report.v_taiex_report_base'::regclass, true)"
    )
    if not definition:
        return False
    definition = str(definition)
    required = (
        'lag(b."總成交金額_億", 1)',
        'avg(b."總成交金額_億")',
        'max(x."總成交金額_億")',
        'c."總成交金額_億" - c."昨量"',
        'c."總成交金額_億" - c."VOLMA5_calc"',
    )
    forbidden = (
        'lag(b."成交量", 1)',
        'avg(b."成交量")',
        'max(x."成交量")',
        'c."成交量" - c."昨量"',
        'c."成交量" - c."VOLMA5_calc"',
    )
    return all(token in definition for token in required) and not any(
        token in definition for token in forbidden
    )


def migrate_taiex_base_view_to_trading_money() -> None:
    """一次性修正 v_taiex_report_base 內仍引用成交股數的量能公式。

    保留輸出欄位「成交量」作為成交股數；只替換計算運算元，因此不會
    改變既有 View 欄位順序、名稱或相依 View 的介面。
    """
    if taiex_base_view_uses_trading_money():
        print("[加權量能] SQL View 已使用成交金額，略過遷移。")
        return

    ok = db.execute_sql(
        r'''
        DO $migration$
        DECLARE
          definition text;
        BEGIN
          PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('report.v_taiex_report_base:turnover-v3'));
          definition := pg_get_viewdef('report.v_taiex_report_base'::regclass, true);

          definition := replace(definition,
            'lag(b."成交量", 1)', 'lag(b."總成交金額_億", 1)');
          definition := replace(definition,
            'count(b."成交量")', 'count(b."總成交金額_億")');
          definition := replace(definition,
            'avg(b."成交量")', 'avg(b."總成交金額_億")');
          definition := replace(definition,
            'max(x."成交量")', 'max(x."總成交金額_億")');
          definition := replace(definition,
            'ORDER BY x."成交量" DESC', 'ORDER BY x."總成交金額_億" DESC');
          definition := replace(definition,
            'c."成交量" - c."昨量"', 'c."總成交金額_億" - c."昨量"');
          definition := replace(definition,
            'c."成交量" - c."VOLMA5_calc"', 'c."總成交金額_億" - c."VOLMA5_calc"');
          definition := replace(definition,
            'c."成交量" - c."VOLMA10_calc"', 'c."總成交金額_億" - c."VOLMA10_calc"');
          definition := replace(definition,
            'c."成交量" - c."VOLMA20_calc"', 'c."總成交金額_億" - c."VOLMA20_calc"');
          definition := replace(definition,
            'c."成交量" - c."VOLMA60_calc"', 'c."總成交金額_億" - c."VOLMA60_calc"');

          EXECUTE 'CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW report.v_taiex_report_base AS ' || definition;
        END $migration$;
        ''',
    )
    if not ok or not taiex_base_view_uses_trading_money():
        raise RuntimeError("加權報表 SQL View 的成交金額量能公式遷移失敗")
    print("[加權量能] SQL View 已全面改用總成交金額_億。")


def needs_full_rebuild() -> bool:
    ensure_rule_table()
    current = db.query_single_value(
        "SELECT rule_version FROM report.report_rule_versions WHERE rule_name = ?",
        (RULE_NAME,),
    )
    return current not in COMPATIBLE_RULE_VERSIONS


def mark_applied() -> None:
    if not db.execute_sql(
        """
        INSERT INTO report.report_rule_versions (rule_name, rule_version, applied_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
        ON CONFLICT (rule_name) DO UPDATE SET
            rule_version = excluded.rule_version,
            applied_at = excluded.applied_at
        """,
        (RULE_NAME, RULE_VERSION),
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("無法寫入加權成交金額規則版本")

import re
import time
import requests
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional, Tuple, List
from common import db  # 你原本的 DB 模組

# ============================================================
# helpers
# ============================================================

def _dstr(ts: pd.Timestamp) -> str:
    return ts.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")


def _to_unix_ts(date_yyyy_mm_dd: str) -> int:
    # date string -> unix seconds (00:00:00 local)
    dt = pd.Timestamp(date_yyyy_mm_dd).to_pydatetime()
    return int(time.mktime(dt.timetuple()))


def _clean_float(x) -> Optional[float]:
    if x is None:
        return None
    s = str(x).strip()
    if s == "" or s.upper() in {"N/A", "NA", "NULL"} or s in {"-----", "--", "-"}:
        return None
    s = s.replace(",", "")
    # 有些是 "18.90     " 這種
    try:
        return float(s)
    except Exception:
        return None


def _clean_int(x) -> Optional[int]:
    if x is None:
        return None
    s = str(x).strip()
    if s == "" or s.upper() in {"N/A", "NA", "NULL"} or s in {"-----", "--", "-"}:
        return None
    s = s.replace(",", "")
    try:
        return int(float(s))
    except Exception:
        return None


def _roc_to_ad_yyyy_mm_dd(s: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    支援：
    - "115/01/15"
    - "100.01.03"
    - "114/12/31"
    - "20110103" / "2026/01/15" / "2026-01-15"（若本來就是西元也盡量吃）
    回傳 "YYYY-MM-DD"
    """
    if s is None:
        return None
    s = str(s).strip()
    if not s:
        return None

    # 先抓純數字 YYYYMMDD
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{8})", s)
    if m:
        y = int(s[:4])
        mm = int(s[4:6])
        dd = int(s[6:8])
        return f"{y:04d}-{mm:02d}-{dd:02d}"

    # 支援 YYYY/MM/DD 或 YYYY-MM-DD
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{4})[\/\-\.](\d{1,2})[\/\-\.](\d{1,2})", s)
    if m:
        y = int(m.group(1))
        mm = int(m.group(2))
        dd = int(m.group(3))
        # 若 y 很小(<=1911) 才可能是民國？一般不會，這裡當西元
        return f"{y:04d}-{mm:02d}-{dd:02d}"

    # 民國 "115/01/15" 或 "100.01.03"
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{2,3})[\/\.](\d{1,2})[\/\.](\d{1,2})", s)
    if m:
        roc_y = int(m.group(1))
        y = roc_y + 1911
        mm = int(m.group(2))
        dd = int(m.group(3))
        return f"{y:04d}-{mm:02d}-{dd:02d}"

    return None


def _parse_range_roc(s: str) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str], Optional[int]]:
    """
    解析 "115/01/16～115/01/29" 或 "115/01/16~115/01/29" 或 "115/01/16～115/01/29"
    回傳 (start_yyyy_mm_dd, end_yyyy_mm_dd, total_days_inclusive_or_none)
    total_days 以「日曆日含頭尾」粗算（不是交易日）
    """
    if s is None:
        return (None, None, None)
    t = str(s).strip()
    if not t:
        return (None, None, None)

    # 各種分隔符
    t = t.replace("～", "~").replace("—", "-").replace("–", "-")
    parts = t.split("~")
    if len(parts) != 2:
        return (None, None, None)

    s1 = _roc_to_ad_yyyy_mm_dd(parts[0].strip())
    s2 = _roc_to_ad_yyyy_mm_dd(parts[1].strip())
    if not s1 or not s2:
        return (s1, s2, None)

    try:
        d1 = pd.Timestamp(s1)
        d2 = pd.Timestamp(s2)
        total = int((d2 - d1).days) + 1
    except Exception:
        total = None
    return (s1, s2, total)


def _get_span(target_table: str) -> Tuple[Optional[pd.Timestamp], Optional[pd.Timestamp]]:
    span_row = db.query_to_df(
        """
        SELECT start_date, end_date
        FROM date_span
        WHERE target_table = ? AND idx_key = ?
        """,
        (target_table, "date"),
    )
    if span_row is None or span_row.empty:
        return (None, None)
    mem_s = pd.Timestamp(span_row.loc[0, "start_date"]).normalize()
    mem_e = pd.Timestamp(span_row.loc[0, "end_date"]).normalize()
    return (mem_s, mem_e)


def _calc_fetch_ranges(
    req_s: pd.Timestamp,
    req_e: pd.Timestamp,
    mem_s: Optional[pd.Timestamp],
    mem_e: Optional[pd.Timestamp],
) -> Tuple[List[Tuple[pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]], pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]:
    fetch_ranges: List[Tuple[pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]] = []

    if mem_s is None or mem_e is None:
        return [(req_s, req_e)], req_s, req_e

    new_s = min(mem_s, req_s)
    new_e = max(mem_e, req_e)

    if req_s >= mem_s and req_e <= mem_e:
        fetch_ranges = []
    elif req_s > mem_e:
        fetch_ranges = [(mem_e + pd.Timedelta(days=1), req_e)]
    elif req_e < mem_s:
        fetch_ranges = [(req_s, mem_s - pd.Timedelta(days=1))]
    else:
        if req_s < mem_s:
            fetch_ranges.append((req_s, mem_s - pd.Timedelta(days=1)))
        if req_e > mem_e:
            fetch_ranges.append((mem_e + pd.Timedelta(days=1), req_e))

    return fetch_ranges, new_s, new_e


def _update_span(target_table: str, new_s: pd.Timestamp, new_e: pd.Timestamp) -> None:
    db.execute_sql(
        """
        INSERT INTO date_span (target_table, idx_key, start_date, end_date, updated_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
        ON CONFLICT(target_table, idx_key) DO UPDATE SET
          start_date = excluded.start_date,
          end_date   = excluded.end_date,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        """,
        (target_table, "date", _dstr(new_s), _dstr(new_e)),
    )


# ============================================================
# 3) TPEX attention (上櫃公布注意有價證券)
# ============================================================

def get_tpex_bulletin_attention(start_date: datetime, end_date: datetime) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    對應：
      POST https://www.tpex.org.tw/www/zh-tw/bulletin/attention
      payload: startDate=YYYY/MM/DD&endDate=YYYY/MM/DD&...&response=json

    入庫表：tpex_bulletin_attention
    快取：date_span(target_table='tpex_bulletin_attention', idx_key='date')
    """
    target_table = "tpex_bulletin_attention"
    req_s = pd.Timestamp(start_date).normalize()
    req_e = pd.Timestamp(end_date).normalize()
    if req_s > req_e:
        raise ValueError("start_date 不可大於 end_date")

    mem_s, mem_e = _get_span(target_table)
    fetch_ranges, new_s, new_e = _calc_fetch_ranges(req_s, req_e, mem_s, mem_e)

    url = "https://www.tpex.org.tw/www/zh-tw/bulletin/attention"

    delete_sql = f"DELETE FROM {target_table} WHERE 公告日期 >= ? AND 公告日期 <= ?"

    insert_sql = f"""
    INSERT INTO {target_table}
      (證券代號, 證券名稱, 累計, 注意交易資訊, 公告日期, 收盤價, 本益比, link, created_at, 公告日期_ts)
    VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
    """

    for fs, fe in fetch_ranges:
        if fs > fe:
            continue

        payload = {
            "startDate": fs.strftime("%Y/%m/%d"),
            "endDate": fe.strftime("%Y/%m/%d"),
            "code": "",
            "cate": "",
            "type": "all",
            "order": "date",
            "id": "",
            "response": "json",
        }

        r = requests.post(url, data=payload, timeout=30)
        r.raise_for_status()
        js = r.json()

        tables = js.get("tables") or []
        if not tables:
            continue

        data = tables[0].get("data") or []
        if not data:
            continue

        rows = []
        for item in data:
            # fields:
            # ["編號","證券代號","證券名稱","累計","注意交易資訊","公告日期","收盤價","本益比","link"]
            sid = str(item[1]).strip()
            name = str(item[2]).strip()
            acc = _clean_int(item[3])
            info = str(item[4]).strip()
            pub_roc = str(item[5]).strip()  # 115/01/15
            pub_ad = _roc_to_ad_yyyy_mm_dd(pub_roc)
            close_p = _clean_float(item[6])
            pe = _clean_float(item[7])
            link = str(item[8]).strip() if item[8] is not None else None

            if not pub_ad:
                continue

            rows.append((
                sid, name, acc, info, pub_ad, close_p, pe, link,
                pd.Timestamp.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
                _to_unix_ts(pub_ad),
            ))

        if rows:
            db.execute_sql(delete_sql, (_dstr(fs), _dstr(fe)))
            db.execute_sql(insert_sql, rows)

    _update_span(target_table, new_s, new_e)

    df = db.query_to_df(
        f"""
        SELECT id, 證券代號, 證券名稱, 累計, 注意交易資訊, 公告日期, 收盤價, 本益比, link, created_at, 公告日期_ts
        FROM {target_table}
        WHERE 公告日期 >= ? AND 公告日期 <= ?
        ORDER BY 公告日期, 證券代號
        """,
        (_dstr(req_s), _dstr(req_e)),
    )
    return df if df is not None else pd.DataFrame()


# ============================================================
# 4) TPEX disposal (上櫃公布處置有價證券資訊)
# ============================================================

def get_tpex_bulletin_disposal(start_date: datetime, end_date: datetime) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    對應：
      POST https://www.tpex.org.tw/www/zh-tw/bulletin/disposal
      payload: startDate=YYYY/MM/DD&endDate=YYYY/MM/DD&...&response=json

    入庫表：tpex_bulletin_disposal（UNIQUE(證券代號, 公布日期)）
    快取：date_span(target_table='tpex_bulletin_disposal', idx_key='date')
    """
    target_table = "tpex_bulletin_disposal"
    req_s = pd.Timestamp(start_date).normalize()
    req_e = pd.Timestamp(end_date).normalize()
    if req_s > req_e:
        raise ValueError("start_date 不可大於 end_date")

    mem_s, mem_e = _get_span(target_table)
    fetch_ranges, new_s, new_e = _calc_fetch_ranges(req_s, req_e, mem_s, mem_e)

    url = "https://www.tpex.org.tw/www/zh-tw/bulletin/disposal"

    upsert_sql = f"""
    INSERT INTO {target_table}
      (公布日期, 證券代號, 證券名稱, 累計, 處置起訖時間, 處置原因, 處置內容, 收盤價, 本益比, memo,
       created_at, 公布日期_ts,
       law_src, last_notice, notice_cnt, notice_dt,
       處置起始日, 處置結束日, 處置總天數)
    VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ?,
            ?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
    ON CONFLICT(證券代號, 公布日期) DO UPDATE SET
      證券名稱 = excluded.證券名稱,
      累計 = excluded.累計,
      處置起訖時間 = excluded.處置起訖時間,
      處置原因 = excluded.處置原因,
      處置內容 = excluded.處置內容,
      收盤價 = excluded.收盤價,
      本益比 = excluded.本益比,
      memo = excluded.memo,
      公布日期_ts = excluded.公布日期_ts,
      law_src = excluded.law_src,
      last_notice = excluded.last_notice,
      notice_cnt = excluded.notice_cnt,
      notice_dt = excluded.notice_dt,
      處置起始日 = excluded.處置起始日,
      處置結束日 = excluded.處置結束日,
      處置總天數 = excluded.處置總天數,
      created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    """

    for fs, fe in fetch_ranges:
        if fs > fe:
            continue

        payload = {
            "startDate": fs.strftime("%Y/%m/%d"),
            "endDate": fe.strftime("%Y/%m/%d"),
            "code": "",
            "cate": "",
            "type": "all",
            "reason": "-1",
            "measure": "-1",
            "order": "date",
            "id": "",
            "response": "json",
        }

        r = requests.post(url, data=payload, timeout=30)
        r.raise_for_status()
        js = r.json()

        tables = js.get("tables") or []
        if not tables:
            continue

        data = tables[0].get("data") or []
        if not data:
            continue

        rows = []
        for item in data:
            # fields:
            # ["編號","公布日期","證券代號","證券名稱","累計","處置起訖時間","處置原因","處置內容","收盤價","本益比"," "]
            pub_roc = str(item[1]).strip()
            pub_ad = _roc_to_ad_yyyy_mm_dd(pub_roc)
            sid = str(item[2]).strip()

            # 證券名稱有時含 "(../../mainboard/...)" 這種
            raw_name = str(item[3]).strip()
            name = raw_name.split("(")[0].strip()

            acc = _clean_int(item[4])
            period = str(item[5]).strip()
            reason = str(item[6]).strip()
            content = str(item[7]).strip()
            close_p = _clean_float(item[8])
            pe = _clean_float(item[9])
            memo = item[10]  # 多行字串/連結
            memo_str = str(memo) if memo is not None else None

            if not pub_ad:
                continue

            s_ad, e_ad, total_days = _parse_range_roc(period)

            law_src = None
            last_notice = None
            notice_cnt = None
            notice_dt = None

            rows.append((
                pub_ad, sid, name, acc, period, reason, content, close_p, pe, memo_str,
                _to_unix_ts(pub_ad),
                law_src, last_notice, notice_cnt, notice_dt,
                s_ad, e_ad, total_days
            ))

        if rows:
            db.execute_sql(upsert_sql, rows)

    _update_span(target_table, new_s, new_e)

    df = db.query_to_df(
        f"""
        SELECT *
        FROM {target_table}
        WHERE 公布日期 >= ? AND 公布日期 <= ?
        ORDER BY 公布日期, 證券代號
        """,
        (_dstr(req_s), _dstr(req_e)),
    )
    return df if df is not None else pd.DataFrame()

# ======== 4. 融資融券餘額 ========
# 項目,買進,賣出,現金(券)償還,前日餘額,今日餘額
def fetch_margin_trading(date: datetime | None = None):
    date_str = date.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    apiEndpoint = "marginTrading/MI_MARGN"
    apiParams = f"date={date_str}&selectType=MS&{common_params}"
    apiUrl = f"{twseUrl}/{apiEndpoint}?{apiParams}"

    try:
        res = requests.get(apiUrl, timeout=10)
        text = res.text.strip()

        # 1) 空白 → 假日 or TWSE 掛掉
        if text == "":
            print(f"[跳過] TWSE 回傳空白（假日?）: {date_str}")
            return None

        # 2) HTML → 被擋 or 維護
        if text.startswith("<") or text.startswith("<!--"):
            print(f"[跳過] TWSE 回傳 HTML（維護或被BAN）: {date_str}")
            return None

        # 3) 嘗試解析 JSON
        data = res.json()

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[錯誤] JSON 解析失敗 {date_str}: {e}")
        return None

    # 4) TWSE 自己給的錯誤訊息
    if "stat" in data and ("無" in data["stat"] or "抱歉" in data["stat"]):
        print(f"[跳過] 無融資資料: {date_str}")
        return None

    # 5) tables 結構不完整
    tables = data.get("tables")
    if not tables or "fields" not in tables[0] or "data" not in tables[0]:
        print(f"[跳過] TWSE 回傳格式錯誤: {date_str}")
        return None

    return tables[0]

# # ======== 4.2 融資融券餘額 區間版 ========
# # 日期,項目,買進,賣出,現金_券_償還,前日餘額,今日餘額
def fetch_margin_trading_range(sDt: datetime, eDt: datetime):
    if sDt > eDt:
        return None
    
    data = []    
    current = sDt

    while current <= eDt:
        currentData = fetch_margin_trading(current)

        # 假日 or 無資料 or HTML → 跳過這一天
        if currentData is None:
            current += timedelta(days=1)
            continue
        
        rows = currentData.get("data", [])
        date_str = current.strftime("%Y%m%d")

        for aRow in rows:
            aRow.insert(0, date_str)

        data.extend(rows)
        current += timedelta(days=1)
        
    return {
        "fields": ['日期', '項目', '買進', '賣出', '現金_券_償還', '前日餘額', '今日餘額'],
        "data": data
    }


# ======== 5. 注意股公告 ========
# 編號,證券代號,證券名稱,累計次數,注意交易資訊,日期,收盤價,本益比
def fetch_notice(sDt: datetime | None = None, eDt: datetime | None = None):
    if (sDt > eDt):
        return None

    if eDt > datetime.today():
        eDt = datetime.today()

    start_str = sDt.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    end_str = eDt.strftime("%Y%m%d")

    sortKinds = ["STKNO", "DATE"]

    apiEndpoint = "announcement/notice"
    apiParams = f"querytype=1&{common_params}"
    apiParams += f"&stockNo=&selectType=&sortKind={sortKinds[1]}"
    apiParams += f"&startDate={start_str}&endDate={end_str}"
    apiUrl = f"{twseUrl}/{apiEndpoint}?{apiParams}"

    res = requests.get(apiUrl)
    raw_data = res.json()
    df = pd.DataFrame(raw_data.get("data", []), columns=raw_data.get("fields", []))
    tools._save_to_csv(df, apiEndpoint, f"{start_str}_{end_str}")
    del df
    return raw_data

import re
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import List, Optional, Tuple

import pandas as pd
import requests
from dateutil.relativedelta import relativedelta

from common import db, tools, utils

# 注意股公告
def get_notice(sDt: datetime, eDt: datetime):
    return data_provider.get_notice("twse", sDt, eDt)

# 融資餘額
def get_margin_trading(sDt: datetime, eDt: datetime):
    if (sDt > eDt):
        return None

    if eDt > datetime.today():
        eDt = datetime.today()

    table = "twse_marginTrading_miMargn"
    print("[sDt]=" , sDt, "[eDt]=", eDt)

    ### 先確認庫有資料
    sql = f"SELECT count(*) FROM {table}"
    dataCnt = db.query_single_value(sql)
    if (dataCnt < 1):
        maxDt = sDt - relativedelta(days=1)
        minDt = maxDt - relativedelta(days=1)        
    else:
        ### 先確認庫資料的上下界
        sql = f"""
        SELECT
            MIN(日期) AS min_date,
            MAX(日期) AS max_date
        FROM {table}
        """
        df_check = db.query_to_df(sql)

        minDt = datetime.strptime(str(df_check["min_date"].iloc[0]), "%Y%m%d")
        maxDt = datetime.strptime(str(df_check["max_date"].iloc[0]), "%Y%m%d")
        print(minDt, maxDt)

    ### 1.資料完全落在庫的範圍，直接搜庫
    if (tools._is_fully_in_range(sDt, eDt, minDt, maxDt)):
        print("*** 直接從庫提取資料")
        sql = f"SELECT * FROM {table}"
        sql += f" WHERE 日期 between '{sDt.strftime('%Y%m%d')}' AND '{eDt.strftime('%Y%m%d')}'"
        df = db.query_to_df(sql)
        return df
    
    ### 2.資料完全落在庫的範圍之外，fetch API
    if (tools._is_no_overlap(sDt, eDt, minDt, maxDt)):
        print("*** 從API提取資料")
        raw_data = twse_api.fetch_margin_trading_range(sDt, eDt)
        if raw_data is None:
            print("fetch_margin_trading 回傳 None")
            return None
        data = raw_data["data"]
        print(data)

        ### 存到db裡
        values = []
        for r in data:
            try:
                values.append((
                    r[0].strip(),
                    r[1].strip(),
                    int(r[2].replace(',', '')),
                    int(r[3].replace(',', '')),
                    int(r[4].replace(',', '')),
                    int(r[5].replace(',', '')),
                    int(r[6].replace(',', ''))
                ))
            except:
                continue

        sql = f"""
        INSERT INTO {table}
        (日期, 項目, 買進, 賣出, 現金_券_償還, 前日餘額, 今日餘額)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
        """
        if not db.execute_sql(sql, values):
            print("存庫失敗！")
        df = pd.DataFrame(raw_data.get("data", []), columns=raw_data.get("fields", []))
        return df
    
    ### 3.重疊的部分取庫，超出的部分用API，最後merge
    ## 找出重疊部分(From 庫)
    overlap_star, overlap_end = tools._overlap_period(sDt, eDt, minDt, maxDt)
    if overlap_star is not None:
        df_exist = get_margin_trading(overlap_star, overlap_end)

    ## 找出需要獲取的部分
    if (sDt < minDt):
        df_new_left = get_margin_trading(sDt, minDt - relativedelta(days=1))
    if (maxDt < eDt):
        df_new_right = get_margin_trading(maxDt + relativedelta(days=1), eDt)
    
    ## 合併 DataFrames
    dfs = []
    if 'df_exist' in locals() and isinstance(df_exist, pd.DataFrame):
        dfs.append(df_exist)
    if 'df_new_left' in locals() and isinstance(df_new_left, pd.DataFrame):
        dfs.append(df_new_left)
    if 'df_new_right' in locals() and isinstance(df_new_right, pd.DataFrame):
        dfs.append(df_new_right)

    if dfs:
        df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)
    else:
        df = None  # 如果都不存在，回傳空 DataFrame
    return df

# 補闕漏的 融資餘額 資料
def repair_margin_trading_gaps(
    start_date: datetime | None = None,
    end_date: datetime | None = None,
):
    """
    修補 twse_marginTrading_miMargn 中間缺漏的交易日資料
    - 若未指定 start/end，則以 DB 中 min/max 日期為範圍
    - 僅針對缺口呼叫 API
    """
    table = "twse_marginTrading_miMargn"
    span_table = "date_span"
    target_table = table
    idx_key = None  # 依你要求，融資不需要 idx_key

    # === 1) 決定修補範圍 ===
    if start_date is None or end_date is None:
        row = db.query_to_df(f"""
            SELECT MIN(日期) AS min_d, MAX(日期) AS max_d
            FROM {table}
        """)
        if row.empty or row.iloc[0]["min_d"] is None:
            print("⚠ DB 無任何融資資料，無法自動修補")
            return
        s = datetime.strptime(row.iloc[0]["min_d"], "%Y%m%d")
        e = datetime.strptime(row.iloc[0]["max_d"], "%Y%m%d")
    else:
        s = pd.Timestamp(start_date).normalize().to_pydatetime()
        e = pd.Timestamp(end_date).normalize().to_pydatetime()

    print(f"🔍 修補範圍: {s.date()} ~ {e.date()}")

    # === 2) 取得交易日曆 ===
    df_trade = finMind.get_tw_stock_trading_dates()

    trade_days = set(
        pd.to_datetime(df_trade["date"], errors="coerce")
        .dropna()
        .dt.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    )

    # === 3) 取 DB 已有日期 ===
    df_exist = db.query_to_df(
        f"""
        SELECT DISTINCT 日期
        FROM {table}
        WHERE 日期 BETWEEN ? AND ?
        """,
        (s.strftime("%Y%m%d"), e.strftime("%Y%m%d")),
    )
    exist_days = set(df_exist["日期"]) if not df_exist.empty else set()

    # === 4) 找缺口交易日 ===
    need_days = sorted([
        d for d in trade_days
        if s.strftime("%Y%m%d") <= d <= e.strftime("%Y%m%d")
        and d not in exist_days
    ])

    if not need_days:
        print("✅ 無缺漏交易日")
        return

    # === 5) 將缺日合併為連續區段（最少 API call） ===
    def to_ranges(days: list[str]):
        ranges = []
        start = prev = datetime.strptime(days[0], "%Y%m%d")
        for d in days[1:]:
            cur = datetime.strptime(d, "%Y%m%d")
            if (cur - prev).days > 1:
                ranges.append((start, prev))
                start = cur
            prev = cur
        ranges.append((start, prev))
        return ranges

    fetch_ranges = to_ranges(need_days)

    print(f"🚑 發現 {len(fetch_ranges)} 段缺口，開始補資料")

    # === 6) 補資料 ===
    for fs, fe in fetch_ranges:
        print(f"📡 補 {fs.date()} ~ {fe.date()}")
        raw = twse_api.fetch_margin_trading_range(fs, fe)
        if raw is None or not raw.get("data"):
            print("⚠ API 無回傳資料")
            continue

        values = []
        for r in raw["data"]:
            try:
                values.append((
                    r[0].strip(),  # 日期 YYYYMMDD
                    r[1].strip(),  # 項目
                    int(r[2].replace(",", "")),
                    int(r[3].replace(",", "")),
                    int(r[4].replace(",", "")),
                    int(r[5].replace(",", "")),
                    int(r[6].replace(",", "")),
                ))
            except Exception:
                continue

        db.execute_sql(f"""
        INSERT INTO {table}
          (日期, 項目, 買進, 賣出, 現金_券_償還, 前日餘額, 今日餘額)
        VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
        ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
        """, values)

    # === 7) 更新 date_span ===
    span = db.query_to_df("""
        SELECT start_date, end_date
        FROM date_span
        WHERE target_table = ? AND idx_key = ?
    """, (target_table, idx_key))

    new_s = s.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    new_e = e.strftime("%Y%m%d")

    if span.empty:
        db.execute_sql("""
        INSERT INTO date_span (target_table, idx_key, start_date, end_date)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (target_table, idx_key, new_s, new_e))
    else:
        cur_s = span.loc[0, "start_date"]
        cur_e = span.loc[0, "end_date"]
        db.execute_sql("""
        UPDATE date_span
        SET start_date = ?, end_date = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE target_table = ? AND idx_key = ?
        """, (
            min(cur_s, new_s),
            max(cur_e, new_e),
            target_table,
            idx_key
        ))

    print("✅ 缺漏修補完成，date_span 已更新")


# =========================
# 共用小工具
# =========================
_TWSE_HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"
}


def _to_int(s: str) -> int:
    if s is None:
        return 0
    s = str(s).strip().replace(",", "")
    if s in ("", "-", "--"):
        return 0
    try:
        return int(float(s))
    except ValueError:
        return 0


def _to_float(s: str) -> float:
    if s is None:
        return 0.0
    s = str(s).strip().replace(",", "")
    if s in ("", "-", "--"):
        return 0.0
    try:
        return float(s)
    except ValueError:
        return 0.0


def _iter_month_starts(start: pd.Timestamp, end: pd.Timestamp) -> List[pd.Timestamp]:
    """
    給定 [start, end]，回傳所有「每月一號」的 Timestamp（含頭尾月）。
    """
    cur = start.replace(day=1)
    cur = pd.Timestamp(cur.year, cur.month, 1)

    res: List[pd.Timestamp] = []
    while cur <= end:
        res.append(cur)
        if cur.month == 12:
            cur = pd.Timestamp(cur.year + 1, 1, 1)
        else:
            cur = pd.Timestamp(cur.year, cur.month + 1, 1)
    return res


# =========================
# 1) FMTQIK：加權市場成交量 / 成交值 / 交易筆數 / 指數收盤
#    table: twse_exchangeReport_fmtqik
# =========================
def get_twse_exchangeReport_fmtqik(
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    來源： https://www.twse.com.tw/exchangeReport/FMTQIK?response=json&date=YYYYMMDD

    資料庫快取表：twse_exchangeReport_fmtqik
      - date       TEXT   (ROC 原始日期, e.g. '114/12/24')
      - date_ad    TEXT   (西元 yyyy-mm-dd)
      - date_ts    INTEGER (該日 00:00:00 的 unix ts)
      - market_volume  INTEGER
      - market_money   INTEGER
      - trade_count    INTEGER
      - taiex_close    REAL
      - taiex_spread   REAL
      - created_at     INTEGER (DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
      - UNIQUE(date_ad)

    span 記憶表：stock_span
      - target_table = 'twse_exchangeReport_fmtqik'
      - stock_id     = 'MARKET'
      - start_date / end_date 為 date_ad
    """
    print(f"--- run twse.get_twse_exchangeReport_fmtqik ---")

    target_table = "twse_exchangeReport_fmtqik"
    span_sid = "MARKET"  # 當作 stock_id 用在 date_span

    req_s = pd.Timestamp(start_date).normalize()
    req_e = pd.Timestamp(end_date).normalize()
    if req_s > req_e:
        raise ValueError("start_date 不可大於 end_date")

    def dstr(t: pd.Timestamp) -> str:
        return t.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

    # ---- 1) 查 span ----
    span_row = db.query_to_df(
        """
        SELECT start_date, end_date
        FROM date_span
        WHERE target_table = ? AND idx_key = ?
        """,
        (target_table, span_sid),
    )

    mem_s = pd.Timestamp(span_row.loc[0, "start_date"]).normalize() if not span_row.empty else None
    mem_e = pd.Timestamp(span_row.loc[0, "end_date"]).normalize() if not span_row.empty else None

    fetch_ranges: list[tuple[pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]] = []

    if mem_s is None:
        fetch_ranges = [(req_s, req_e)]
        new_s, new_e = req_s, req_e
    else:
        new_s = min(mem_s, req_s)
        new_e = max(mem_e, req_e)

        if req_s >= mem_s and req_e <= mem_e:
            fetch_ranges = []
        elif req_s > mem_e:
            fetch_ranges = [(mem_e + pd.Timedelta(days=1), req_e)]
        elif req_e < mem_s:
            fetch_ranges = [(req_s, mem_s - pd.Timedelta(days=1))]
        else:
            if req_s < mem_s:
                fetch_ranges.append((req_s, mem_s - pd.Timedelta(days=1)))
            if req_e > mem_e:
                fetch_ranges.append((mem_e + pd.Timedelta(days=1), req_e))

    # ---- 2) 補資料：依「缺的日期區間」→ 拆成月份呼叫 API ----
    insert_sql = """
    INSERT INTO twse_exchangeReport_fmtqik
      (date, date_ad, date_ts,
       market_volume, market_money, trade_count,
       taiex_close, taiex_spread)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
    """

    for fs, fe in fetch_ranges:
        if fs > fe:
            continue

        # 該缺口涵蓋的所有月份
        for m_start in _iter_month_starts(fs, fe):
            ymd = m_start.strftime("%Y%m01")
            url = "https://www.twse.com.tw/exchangeReport/FMTQIK"
            params = {"response": "json", "date": ymd}

            try:
                res = requests.get(url, params=params, headers=_TWSE_HEADERS, timeout=10)
                res.raise_for_status()
                body = res.json()
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[TWSE FMTQIK] request error ({ymd}): {e}")
                continue

            if body.get("stat") != "OK":
                # 沒資料就跳過該月
                continue

            data_rows = body.get("data", [])
            if not data_rows:
                continue

            insert_params = []
            for row in data_rows:
                # row[0]: 民國日期 '114/12/24'
                roc_date = str(row[0]).strip()
                ts = utils.roc_to_unix(roc_date)
                if ts is None:
                    continue
                dt_ad = datetime.fromtimestamp(ts).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

                # 不在目前缺口的日期，仍然可以收進來，因為我們是把 span 擴大
                market_volume = _to_int(row[1])   # 成交股數
                market_money = _to_int(row[2])    # 成交金額
                trade_count = _to_int(row[3])     # 交易筆數
                taiex_close = _to_float(row[4])   # 收盤指數
                taiex_spread = _to_float(row[5])  # 漲跌點數

                insert_params.append((
                    roc_date,
                    dt_ad,
                    ts,
                    market_volume,
                    market_money,
                    trade_count,
                    taiex_close,
                    taiex_spread,
                ))

            if insert_params:
                db.execute_sql(insert_sql, insert_params)

    # ---- 3) 依「實際有的資料」重新決定 span ----
    span_cov = db.query_to_df(
        f"""
        SELECT MIN(date_ad) AS min_d, MAX(date_ad) AS max_d
        FROM {target_table}
        """
    )

    if not span_cov.empty and span_cov.loc[0, "max_d"] is not None:
        real_s = pd.Timestamp(span_cov.loc[0, "min_d"]).normalize()
        real_e = pd.Timestamp(span_cov.loc[0, "max_d"]).normalize()
        # 避免把 span 設到超過這次要求的 end_date（API 可能還沒開出未來的日子）
        real_e = min(real_e, req_e)
    else:
        # 沒資料就乾脆設成這次要求範圍
        real_s, real_e = req_s, req_e

    db.execute_sql(
        """
        INSERT INTO date_span (target_table, idx_key, start_date, end_date, updated_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
        ON CONFLICT(target_table, idx_key) DO UPDATE SET
          start_date = excluded.start_date,
          end_date   = excluded.end_date,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        """,
        (target_table, span_sid, dstr(real_s), dstr(real_e)),
    )

    # ---- 4) 一律從 DB 回傳 ----
    df = db.query_to_df(
        """
        SELECT
          date,
          date_ad,
          date_ts,
          market_volume,
          market_money,
          trade_count,
          taiex_close,
          taiex_spread
        FROM twse_exchangeReport_fmtqik
        WHERE date_ad >= ?
          AND date_ad <= ?
        ORDER BY date_ad
        """,
        (dstr(req_s), dstr(req_e)),
    )
    return df


# =========================
# 2) MI_5MINS_HIST：加權指數日 OHLC (由 5 分鐘資料整理, 官方每日盤後)
#    table: twse_indicesReport_mi_5mins_hist

def get_twse_indicesReport_mi_5mins_hist(
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    來源： https://www.twse.com.tw/indicesReport/MI_5MINS_HIST?response=json&date=YYYYMMDD

    資料庫快取表：twse_indicesReport_mi_5mins_hist
      - date        TEXT  (ROC 原始日期, e.g. '114/12/24')
      - date_ad     TEXT  (西元 yyyy-mm-dd)
      - date_ts     INTEGER

      - high_index  REAL
      - low_index   REAL
      - close_index REAL
      - created_at  INTEGER DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      - UNIQUE(date_ad)

    span 記憶表：stock_span
      - target_table = 'twse_indicesReport_mi_5mins_hist'
      - stock_id     = 'TAIEX'
    """
    print(f"--- run twse.get_twse_indicesReport_mi_5mins_hist ---")

    target_table = "twse_indicesReport_mi_5mins_hist"
    span_sid = "TAIEX"

    req_s = pd.Timestamp(start_date).normalize()
    req_e = pd.Timestamp(end_date).normalize()
    if req_s > req_e:
        raise ValueError("start_date 不可大於 end_date")

    def dstr(t: pd.Timestamp) -> str:
        return t.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

    # ---- 1) 查 span ----
    span_row = db.query_to_df(
        """
        SELECT start_date, end_date
        FROM date_span
        WHERE target_table = ? AND idx_key = ?
        """,
        (target_table, span_sid),
    )

    mem_s = pd.Timestamp(span_row.loc[0, "start_date"]).normalize() if not span_row.empty else None
    mem_e = pd.Timestamp(span_row.loc[0, "end_date"]).normalize() if not span_row.empty else None

    fetch_ranges: list[tuple[pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]] = []

    if mem_s is None:
        fetch_ranges = [(req_s, req_e)]
        new_s, new_e = req_s, req_e
    else:
        new_s = min(mem_s, req_s)
        new_e = max(mem_e, req_e)

        if req_s >= mem_s and req_e <= mem_e:
            fetch_ranges = []
        elif req_s > mem_e:
            fetch_ranges = [(mem_e + pd.Timedelta(days=1), req_e)]
        elif req_e < mem_s:
            fetch_ranges = [(req_s, mem_s - pd.Timedelta(days=1))]
        else:
            if req_s < mem_s:
                fetch_ranges.append((req_s, mem_s - pd.Timedelta(days=1)))
            if req_e > mem_e:
                fetch_ranges.append((mem_e + pd.Timedelta(days=1), req_e))

    # ---- 2) 補資料：依缺口的月份呼叫 API ----
    insert_sql = """
    INSERT INTO twse_indicesReport_mi_5mins_hist
      (date, date_ad, date_ts,
       open_index, high_index, low_index, close_index)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
    """

    for fs, fe in fetch_ranges:
        if fs > fe:
            continue

        for m_start in _iter_month_starts(fs, fe):
            ymd = m_start.strftime("%Y%m01")
            url = "https://www.twse.com.tw/indicesReport/MI_5MINS_HIST"
            params = {"response": "json", "date": ymd}

            try:
                res = requests.get(url, params=params, headers=_TWSE_HEADERS, timeout=10)
                res.raise_for_status()
                body = res.json()
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[TWSE MI_5MINS_HIST] request error ({ymd}): {e}")
                continue

            if body.get("stat") != "OK":
                continue

            data_rows = body.get("data", [])
            if not data_rows:
                continue

            insert_params = []
            for record in data_rows:
                # record[0]: 民國日期 '108/01/02'
                roc_date = str(record[0]).strip()
                ts = utils.roc_to_unix(roc_date)
                if ts is None:
                    continue
                dt_ad = datetime.fromtimestamp(ts).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

                open_price = _to_float(record[1])
                high_price = _to_float(record[2])
                low_price = _to_float(record[3])
                close_price = _to_float(record[4])

                insert_params.append((
                    roc_date,
                    dt_ad,
                    ts,
                    open_price,
                    high_price,
                    low_price,
                    close_price,
                ))

            if insert_params:
                db.execute_sql(insert_sql, insert_params)

    # ---- 3) 依「實際有的資料」重新決定 span ----
    span_cov = db.query_to_df(
        f"""
        SELECT MIN(date_ad) AS min_d, MAX(date_ad) AS max_d
        FROM {target_table}
        """
    )

    if not span_cov.empty and span_cov.loc[0, "max_d"] is not None:
        real_s = pd.Timestamp(span_cov.loc[0, "min_d"]).normalize()
        real_e = pd.Timestamp(span_cov.loc[0, "max_d"]).normalize()
        # 避免把 span 設到超過這次要求的 end_date（API 可能還沒開出未來的日子）
        real_e = min(real_e, req_e)
    else:
        # 沒資料就乾脆設成這次要求範圍
        real_s, real_e = req_s, req_e

    db.execute_sql(
        """
        INSERT INTO date_span (target_table, idx_key, start_date, end_date, updated_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
        ON CONFLICT(target_table, idx_key) DO UPDATE SET
          start_date = excluded.start_date,
          end_date   = excluded.end_date,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        """,
        (target_table, span_sid, dstr(real_s), dstr(real_e)),
    )

    # ---- 4) 一律從 DB 回傳 ----
    df = db.query_to_df(
        """
        SELECT
          date,
          date_ad,
          date_ts,
          open_index,
          high_index,
          low_index,
          close_index
        FROM twse_indicesReport_mi_5mins_hist
        WHERE date_ad >= ?
          AND date_ad <= ?
        ORDER BY date_ad
        """,
        (dstr(req_s), dstr(req_e)),
    )
    return df


# ============================================================
# helpers
# ============================================================

def _dstr(ts: pd.Timestamp) -> str:
    return ts.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")


def _to_unix_ts(date_yyyy_mm_dd: str) -> int:
    # date string -> unix seconds (00:00:00 local)
    dt = pd.Timestamp(date_yyyy_mm_dd).to_pydatetime()
    return int(time.mktime(dt.timetuple()))


def _clean_float(x) -> Optional[float]:
    if x is None:
        return None
    s = str(x).strip()
    if s == "" or s.upper() in {"N/A", "NA", "NULL"} or s in {"-----", "--", "-"}:
        return None
    s = s.replace(",", "")
    # 有些是 "18.90     " 這種
    try:
        return float(s)
    except Exception:
        return None


def _clean_int(x) -> Optional[int]:
    if x is None:
        return None
    s = str(x).strip()
    if s == "" or s.upper() in {"N/A", "NA", "NULL"} or s in {"-----", "--", "-"}:
        return None
    s = s.replace(",", "")
    try:
        return int(float(s))
    except Exception:
        return None


def _roc_to_ad_yyyy_mm_dd(s: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    支援：
    - "115/01/15"
    - "100.01.03"
    - "114/12/31"
    - "20110103" / "2026/01/15" / "2026-01-15"（若本來就是西元也盡量吃）
    回傳 "YYYY-MM-DD"
    """
    if s is None:
        return None
    s = str(s).strip()
    if not s:
        return None

    # 先抓純數字 YYYYMMDD
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{8})", s)
    if m:
        y = int(s[:4])
        mm = int(s[4:6])
        dd = int(s[6:8])
        return f"{y:04d}-{mm:02d}-{dd:02d}"

    # 支援 YYYY/MM/DD 或 YYYY-MM-DD
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{4})[\/\-\.](\d{1,2})[\/\-\.](\d{1,2})", s)
    if m:
        y = int(m.group(1))
        mm = int(m.group(2))
        dd = int(m.group(3))
        # 若 y 很小(<=1911) 才可能是民國？一般不會，這裡當西元
        return f"{y:04d}-{mm:02d}-{dd:02d}"

    # 民國 "115/01/15" 或 "100.01.03"
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{2,3})[\/\.](\d{1,2})[\/\.](\d{1,2})", s)
    if m:
        roc_y = int(m.group(1))
        y = roc_y + 1911
        mm = int(m.group(2))
        dd = int(m.group(3))
        return f"{y:04d}-{mm:02d}-{dd:02d}"

    return None


def _parse_range_roc(s: str) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str], Optional[int]]:
    """
    解析 "115/01/16～115/01/29" 或 "115/01/16~115/01/29" 或 "115/01/16～115/01/29"
    回傳 (start_yyyy_mm_dd, end_yyyy_mm_dd, total_days_inclusive_or_none)
    total_days 以「日曆日含頭尾」粗算（不是交易日）
    """
    if s is None:
        return (None, None, None)
    t = str(s).strip()
    if not t:
        return (None, None, None)

    # 各種分隔符
    t = t.replace("～", "~").replace("—", "-").replace("–", "-")
    parts = t.split("~")
    if len(parts) != 2:
        return (None, None, None)

    s1 = _roc_to_ad_yyyy_mm_dd(parts[0].strip())
    s2 = _roc_to_ad_yyyy_mm_dd(parts[1].strip())
    if not s1 or not s2:
        return (s1, s2, None)

    try:
        d1 = pd.Timestamp(s1)
        d2 = pd.Timestamp(s2)
        total = int((d2 - d1).days) + 1
    except Exception:
        total = None
    return (s1, s2, total)


def _get_span(target_table: str) -> Tuple[Optional[pd.Timestamp], Optional[pd.Timestamp]]:
    span_row = db.query_to_df(
        """
        SELECT start_date, end_date
        FROM date_span
        WHERE target_table = ? AND idx_key = ?
        """,
        (target_table, "date"),
    )
    if span_row is None or span_row.empty:
        return (None, None)
    mem_s = pd.Timestamp(span_row.loc[0, "start_date"]).normalize()
    mem_e = pd.Timestamp(span_row.loc[0, "end_date"]).normalize()
    return (mem_s, mem_e)


def _calc_fetch_ranges(
    req_s: pd.Timestamp,
    req_e: pd.Timestamp,
    mem_s: Optional[pd.Timestamp],
    mem_e: Optional[pd.Timestamp],
) -> Tuple[List[Tuple[pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]], pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]:
    fetch_ranges: List[Tuple[pd.Timestamp, pd.Timestamp]] = []

    if mem_s is None or mem_e is None:
        return [(req_s, req_e)], req_s, req_e

    new_s = min(mem_s, req_s)
    new_e = max(mem_e, req_e)

    if req_s >= mem_s and req_e <= mem_e:
        fetch_ranges = []
    elif req_s > mem_e:
        fetch_ranges = [(mem_e + pd.Timedelta(days=1), req_e)]
    elif req_e < mem_s:
        fetch_ranges = [(req_s, mem_s - pd.Timedelta(days=1))]
    else:
        if req_s < mem_s:
            fetch_ranges.append((req_s, mem_s - pd.Timedelta(days=1)))
        if req_e > mem_e:
            fetch_ranges.append((mem_e + pd.Timedelta(days=1), req_e))

    return fetch_ranges, new_s, new_e


def _update_span(target_table: str, new_s: pd.Timestamp, new_e: pd.Timestamp) -> None:
    db.execute_sql(
        """
        INSERT INTO date_span (target_table, idx_key, start_date, end_date, updated_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
        ON CONFLICT(target_table, idx_key) DO UPDATE SET
          start_date = excluded.start_date,
          end_date   = excluded.end_date,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        """,
        (target_table, "date", _dstr(new_s), _dstr(new_e)),
    )


# ============================================================
# 1) TWSE notice (上市公布注意有價證券)
# ============================================================

def get_twse_announcement_notice(start_date: datetime, end_date: datetime) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    對應：
      GET https://www.twse.com.tw/rwd/zh/announcement/notice?querytype=1&...&startDate=YYYYMMDD&endDate=YYYYMMDD&response=json

    入庫表：twse_announcement_notice
    快取：date_span(target_table='twse_announcement_notice', idx_key='date')
    """
    target_table = "twse_announcement_notice"
    req_s = pd.Timestamp(start_date).normalize()
    req_e = pd.Timestamp(end_date).normalize()
    if req_s > req_e:
        raise ValueError("start_date 不可大於 end_date")

    mem_s, mem_e = _get_span(target_table)
    fetch_ranges, new_s, new_e = _calc_fetch_ranges(req_s, req_e, mem_s, mem_e)

    base_url = "https://www.twse.com.tw/rwd/zh/announcement/notice"

    # notice 表沒有 UNIQUE(證券代號, 日期) → 用「日期範圍先刪再灌」避免重複
    delete_sql = f"DELETE FROM {target_table} WHERE 日期 >= ? AND 日期 <= ?"

    insert_sql = f"""
    INSERT INTO {target_table}
      (證券代號, 證券名稱, 累計次數, 注意交易資訊, 日期, 收盤價, 本益比, created_at, 日期_ts)
    VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
    """

    for fs, fe in fetch_ranges:
        if fs > fe:
            continue

        params = {
            "querytype": "1",
            "stockNo": "",
            "selectType": "",
            "startDate": fs.strftime("%Y%m%d"),
            "endDate": fe.strftime("%Y%m%d"),
            "sortKind": "DATE",
            "response": "json",
        }

        r = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=30)
        r.raise_for_status()
        js = r.json()

        data = js.get("data") or []
        if not data:
            # 仍更新 span（代表這段已確認沒資料）
            continue

        rows = []
        for item in data:
            # fields: ["編號","證券代號","證券名稱","累計次數","注意交易資訊","日期","收盤價","本益比"]
            sid = str(item[1]).strip()
            name = str(item[2]).strip()
            cnt = _clean_int(item[3])
            info = str(item[4]).strip()
            roc_dt = str(item[5]).strip()
            ad_dt = _roc_to_ad_yyyy_mm_dd(roc_dt)  # notice 的日期是民國點分隔
            close_p = _clean_float(item[6])
            pe = _clean_float(item[7])

            if not ad_dt:
                continue

            rows.append((
                sid, name, cnt, info, ad_dt, close_p, pe,
                pd.Timestamp.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
                _to_unix_ts(ad_dt),
            ))

        if rows:
            # 先刪掉該 range（以避免重複）
            db.execute_sql(delete_sql, (_dstr(fs), _dstr(fe)))
            db.execute_sql(insert_sql, rows)

    _update_span(target_table, new_s, new_e)

    # DB 回傳
    df = db.query_to_df(
        f"""
        SELECT id, 證券代號, 證券名稱, 累計次數, 注意交易資訊, 日期, 收盤價, 本益比, created_at, 日期_ts
        FROM {target_table}
        WHERE 日期 >= ? AND 日期 <= ?
        ORDER BY 日期, 證券代號
        """,
        (_dstr(req_s), _dstr(req_e)),
    )
    return df if df is not None else pd.DataFrame()


# ============================================================
# 2) TWSE punish (上市公布處置有價證券資訊)
# ============================================================

def get_twse_announcement_punish(start_date: datetime, end_date: datetime) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    對應：
      GET https://www.twse.com.tw/rwd/zh/announcement/punish?response=json
    （實務上 TWSE 也常支援 startDate/endDate 參數；若不支援通常會被忽略，不影響程式）

    入庫表：twse_announcement_punish（UNIQUE(證券代號, 公布日期)）
    快取：date_span(target_table='twse_announcement_punish', idx_key='date')
    """
    target_table = "twse_announcement_punish"
    req_s = pd.Timestamp(start_date).normalize()
    req_e = pd.Timestamp(end_date).normalize()
    if req_s > req_e:
        raise ValueError("start_date 不可大於 end_date")

    mem_s, mem_e = _get_span(target_table)
    fetch_ranges, new_s, new_e = _calc_fetch_ranges(req_s, req_e, mem_s, mem_e)

    base_url = "https://www.twse.com.tw/rwd/zh/announcement/punish"

    upsert_sql = f"""
    INSERT INTO {target_table}
      (公布日期, 證券代號, 證券名稱, 累計, 處置條件, 處置起迄時間, 處置措施, 處置內容, 備註,
       created_at, 公布日期_ts,
       law_src, last_notice, notice_cnt, notice_dt,
       處置起始日, 處置結束日, 處置總天數)
    VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,
            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ?,
            ?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
    ON CONFLICT(證券代號, 公布日期) DO UPDATE SET
      證券名稱 = excluded.證券名稱,
      累計 = excluded.累計,
      處置條件 = excluded.處置條件,
      處置起迄時間 = excluded.處置起迄時間,
      處置措施 = excluded.處置措施,
      處置內容 = excluded.處置內容,
      備註 = excluded.備註,
      公布日期_ts = excluded.公布日期_ts,
      law_src = excluded.law_src,
      last_notice = excluded.last_notice,
      notice_cnt = excluded.notice_cnt,
      notice_dt = excluded.notice_dt,
      處置起始日 = excluded.處置起始日,
      處置結束日 = excluded.處置結束日,
      處置總天數 = excluded.處置總天數,
      created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    """

    for fs, fe in fetch_ranges:
        if fs > fe:
            continue

        params = {
            "response": "json",
            # 嘗試帶日期（若不支援通常會忽略）
            "startDate": fs.strftime("%Y%m%d"),
            "endDate": fe.strftime("%Y%m%d"),
        }
        r = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=30)
        r.raise_for_status()
        js = r.json()

        data = js.get("data") or []
        if not data:
            continue

        rows = []
        for item in data:
            # fields:
            # ["編號","公布日期","證券代號","證券名稱","累計","處置條件","處置起迄時間","處置措施","處置內容","備註"]
            pub_roc = str(item[1]).strip()
            pub_ad = _roc_to_ad_yyyy_mm_dd(pub_roc)
            sid = str(item[2]).strip()
            name = str(item[3]).strip()
            acc = _clean_int(item[4])
            cond = str(item[5]).strip()
            period = str(item[6]).strip()
            measure = str(item[7]).strip()
            content = str(item[8]).strip()
            memo = item[9]  # 可能是 html string
            memo_str = str(memo) if memo is not None else None

            if not pub_ad:
                continue

            s_ad, e_ad, total_days = _parse_range_roc(period)

            # 先把你後續要 enrich 的欄位留著（先填 None）
            law_src = None
            last_notice = None
            notice_cnt = None
            notice_dt = None

            rows.append((
                pub_ad, sid, name, acc, cond, period, measure, content, memo_str,
                _to_unix_ts(pub_ad),
                law_src, last_notice, notice_cnt, notice_dt,
                s_ad, e_ad, total_days
            ))

        if rows:
            db.execute_sql(upsert_sql, rows)

    _update_span(target_table, new_s, new_e)

    df = db.query_to_df(
        f"""
        SELECT *
        FROM {target_table}
        WHERE 公布日期 >= ? AND 公布日期 <= ?
        ORDER BY 公布日期, 證券代號
        """,
        (_dstr(req_s), _dstr(req_e)),
    )
    return df if df is not None else pd.DataFrame()

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterable, Sequence

import pandas as pd
import requests
from dotenv import load_dotenv

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
load_dotenv(PROJECT_ROOT / ".env")

FINMIND_API_URL = "https://api.finmindtrade.com/api/v4/data"
TARGET_TABLE = "raw_finmind.fm_us_stock_daily"
DATASET = "USStockPrice"

# 使用者目前指定的核心四個美股指數。
CORE_US_MARKET_SYMBOLS: dict[str, str] = {
    "^IXIC": "NASDAQ Composite",
    "^SOX": "PHLX Semiconductor Index",
    "^DJI": "Dow Jones Industrial Average",
    "^GSPC": "S&P 500",
}

# 額外建議。VIX 可表示風險情緒；TSM ADR 與台股/台積電隔日連動研究很有價值。
RECOMMENDED_US_MARKET_SYMBOLS: dict[str, str] = {

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FetchResult:
    stock_id: str
    requested_start: date
    requested_end: date
    rows: int
    first_date: date | None
    last_date: date | None


def _finmind_token() -> str:
    token = os.getenv("FINMIND_TOKEN", "").strip()
    if not token:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"找不到 FINMIND_TOKEN，請確認已在 {PROJECT_ROOT / '.env'} 設定 FINMIND_TOKEN"
        )
    return token


def _as_date(value: str | date | datetime) -> date:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.date()
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value
    return pd.Timestamp(value).date()


def _chunk_ranges(start_date: date, end_date: date, chunk_years: int = 5):
    """將長日期區間切成較小 API 請求，降低單次資料量與逾時風險。"""
    if start_date > end_date:
        raise ValueError("start_date 不可大於 end_date")
    if chunk_years <= 0:
        raise ValueError("chunk_years 必須大於 0")

    current = start_date
    while current <= end_date:
        try:
            next_boundary = current.replace(year=current.year + chunk_years)
        except ValueError:  # 2/29
            next_boundary = current.replace(month=2, day=28, year=current.year + chunk_years)
        chunk_end = min(end_date, next_boundary - timedelta(days=1))
        yield current, chunk_end
        current = chunk_end + timedelta(days=1)


def _normalize_us_stock_price(df: pd.DataFrame, expected_stock_id: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(
            columns=["date", "stock_id", "adj_close", "close", "high", "low", "open", "volume"]
        )

    out = df.copy()
    # FinMind 文件顯示 USStockPrice 使用首字母大寫欄位；這裡做大小寫容錯。
    lower_lookup = {str(c).lower(): c for c in out.columns}

    def col(name: str):
        return lower_lookup.get(name.lower())

    rename = {}
    for source_name, target_name in [
        ("date", "date"),
        ("stock_id", "stock_id"),
        ("Adj_Close", "adj_close"),
        ("Close", "close"),
        ("High", "high"),
        ("Low", "low"),
        ("Open", "open"),
        ("Volume", "volume"),
    ]:
        actual = col(source_name)
        if actual is not None:
            rename[actual] = target_name
    out = out.rename(columns=rename)

    if "date" not in out.columns:
        raise RuntimeError(f"FinMind {DATASET} 回傳缺少 date 欄位：{list(df.columns)}")
    if "stock_id" not in out.columns:
        out["stock_id"] = expected_stock_id

    for c in ["adj_close", "close", "high", "low", "open", "volume"]:
        if c not in out.columns:
            out[c] = pd.NA

    out["date"] = pd.to_datetime(out["date"], errors="coerce").dt.date
    out["stock_id"] = out["stock_id"].astype(str).str.strip()
    out.loc[out["stock_id"] == "", "stock_id"] = expected_stock_id

    for c in ["adj_close", "close", "high", "low", "open", "volume"]:
        out[c] = pd.to_numeric(out[c], errors="coerce")

    out = out.dropna(subset=["date", "stock_id"])
    out = out.drop_duplicates(subset=["date", "stock_id"], keep="last")
    out = out.sort_values(["stock_id", "date"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    return out[["date", "stock_id", "adj_close", "close", "high", "low", "open", "volume"]]


def fetch_us_stock_daily(
    stock_id: str,
    start_date: str | date | datetime,
    end_date: str | date | datetime,
    *,
    chunk_years: int = 5,
    sleep_seconds: float = 0.15,
    timeout_seconds: int = 60,
    session: requests.Session | None = None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """從 FinMind USStockPrice 下載單一美股/指數的日資料。"""
    sid = str(stock_id).strip()
    if not sid:
        raise ValueError("stock_id 不可為空")

    start = _as_date(start_date)
    end = _as_date(end_date)
    if start > end:
        raise ValueError("start_date 不可大於 end_date")

    token = _finmind_token()
    sess = session or requests.Session()
    frames: list[pd.DataFrame] = []

    for chunk_start, chunk_end in _chunk_ranges(start, end, chunk_years=chunk_years):
        params = {
            "dataset": DATASET,
            "data_id": sid,
            "start_date": chunk_start.isoformat(),
            "end_date": chunk_end.isoformat(),
        }
        resp = sess.get(
            FINMIND_API_URL,
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
            params=params,
            timeout=timeout_seconds,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        payload = resp.json()

        status = payload.get("status")
        msg = payload.get("msg", "")
        if status not in (None, 200):
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"FinMind API 失敗：stock_id={sid}, "
                f"range={chunk_start}~{chunk_end}, status={status}, msg={msg}"
            )

        raw = pd.DataFrame(payload.get("data") or [])
        clean = _normalize_us_stock_price(raw, sid)
        if not clean.empty:
            frames.append(clean)

        print(
            f"  {sid}  {chunk_start} ~ {chunk_end}: "
            f"{len(clean):,} rows"
        )
        if sleep_seconds > 0:
            time.sleep(sleep_seconds)

    if not frames:
        return _normalize_us_stock_price(pd.DataFrame(), sid)

    result = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
    result = result.drop_duplicates(subset=["date", "stock_id"], keep="last")
    result = result.sort_values(["stock_id", "date"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    return result


def upsert_us_stock_daily(df: pd.DataFrame) -> int:
    """將已清洗的 USStockPrice 資料 upsert 到 PostgreSQL。"""
    # 延後載入，讓只輸出 CSV / --help 時不必先載入 psycopg。
    from common import db
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return 0

    rows = []
    for row in df.itertuples(index=False):
        volume = None if pd.isna(row.volume) else int(row.volume)
        values = [row.date, row.stock_id, row.adj_close, row.close, row.high, row.low, row.open, volume]
        cleaned = []
        for value in values:
            if value is pd.NA or value is pd.NaT:
                cleaned.append(None)
            elif isinstance(value, float) and pd.isna(value):
                cleaned.append(None)
            else:
                cleaned.append(value)
        rows.append(tuple(cleaned))

    sql = f"""
        INSERT INTO {TARGET_TABLE}
            (date, stock_id, adj_close, close, high, low, open, volume)
        VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
        ON CONFLICT (date, stock_id) DO UPDATE SET
            adj_close = EXCLUDED.adj_close,
            close = EXCLUDED.close,
            high = EXCLUDED.high,
            low = EXCLUDED.low,
            open = EXCLUDED.open,
            volume = EXCLUDED.volume,
            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    """

    with db.get_connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.executemany(sql, rows)
        conn.commit()
    return len(rows)



def update_us_stock_daily_incremental(
    stock_ids: Sequence[str],
    end_date: str | date | datetime | None = None,
    *,
    lookback_days: int = 7,
    floor_date: str | date | datetime = "2000-01-01",
) -> dict[str, dict]:
    """Dashboard 日常用的美股日資料增量更新。

    每個代碼只從資料庫最新日期往前少量回看，避免每次從歷史起點重抓；
    多個代碼共用同一個 requests.Session，且不輸出 CSV。
    """
    from common import db

    end = _as_date(end_date or date.today())
    floor = _as_date(floor_date)
    lookback = max(1, int(lookback_days))
    results: dict[str, dict] = {}

    with requests.Session() as sess:
        for stock_id in stock_ids:
            sid = str(stock_id).strip()
            latest = db.query_single_value(
                f"SELECT MAX(date) FROM {TARGET_TABLE} WHERE stock_id = ?",
                (sid,),
            )
            if latest is None:
                start = floor
            else:
                latest_date = pd.Timestamp(latest).date()
                start = max(floor, latest_date - timedelta(days=lookback))
            if start > end:
                start = end

            print(f"[美股日資料] {sid} 增量更新：{start}～{end}")
            frame = fetch_us_stock_daily(
                sid,
                start,
                end,
                chunk_years=1,
                session=sess,
            )
            written = upsert_us_stock_daily(frame) if not frame.empty else 0
            results[sid] = {
                "stock_id": sid,
                "requested_start": start.isoformat(),
                "requested_end": end.isoformat(),
                "rows": int(len(frame)),
                "written_rows": int(written),
                "first_date": None if frame.empty else frame["date"].min().isoformat(),
                "last_date": None if frame.empty else frame["date"].max().isoformat(),
            }
    return results

def export_us_stock_daily_csv(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    output_dir: str | Path = DEFAULT_EXPORT_DIR,
) -> list[Path]:
    """存成每代碼一份 CSV，另存 combined CSV。"""
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return []

    output = Path(output_dir)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    written: list[Path] = []

    def safe_name(symbol: str) -> str:
        return symbol.replace("^", "INDEX_").replace("/", "_")

    for sid, part in df.groupby("stock_id", sort=True):
        path = output / f"{safe_name(sid)}_daily.csv"
        part.sort_values("date").to_csv(path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
        written.append(path)

    combined = output / "us_market_daily_combined.csv"
    df.sort_values(["stock_id", "date"]).to_csv(combined, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    written.append(combined)
    return written


def download_us_market_daily(
    stock_ids: Sequence[str],
    start_date: str | date | datetime,
    end_date: str | date | datetime,
    *,
    save_db: bool = True,
    csv_dir: str | Path | None = DEFAULT_EXPORT_DIR,
    chunk_years: int = 5,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, list[FetchResult], list[Path]]:
    """批次下載指定代碼，可同時寫 PostgreSQL 與 CSV。"""
    start = _as_date(start_date)
    end = _as_date(end_date)
    all_frames: list[pd.DataFrame] = []
    summaries: list[FetchResult] = []

    with requests.Session() as sess:
        for sid in stock_ids:
            print(f"\n=== {sid} ===")
            frame = fetch_us_stock_daily(
                sid,
                start,
                end,
                chunk_years=chunk_years,
                session=sess,
            )
            all_frames.append(frame)
            summaries.append(
                FetchResult(
                    stock_id=sid,
                    requested_start=start,
                    requested_end=end,
                    rows=len(frame),
                    first_date=None if frame.empty else frame["date"].min(),
                    last_date=None if frame.empty else frame["date"].max(),
                )
            )
            if save_db and not frame.empty:
                count = upsert_us_stock_daily(frame)
                print(f"  DB upsert: {count:,} rows -> {TARGET_TABLE}")

    combined = (
        pd.concat(all_frames, ignore_index=True)
        if all_frames
        else _normalize_us_stock_price(pd.DataFrame(), "")
    )
    if not combined.empty:
        combined = combined.drop_duplicates(["date", "stock_id"], keep="last")
        combined = combined.sort_values(["stock_id", "date"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    written = export_us_stock_daily_csv(combined, csv_dir) if csv_dir is not None else []
    return combined, summaries, written

"""Install and verify the paper trade schema against the Dashboard database."""
from pathlib import Path
from common import db

REQUIRED = {"orders": {"position_effect", "time_in_force", "cancel_reason", "trigger_direction"},
            "trades": {"position_quantity", "exit_order_id"},
            "journals": {"id", "title", "body", "journal_date", "updated_at"},
            "journal_links": {"journal_id", "account_id", "run_id", "trade_id", "historical_date", "entry_order_id"}}


def main():
    try:
        import markdown_it  # noqa: F401
        import PIL  # noqa: F401
    except ImportError as exc:
        raise RuntimeError('Install Markdown dependency: python -m pip install "markdown-it-py>=3.0,<5" "Pillow>=11.3,<13"') from exc
    sql = (Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "dashboard" / "sql" / "paper_trade.sql").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    with db.get_connection() as conn:
        conn.commit()
        conn.autocommit = True
        print("Database:", conn.execute("SELECT current_database()").fetchone()[0])
        try:
            conn.execute(sql, prepare=False)
        except Exception:
            conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise
        rows = conn.execute("SELECT table_name, column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'paper_trade'").fetchall()
        found = {(table, column) for table, column in rows}
        missing = sorted((table, column) for table, columns in REQUIRED.items() for column in columns if (table, column) not in found)
        if missing:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Missing schema columns: {missing}")
        legacy = [(t,c) for t,c in found if t in ("runs","trades") and c in ("note","note_updated_at")]
        if legacy: raise RuntimeError(f"Legacy note columns remain: {legacy}")
        # A unique constraint on order_id would prevent partial position splits.
        old_unique = conn.execute("""SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.conrelid AND a.attnum=c.conkey[1] WHERE c.conrelid='paper_trade.trades'::regclass AND c.contype='u' AND cardinality(c.conkey)=1 AND a.attname='order_id'""").fetchone()
        if old_unique:
            raise RuntimeError("Legacy UNIQUE(order_id) remains; partial closing cannot work.")
        conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(t.position_quantity,o.quantity), t.exit_order_id, o.position_effect, o.time_in_force, o.cancel_reason, o.trigger_direction FROM paper_trade.trades t JOIN paper_trade.orders o ON o.id=t.order_id LIMIT 0")
        conn.execute("SELECT entry_order_id FROM paper_trade.journal_link_details LIMIT 0")
        print("Verified: position fields, time_in_force, trigger_direction, journal opening-order links.")
        print("paper_trade schema ready. Existing market and backtest tables were not changed.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
    from dashboard.journal_media import media_root
    print("Journal media:", media_root())

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import socket
import threading
import webbrowser

import uvicorn


def main() -> None:
    host = "127.0.0.1"
    port = int(os.getenv("DASHBOARD_PORT", "8050"))
    url = f"http://{host}:{port}"

    # 桌面捷徑被重複雙擊時，直接開啟既有 Dashboard，不再啟動第二個服務。
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as probe:
        probe.settimeout(0.4)
        if probe.connect_ex((host, port)) == 0:
            print(f"Dashboard 已在執行，正在開啟：{url}")
            webbrowser.open(url)
            return

    threading.Timer(1.2, lambda: webbrowser.open(url)).start()
    print(f"級距統計 Dashboard 已啟動：{url}")
    print("關閉此視窗即可停止 Dashboard。")
    uvicorn.run("dashboard.app:app", host=host, port=port, reload=False, log_level="info")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from FinMind.data import DataLoader


FILE_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve()
PROJECT_ROOT = next(
    (
        path
        for path in (*FILE_PATH.parents, Path.cwd().resolve())
        if (path / "module" / "futures_datas.py").exists()
    ),
    FILE_PATH.parents[1],
)
sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

if hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")

load_dotenv(PROJECT_ROOT / ".env")

from module.futures_datas import fetch_daily_market_data  # noqa: E402


PURE_MONTH_PATTERN = r"^\d{6}$"


def _empty_result(source: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return pd.DataFrame(
        columns=[
            "資料來源",
            "來源交易日期",
            "期貨代號",
            "契約月份",
            "交易時段",
            "開盤",
            "最高",
            "最低",
            "收盤",
            "成交量",
        ]
    ).assign(資料來源=source)


def fetch_taifex_raw(
    futures_id: str,
    start_date: pd.Timestamp,
    end_date: pd.Timestamp,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """直接下載期交所官方 CSV，不讀寫資料庫。"""
    frame = fetch_daily_market_data(start_date, end_date, futures_id)
    if frame is None or frame.empty:
        return _empty_result("TAIFEX")

    frame = frame.loc[frame["trading_session"].eq("after_market")].copy()
    if frame.empty:
        return _empty_result("TAIFEX")

    return pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "資料來源": "TAIFEX",
            "來源交易日期": pd.to_datetime(frame["trade_date"]).dt.date,
            "期貨代號": frame["futures_id"],
            "契約月份": frame["contract_month"],
            "交易時段": frame["trading_session"],
            "開盤": frame["open"],
            "最高": frame["high"],
            "最低": frame["low"],
            "收盤": frame["close"],
            "成交量": frame["volume"],
        }
    ).sort_values(["來源交易日期", "成交量"], ascending=[True, False])


def fetch_finmind_raw(
    futures_id: str,
    start_date: pd.Timestamp,
    end_date: pd.Timestamp,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """直接呼叫 FinMind，不使用專案快取，也不寫入資料庫。"""
    token = os.getenv("FINMIND_TOKEN", "").strip()
    if not token:
        raise RuntimeError(f"找不到 FINMIND_TOKEN，請檢查 {PROJECT_ROOT / '.env'}")

    api = DataLoader()
    api.login_by_token(api_token=token)
    frame = api.taiwan_futures_daily(
        futures_id=futures_id,
        start_date=start_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        # FinMind 的區間端點行為可能隨套件版本不同，多加一天避免漏掉 end_date。
        end_date=(end_date + pd.Timedelta(days=1)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
    )
    if frame is None or frame.empty:
        return _empty_result("FinMind")

    required = {"date", "futures_id", "contract_date", "trading_session"}
    missing = required.difference(frame.columns)
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError(f"FinMind 回傳缺少欄位：{', '.join(sorted(missing))}")

    frame = frame.copy()
    frame["date"] = pd.to_datetime(frame["date"], errors="coerce")
    frame["contract_date"] = frame["contract_date"].astype(str).str.strip()
    frame = frame.loc[
        frame["date"].between(start_date, end_date)
        & frame["trading_session"].astype(str).str.strip().eq("after_market")
        & frame["contract_date"].str.fullmatch(PURE_MONTH_PATTERN, na=False)
    ].copy()
    if frame.empty:
        return _empty_result("FinMind")

    return pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "資料來源": "FinMind",
            "來源交易日期": frame["date"].dt.date,
            "期貨代號": frame["futures_id"],
            "契約月份": frame["contract_date"],
            "交易時段": frame["trading_session"],
            "開盤": pd.to_numeric(frame.get("open"), errors="coerce"),
            "最高": pd.to_numeric(frame.get("max"), errors="coerce"),
            "最低": pd.to_numeric(frame.get("min"), errors="coerce"),
            "收盤": pd.to_numeric(frame.get("close"), errors="coerce"),
            "成交量": pd.to_numeric(frame.get("volume"), errors="coerce"),
        }
    ).sort_values(["來源交易日期", "成交量"], ascending=[True, False])


def _night_dates(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> list[pd.Timestamp]:
    if frame.empty:
        return []
    dates = pd.to_datetime(frame["來源交易日期"], errors="coerce").dropna()
    return sorted({date.normalize() for date in dates})


def _print_source_result(
    source: str,
    frame: pd.DataFrame | None,
    error: Exception | None,
) -> None:
    print(f"\n{'=' * 18} {source} {'=' * 18}")
    if error is not None:
        print(f"查詢失敗：{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
        return
    if frame is None or frame.empty:
        print("查詢區間內沒有純月份 TX 盤後資料。")
        return
    print(frame.to_string(index=False))


def _conclusion(
    report_date: pd.Timestamp,
    end_date: pd.Timestamp,
    official: pd.DataFrame | None,
    finmind: pd.DataFrame | None,
) -> None:
    print(f"\n{'=' * 18} 判讀結果 {'=' * 18}")
    print(f"專案報表夜盤歸屬日：{report_date.date()}")
    print(f"外部來源檢查區間：{report_date.date()} ～ {end_date.date()}")

    for source, frame in (("TAIFEX", official), ("FinMind", finmind)):
        if frame is None:
            print(f"{source}：查詢失敗，無法判讀。")
            continue
        dates = _night_dates(frame)
        if not dates:
            print(
                f"{source}：目前仍查不到這個區間的盤後資料；"
                "可能尚未發布或來源延遲，不能據此否定日期歸屬假設。"
            )
            continue

        same_date_exists = report_date in dates
        later_dates = [date for date in dates if date > report_date]
        next_date = later_dates[0] if later_dates else None

        if same_date_exists:
            print(
                f"{source}：有 {report_date.date()} 的盤後列；依下一交易日歸屬規則，"
                "這列代表前一交易日下午至本日凌晨，不是本日下午開始的夜盤。"
            )
        else:
            print(f"{source}：沒有 {report_date.date()} 的盤後列。")

        if next_date is not None:
            days = (next_date - report_date).days
            print(
                f"{source}：下一筆盤後列標在 {next_date.date()}，比報表日期晚 {days} 天；"
                f"這才是 {report_date.date()} 下午開始之夜盤的候選資料，"
                "符合『夜盤歸到下一交易日』的假設。"
            )
        else:
            print(
                f"{source}：目前尚未出現 {report_date.date()} 之後的盤後列；"
                "若下一交易日尚未發布，這是正常現象，稍後再測即可。"
            )

    official_later = (
        [date for date in _night_dates(official) if date > report_date]
        if official is not None
        else []
    )
    finmind_later = (
        [date for date in _night_dates(finmind) if date > report_date]
        if finmind is not None
        else []
    )
    if official_later and finmind_later:
        if official_later[0] == finmind_later[0]:
            print(f"兩個來源的下一個盤後歸屬日一致：{official_later[0].date()}。")
        else:
            print(
                "兩個來源的下一個盤後歸屬日不一致："
                f"TAIFEX={official_later[0].date()}、FinMind={finmind_later[0].date()}。"
            )


def run_diagnostic(report_date: str, futures_id: str = "TX", lookahead_days: int = 7) -> int:
    start = pd.Timestamp(report_date).normalize()
    end = start + pd.Timedelta(days=lookahead_days)

    official = finmind = None
    official_error = finmind_error = None
    try:
        official = fetch_taifex_raw(futures_id, start, end)
    except Exception as exc:  # 診斷時必須保留另一來源的查詢結果
        official_error = exc

    try:
        finmind = fetch_finmind_raw(futures_id, start, end)
    except Exception as exc:  # 診斷時必須保留另一來源的查詢結果
        finmind_error = exc

    _print_source_result("期交所官方 CSV", official, official_error)
    _print_source_result("FinMind 原始 API", finmind, finmind_error)
    _conclusion(start, end, official, finmind)

    return 1 if official_error is not None or finmind_error is not None else 0


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="比較期交所與 FinMind 的 TX 盤後資料交易日歸屬（只讀，不寫資料庫）"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--report-date",
        default="2026-08-21",
        help="專案報表所使用的夜盤日期，格式 YYYY-MM-DD",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--futures-id", default="TX", help="期貨代號，預設 TX")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--lookahead-days",
        type=int,
        default=7,
        help="從報表日期向後檢查幾個日曆日，預設 7",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    return run_diagnostic(args.report_date, args.futures_id, args.lookahead_days)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
